A compilation featuring different bonus tracks.
Tracks 1-4 from the Gate of Shadows LP.

Track 9 is an extension of Fossil Stables, previously unavailable.
Time is abundant, and so is economy in our particular case.

trackinfo.title: Somehow (Vinyl Mix)
trackinfo.lyrics: The medical tower was set ablaze, as the terrified Sulka wanted nothing to do with what was in it, also fearing the possibility of some disease. Ophelia was never seen again.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: Citadel Icrifeani (Vinyl Mix)
trackinfo.lyrics: Yvette lamented the loss of her sister, and now, as the only human left in Paradise, the Sulka protected her with everything they had, as she was the only individual left who could wield the Big Stick.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: Murky Gloom Widow (Vinyl Mix)
trackinfo.lyrics: In her dreams, she saw a small house within a small village. The house had faces that popped out of the foundation every once in a while, and the looked very much like the child with the stone head that Ophelia had brought back. Not much is known about what happened to the child after the Sulka saw it. Some say they left it in the field, and a storm carried it away. Others claim they buried it out of muted horror regarding its facial expression.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: Dark Comet? (Vinyl Mix)
trackinfo.lyrics: Needless to say, Paradise was never the same after what happened to Ophelia. Sebastian, the Captain of the Sulka, made it clear that no one was to enter the Jala Woods under any circumstances. It was clear to many that even though the Jala Woods were off-limits, that the children of the Sulka seemed to be awfully attracted to the mysticism and odd legends about it.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: The Spinning Wheel (Demo)
trackinfo.lyrics: Now, as you can probably imagine, with a weak state, no country, good or bad, can survive. Luckily, we live in anything but a weak state. As you can imagine, this exercise has been a metaphor for what we like to call "azure state".
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: Water Shrine (Demo)
trackinfo.lyrics: There are many enemies to the establishment of the azure state. Remember that rights are not gifts from the Azure Government. Thus, they are gifts of governments past. Azure state is a train of thought that governs our way of life, our prosperity.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: Music Chimes for the Experimental
trackinfo.lyrics: In order to understand the exercise, we need to analyze its components. A color, like azure, is a variation of a primary color. Why did our government choose azure as its national and official state color? It has to do with policy. The purpose of this next exercise (or, the analysis of the story thus far) is to expand the mind of the average azure citizen and worker so that the glorious State of the Azure may expand.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: Fossil Stables
trackinfo.lyrics: Let's consider the meaning of the word Earth first. Remember that rights are not gifts from the Azure Government and a remnants of inferior government systems. In order to create a better world, the former rights of our citizens (the right of assembly and free press for example), are maintained to prevent the dissolution of our glorious state. In essence, we take the good pieces of the past and use them to form a world, much like Earth.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

trackinfo.title: I Ran Far Away
trackinfo.lyrics: Consider that time is money, or in our case, revenue and economy. We create our economy through time, and vice versa, making these two elements inseparable. Likewise, our constitution calls for hard work and a good pay for the work of a man. Better work merits better pay. These are inseparable elements.
trackinfo.credits: from ?, released November 5, 2014

Zeffon.title: 10,707 Eyes
Zeffon.about:
i. Staring Eyes
After nursing her wounded foot a little, the woman heard a voice.
"Eeeee..."
She looked around. Surely this couldn't be happening already. The escape from Zeffon had happened so quickly, but she knew that it was inevitable if someone were to survive that he would know about it. That man was obsessed with consuming worlds. The other man that had rescued the woman simply sat on a rock, staring at his feet. There was no response from him. Perhaps he really was the one. It was said that when mankind loses its ability to communicate with the gods, then a certain individual who represents that voice would fall mute. It just seemed unlikely that it was this man. Yet, it was a possibility.
"Eeeeee..."
That sound was getting stronger. The woman swatted her ear, expecting to get a mosquito there, but there was nothing. Surely it was nothing. The Dark Comet had turned her previous world into a raging inferno, but the same thing wouldn't happen here, would it?
The man looked up. Cyane had been thinking for a while, but he knew that although he had known her for a short time, he knew that he admired that woman. Oh, how he wished he could speak!
ii. Spiteful Sol
It was known a long time ago that Yeehehenn was the creation of Ouer, the new name of the ancient god of water. This itself is mentioned in the Water Book, something that has not been opened in a long time, and is kept by a certain tribe near Du Garma Canyon. The Water Book is supposedly cursed, as is the water element, as water seems to dissolve all the evil contained with the dimension of Zeffon.
iii. Asylum From the Sun
To say is to do. It became obvious after a while that involuntary speech had consequences for those that dared oppose the sun. To be clear, it was never a matter of how often the Sun of Gheheh opposed Sol, but it was a matter of how that sun, created by the Third Eye, never appeared to set.

Zeffon.about:
Okay, I have a confession to make. I tried to assassinate Dränsilane's proxy, but failed miserably. It must've been due to that rat patrolman. In any case, I'm stuck. My name is Lanaos.
I tried to kill Dränsilane for fear that the man would return to the Frogplain. Yes, Dränsilane did die, but he will continue to be reborn. That is the issue I face. I fear I have little time left.
I have left behind everything I can to try to make sure someone can take my place. It feels as though my soul is separating from my body. Someone needs to bring death swiftly to the immortal.
I need to make it to my village past the Endigös statue. Only then will I have some chance of surviving.
My father left behind something of value. It means nothing to me, but he assured me that it was important. It was a small scrap of paper, covered in what appeared to be dried blood. On the front, it read "parallels". On the back however, was scrawled the number "24". Apparently, it is half of a very significant number, at least one significant to someone who can kill Dränsilane.
Yes, my father Jan didn't realize his role in life until much later. I suppose some of us are warriors, while others are simply messengers. Although I tried to turn the cards I held regarding my societal role as a woman, I never was able to effectively beat the god at his own game. Thus, I am a messenger, like everyone else.

trackinfo.title: ½
trackinfo.lyrics: Things seemed to be panning out. Out of curiosity, the birds spoke to me, and they said that the reason I was able to step out of my haze of mind and into the open world of Paradise is because of the symbol that was given: a bird with a branch in its mouth, a cashew glued to the tip. This bird was part of the Sulka, a militarized group of birds and reptiles dedicated to removing the sources of madness from the various dimensions.

Zeffon.about:
I. Birthday
On this day, RTL was born.
On this day, RTL died.
And though she passed away long ago.
It is a mere husk that continues to live.
And with this final writing,
It is I, Thorn Ansede, the author of our story thus far,
Who will pass away as well.
May my words be interpreted as metaphor
And not fact.
It was on this night that Reve Terra Lyeon, Caria's aunt, had a dream about her. She dreamed that Caria was in a black pool of darkness, and, in an ominously silent depiction, dreamed that Caria was drowning and trying to keep her head above the black waters.

The Nacajda also gives what is known as The Ritual of Tongues. Individuals who have undergone this ritual speak in the oddest dialect, given that their tongue is cut out as part of the ritual. However, they are still able to make sounds that would otherwise require a tongue, which is (or was) attributed to Miu's "grace".
iii. Vine
Miu is supposedly a weak god, but a master of the Nacajda, and thus all-powerful within its walls. Those who enter his "realm" nowadays shall be ripped apart (or so they say).
iv. A Past Evening
There's a tale of the Death Machine that lurks within the Nacajda's walls that carries out the bidding of the wrathful Miu. It is said those attacked by this machine experience death by being bled until they turn blue from the lack of oxygen, all while being alive. Despite being a detective, I personally know very little about the Nacajda.
v. Strange Beckoning
There is a treasure in that cursed temple though. It's the old king's crown that used to belong to Dränsilane. How it got to Lavu from Anne is a mystery.
vi. Death of One Alone
However, I know for a fact that it exists. One of my friends attempted to loot the crown from the Nacajda, and eventually succeeded. Before he disappeared, he showed it to me. It's a simple crown made of gold and a pearl here and there - nothing too fancy. However, he told me that he had to go on a journey because of a "black dragon" that he met while inside. There, he said, the dragon told him to visit him at the Citadel of the Ha Ma Trials, a temple dedicated to Unknown Iahae and located in an isolated marshy part of Refeaël. I haven't seen him since.

Zeffon.title: Above All
Zeffon.about:
Trivia: This album is more or less a tribute to the things that influenced me as a child, including certain mystery movies, and epic role-playing games. The album name is an excerpt from the quote "Above all, avoid the moor". Also, the sequence of artwork (from Something Wicked to Graghgorra) is meant to represent an individual braving everything on a quest for their own identity.
i. Creator's Rage
Heretmedel, being the ancient name of Ocsania, is now suspended in Limbo, due to the unusual supernatural nature of Unkardia and its neighboring isle, Anne. Eventually, two more of the four brothers disappear, leaving Nathaniel Short, the youngest. Desperate, Nathaniel crosses the Great Marsh to the center of it, where he finds the Weeping Oaken Tree. The Weeping Oaken Tree, is the only known portal to Limbo, according to a man Short met calling himself Dr. Uy. He gets to the island in the middle of the Great Marsh, only to find a man waiting for him...
"Going somewhere?"
"Who are you?"
"The name's Kerragan Cathrop, No. 6 of the Royal Government. I've been away for a while, but I'm afraid that we don't need the likes of you running around, screwing with our plans."
"You killed my brothers!"
"Well, it's a possibility... Anyhow, your little scheme ends here. Wait, who are you again...?"
"I... I can't te..."
*BANG*
With that, Nathaniel is shot dead and his body is thrown into the swamp. You (Kerragan) think briefly. Nathaniel Short is dead. Isaac Strafe is also dead. His brothers Vaughn and Ryan are supposedly dead, but have never had their bodies recovered. And Dr. Uy. The thought of Dr. Uy makes your blood boil. And then Samuel Cathrop had to be killed. He simply knew too much about big brother Kerragan. So there's only Dr. Uy, and possibly Vaughn and Ryan Strafe. Any opposition to the Overmind Campaign is practically non-existent.
As you leave, a hideous howl can be heard across the swamp in the darkness. You only hope it's not one of those brady-somethings again...
With his mission accomplished, you report back to Lavu. Having travelled to Unkardia at the very special request of the higher powers, you saw many visions after being escorted by a ghost. The sight of yet another supernatural being was just another day in your line of work. Or at least you could call it work. You're just glad you didn't get caught up in overmind mumbo-jumbo back in the Great Marsh.
Unfortunately, according to your colleagues, Number 8 is terminally ill. That's all right. You didn't know him too well anyway. It still bites at your curiousity, though. You decide to look into it. As it turns out, the cause is very surprising.
ii. Ibiksiani's Ghost
Number Eight is nearly dead by the time you arrive at his residence in Blueheart. His bones show through his skin, he's covered in cysts and slime, and has turned a brown-yellow color. Though horrifying, you need to keep your calm. After giving it some thought, it occurs to you that the cause may not be some weird venom concocted by Dr. Uy, but something more sinister. You examine the records that state his location every 6 hours, something a Governor of Lavu is required to do. Funny. He hasn't even made close contact with the Great Marsh or its boundries. This worries you.
Though the city of Lavu is commonly accepted as the capital of the Kingdom of Lavu, the true official residence of the nine Governors of Lavu is in Nevermore, one of several dimensions that the state knows about, and actively makes sure no one else discovers. The issue with Number 8's illness is that his current state resembles that of a human bradyzoite, a state that should not be contagious from the distance between his common residences and the Great Marsh. The Overmind Campaign may have serious consequences if the biocloud reaches too far.
iii. Wretch
Having called the emergency meeting, the other key members of the government body rise. It is not common to see other members of the body, since the only members allowed to be seen by any other member are the ones directly above and below the member's current rank. You for example, is only allowed contact with members 5 and 7. Ryce Ilhid is number 7. You're not sure what the name of No. 5 is. You've only seen him once.
After explaining the crisis to your colleages, they and you all agree the culprit must be the biocloud transcending an unknown dimension. You all know that the Seraph Territories discovered another dimension recently, but have been reluctant to share any further details. A bold and perhaps unwise move for such a close ally. You have, however, heard of a strange archeological joint expedition being carried out by the Seraph Territories and Refeäel. You propose that you start your investigation there. The other members nod in agreement.
iv. Mystery of the Great Marsh
On your way to Unknown Falls and the barren southeast, the mystery of the Great Marsh still troubles you. You realize that the entrance to Limbo is a dimensional hole just underneath the Weeping Oaken Tree. What puzzles you is how to create a human bradyzoite. Maybe when Governor Number One wanted to start the project, they dragged a human out of Limbo, which corrupted his soul or something. You're not entirely sure what a human bradyzoite even does.
You arrive at Unknown Falls. The massive waterfall is incredibly quiet for such a huge torrential downpour. The only life found in the lake below are Giant Squid, indicating that the water pressure within the lake is extremely high. And most of these monstrocities are usually on the surface. Maybe the air pressure above the lake is incredibly high, compressing the water until it can sustain life that's only found at the bottom of the ocean. But you don't want to find out. Unknown Falls is incredibly ominous and creepy, even for you. You only know about the squid because you can see them from the cliff you're on. Suddenly, you see people with pickaxes. They're mining in the cliff wall below you, which seems incredibly risky to you, given the high pressure theory you just came up with. You make your way down to the general area, where you see a cave. Upon entering, a man greets you.
"Hello. You would be Kerragan, I presume."
"No. Just a wandering traveler."
"Nah. It's definitely Kerragan."
"I don't know your nationality sir, but where I come from, deciding what a person has on their mind when that person already knows is considered rude. I'm just a wandering traveler, and that's what I expect myself to remember, not you."
"You must not remember me. I'm Ulysses Paragi, head of the Government of Ibiksis Island."
"Ulysees? So what are you doing here with the Seraph Territories and Refeaël?"
"Your spies are either getting rusty, or we're just getting better at concealing our information for your espionage. This is a three-nation endeavour."
Your spies are getting rusty? You make a mental note of this.
"Oh. Well, as you already know, I am indeed Kerragan. Out of curiosity, have you lost anyone to the giant squid down there?"
"A few men. All of them convicts."
"Oh, right. Your country doesn't hold in respect for anyone who's already been in prison. We could use that kind of social mentality in Lavu."
"So, what did you come here for?"
"We have a rather large problem. We were curious about that dimension that the Seraph Territories have found as of late."
"It was a dimension they named Anzé. I think they kept it hidden from Lavu for various reasons. Anzé is a dimension that harnesses two dimensional elements, not one, so the scientific value of Anzé is pretty large."
v. Samuelus Mansion
"I'm assuming water is one of these elements. That's all we've found is water-based dimensions filled with swamps."
"This one was actually filled with crystalline rocks so perfect, that their national religion deemed the site holy."
"Perfect crystalline rocks? That's highly unusual and possibily very unstable. The Seraph Territories shouldn't dabble with Anzé too much longer, the rift created if it collapes could cause severe trauma in their region."
"Yeah, I agree. But I shouldn't talk about them like that when they're all around me."
"Psh. Anyhow, what did you come here to find?"
"Another dimension, actually. We think we're very close to the source, but it's buried within this mountain."
"A dimension in Unknown Falls, eh? Sounds foreboding."
"Indeed."

Zeffon.title: Aesthetics
Zeffon.about:
i. Severed Hands in Aesthetically Pleasing Rows
When I, Creator, came into this world and made it my own, I had no idea that a single group of people would cause me this much trouble. Luckily, being the immortal being that I am, I can do as I please. When I found out about how Ryan was permitting his Unkardian kin to usurp my throne, I just could not allow that. That girl though, she made me feel something I had never felt before. Something they call love. Dränsilane joined the forces of Muagara later, hoping to defeat me with the God of Darkness on his side. He knew what I did to him and Reve, and he was willing to destroy the universe in order to destroy me.
I remember when I attacked Sharhodeon, looking for that woman I had been controlling for years. The woman I told to destroy Unkardia itself. The woman I called my wife at one point. It's funny how she had had hope for the world when she knew that I was going to destroy it in the end. She has lost so much. Ha!
In any case, I sent Dränsilane to the real world, one where he has no memory of his past self. He should depart this world within the next 20 years or so.
Reve, I do not wish you to much ill will. However, anyone who has the audacity to try to resist my own desires has no place in this world of mine.
~
When Reve finally awoke, she was in a ship of sorts. A crew member came down the stairs and looked at her. The person the captain took aboard was alive, despite her injuries.
"Where... am I?" croaked Reve, her throat sore. The smell of rotting plants filled the air, causing her to cough. She looked up, but the man had vanished. Pain shot through her right leg when she tried to get up, and she screamed out of sheer agony.
"What's going on in there?"
A familiar face walked into the room. It was him.
"Dränsilane?!"
"Hello, Reve."
Reve once again tried to get up, but couldn't.
"Careful, Reve, you had a close shave with the Sorrow."
"I never entered Graghgorra!"
"The Sorrow has gained power. It lives in our world now, Reve."
"Oh dear... I suppose it got my foot then." Reve looked down. A cast covered what was now a foot-less right leg. Upon further examination, she was missing her left hand, which was also covered in a cast. She remembered being attacked by something in the Sharhodeon Forest, but then something stopped it. Creator! Creator had swooped down and saved her life, only to take her left hand as a trophy.
"Dränsilane..."
"Try to rest, Reve. I'm surprised you're alive."
"Where's Emeroch?"
"Reve..."
"Where is he?"
"I found him mutilated. His left hand was missing. Someone had cut him open. I think they wanted to watch him suffer."
~
I found it... The left hand with the third eye in its palm...
ii. Themed Southeast Interlude
Emeroch was given a burial that day, and ever since he died I was always curious as to why he covered his left hand. At least now I know.
- Kin
The Gods of Yuuuuraoooagahh cannot be stopped, or so it is said, as there is a certain aesthetic that they have the pleases the ultimate being. Unsure of what to do next, the people of the town of Whip began to cry to the third being, the one that caused that there should be a revolution against the warring beings of Muagarah and Eresymcaion. His name cannot be mentioned thrice.
iii. A Water Chamber of Prayer
How does this work when the old beings cannot stay the hand of Muagarah? That's the question the people are asking and have been asking for millennia! Whether they can be sure or not about the strange being that is Eresymcaion (or Muagarah for that matter), they know that there is an issue with the way they have been told to present the ancient temple of Ohshaaagraheehee. The temple contains the ancient weapon that can destroy Muagarah and Eresymcaion, and is known as the Longbow.

trackinfo.title: Severed Hands in Aesthetically Pleasing Rows
trackinfo.lyrics: i. Severed Hands in Aesthetically Pleasing Rows When I, Creator, came into this world and made it my own, I had no idea that a single group of people would cause me this much trouble. Luckily, being the immortal being that I am, I can do as I please. When I found out about how Ryan was permitting his Unkardian kin to usurp my throne, I just could not allow that. That girl though, she made me feel something I had never felt before. Something they call love. Dränsilane joined the forces of Muagara later, hoping to defeat me with the God of Darkness on his side. He knew what I did to him and Reve, and he was willing to destroy the universe in order to destroy me. I remember when I attacked Sharhodeon, looking for that woman I had been controlling for years. The woman I told to destroy Unkardia itself. The woman I called my wife at one point. It's funny how she had had hope for the world when she knew that I was going to destroy it in the end. She has lost so much. Ha! In any case, I sent Dränsilane to the real world, one where he has no memory of his past self. He should depart this world within the next 20 years or so. Reve, I do not wish you to much ill will. However, anyone who has the audacity to try to resist my own desires has no place in this world of mine. ~ When Reve finally awoke, she was in a ship of sorts. A crew member came down the stairs and looked at her. The person the captain took aboard was alive, despite her injuries. "Where... am I?" croaked Reve, her throat sore. The smell of rotting plants filled the air, causing her to cough. She looked up, but the man had vanished. Pain shot through her right leg when she tried to get up, and she screamed out of sheer agony. "What's going on in there?" A familiar face walked into the room. It was him. "Dränsilane?!" "Hello, Reve." Reve once again tried to get up, but couldn't. "Careful, Reve, you had a close shave with the Sorrow." "I never entered Graghgorra!" "The Sorrow has gained power. It lives in our world now, Reve." "Oh dear... I suppose it got my foot then." Reve looked down. A cast covered what was now a foot-less right leg. Upon further examination, she was missing her left hand, which was also covered in a cast. She remembered being attacked by something in the Sharhodeon Forest, but then something stopped it. Creator! Creator had swooped down and saved her life, only to take her left hand as a trophy. "Dränsilane..." "Try to rest, Reve. I'm surprised you're alive." "Where's Emeroch?" "Reve..." "Where is he?" "I found him mutilated. His left hand was missing. Someone had cut him open. I think they wanted to watch him suffer." ~ I found it... The left hand with the third eye in its palm...

Zeffon.title: Alien Tombstone
Zeffon.about:
i. Alien Frog
Due to the nature of some unusual disturbances in nature lately, I thought I'd make an archive of some of these events for posterity. My name is Vari Cathrop. This is a year after I was rescued by my sisters, so I thought I'd finally speak on the disturbances I witnessed in captivity. I've been working to solve some of these problems, but I can't feel quite relieved yet. The things I've seen equate to too much.
ii. Tomb of the Unknown
It's true that Emeroch kidnapped me, but it was not him that had initially intended to do this. Emeroch Isga took me to the Forest Continent. It, as the name implies, is nothing but a deep forest, completely completely free of colonization. This is where the horrors started. While still a small child, I was placed into the forest and left to die. It was part of an experiment that the man Emeroch had come up with for me. He talked of a small generator that he was working on in Värta if memory serves me correctly. In any case, the Forest Continent is filled with ferocious beasts that could easily devour, not to mention rip apart a small human baby. I quickly learned to run from the evil beasts however, and although I've emerged with many physical and emotional scars, I'm still in one piece. Every so often though, although I have gone through copious amounts of therapy, I can still hear the voices of the forest in my head, telling me the most outrageous things.

Zeffon.title: ...And to Speak the Truth or Die
Zeffon.about:
i. 22: Third Eye, Earth Book I
When I came down to the stairs, Lydia was waiting. She had had a horrible time with the plan to destroy Dränsilane, and I was tired as well. Dränsilane was able to predict a lot of the plots against him and plan accordingly. After he joined sides with Muagara, he employed an army of undead soldiers to march alongside the God of Darkness. We decided after that day it was best to abandon our efforts and go underground. Eresymcaion had been dead for some time, eliminating any possibility of the Unknown Beast reforming. From that point on, the decision was made to evacuate the surface and live in the Temple of Faces. Unfortunately, the only people who managed to follow us were some people from the small town of Rowta, up north. The entrance beneath the Fifth Temple of Meredith had collapsed due to the chaos between the warring gods. I suppose that the light was meant to die. It makes me wonder what the forces of evil have in mind beyond world domination. It makes me wonder if they do in fact have a way to reach worlds beyond ours. -- E.
Though this is going to be my only entry in this book (as far as I can tell), I hope to the Greater Power that I may live long enough for a period of peace within this distraught world of Zeffon. Graghgorra was conquered many years before by the Sorrow. I've done battle with the Sorrow before I released that it could destroy the Overmind, and thus me as well. Why does it leave us to suffer? Perhaps it feeds off of our anxiety, causing it to flourish at our expense. The enemy itself cannot be fought by any means, and thus gives me a feeling of lethargy, exeräise, malaise, and most of all, uselessness. I would protect these people if I could, despite the awful things they've done to my homeland. This is to the people of the world. -- Adelais
Lydia left with Adelais. She said that she was going to try to stop Muagara and Dränsilane with her sister. I begged them not to do it, but they felt it was the correct choice to undertake. I told them if that was to be their decision, to at least try to find Reve. She had come down with the same thing that her brother did. I'm sure of it. -- Emeroch
Most of the people that evacuated into the Great Limb Forest did it a while back now. It's been five years now, and still no sign of the two Unkardian women who left the temple. I wish the man Emeroch would stop checking. He just seems to scribble in that book of his, trying to keep a record of the various things that occur in this dank environment. It's too bad - we could use his help finding food. Our supplies that have been stored in this area since our ancestors inhabited this area will run out soon. He keeps talking to the air, and I wonder what that indicates about his sanity. If he keeps this up, I'll take control of the people of Rowta. The blood of Vagard runs within my veins. -- Kin
It's funny how that man seems to cover the palm of his right hand with a glove. Surely it limits his dexterity, yes? Heh.
It became very rainy that following autumn. So rainy in fact, that many of the people of Rowta became ill and died. When Emeroch woke up, the villagers had abandoned him and moved to the surface again. Emeroch ran to the town of Rowta, only to find it in ruin. Frogs croaked around the once-proud town, but there was no sign of the villagers. Emeroch then spotted a sign that displayed the following:
We have run for the hills to the North. Perhaps the man there can help us. She is coming.
Emeroch turned around. The ghost he had been talking to was still there.
"Still tailing me?"
The ghost was as silent as ever.
"You will never drive me mad, never. I am not like my brother. It would be impossible for me to join Muagara."
The ghost remained there.
ii. 90: Death Smiles Upon Thee, Earth Book II
It is day number three. Against my better judgment, I decided to follow where that ghost was taking me. If it really is who I suspect (Vari Cathrop), then there is a small chance that the spirit bodes any ill will. It's best to be cautious, though. I have been guided to what appears to have been Sharhodeon, except the land is destroyed and desolate. It looks like a huge earthquake occurred here, or something of that nature. Rocks as tall as towers stick out of the earth, creating an eerie landscape full of dark columns as I wander in between them. It would be easy to get lost, which is why I'm assuming the ghost is leading me personally. I hope for the very best. -- Emeroch
As I get farther in, I've reached a point where the pillars are more organized, and are in perfect rows and columns. I swear I've heard sounds as I sleep at night - sounds of frogs of course, given the damp environment I'm in, but also some sort of whistling, which affects my thoughts in a strange way. I've also been having dreams of a large citadel in the middle of this vile landscape. -- Emeroch
iii. ?: And to Speak the Truth or Die, Fire Book
I've got only a strange event to write. The ghost abandoned me all of a sudden. The frogs have stopped, making me believe there's something in the darkness. My lantern is out of fuel. I hear a faint breeze. ))--RE(a) E.
...Sharhodeon Forest, a massive wood where a country once resided...
iv. Sharhodeon Forest ))--RE(a)
In the end, the god of Utheooaggah was the one that saved us all from doom. He resides in the Shaaarrhhhoden Fooohhhrest - at least, that's the name of the forest as it stands now.

It's been five years now, and still no sign of the two Unkardian women who left the temple. I wish the man Emeroch would stop checking. He just seems to scribble in that book of his, trying to keep a record of the various things that occur in this dank environment. It's too bad - we could use his help finding food. Our supplies that have been stored in this area since our ancestors inhabited this area will run out soon. He keeps talking to the air, and I wonder what that indicates about his sanity. If he keeps this up, I'll take control of the people of Rowta. The blood of Vagard runs within my veins. -- Kin It's funny how that man seems to cover the palm of his right hand with a glove. Surely it limits his dexterity, yes? Heh. It became very rainy that following autumn. So rainy in fact, that many of the people of Rowta became ill and died. When Emeroch woke up, the villagers had abandoned him and moved to the surface again. Emeroch ran to the town of Rowta, only to find it in ruin. Frogs croaked around the once-proud town, but there was no sign of the villagers. Emeroch then spotted a sign that displayed the following: We have run for the hills to the North. Perhaps the man there can help us. She is coming. Emeroch turned around. The ghost he had been talking to was still there. "Still tailing me?" The ghost was as silent as ever. "You will never drive me mad, never. I am not like my brother. It would be impossible for me to join Muagara." The ghost remained there.
trackinfo.credits: from ...And to Speak the Truth or Die, released January 4, 2014

trackinfo.title: 90: Death Smiles Upon Thee, Earth Book II
trackinfo.lyrics: ii. 90: Death Smiles Upon Thee, Earth Book II It is day number three. Against my better judgment, I decided to follow where that ghost was taking me. If it really is who I suspect (Vari Cathrop), then there is a small chance that the spirit bodes any ill will. It's best to be cautious, though. I have been guided to what appears to have been Sharhodeon, except the land is destroyed and desolate. It looks like a huge earthquake occurred here, or something of that nature. Rocks as tall as towers stick out of the earth, creating an eerie landscape full of dark columns as I wander in between them. It would be easy to get lost, which is why I'm assuming the ghost is leading me personally. I hope for the very best. -- Emeroch As I get farther in, I've reached a point where the pillars are more organized, and are in perfect rows and columns. I swear I've heard sounds as I sleep at night - sounds of frogs of course, given the damp environment I'm in, but also some sort of whistling, which affects my thoughts in a strange way. I've also been having dreams of a large citadel in the middle of this vile landscape. -- Emeroch

Zeffon.title: Antarctic
Zeffon.about:
Antarctic is about a civilization that popped up in the tundras to the south before it the climate turned arid and dry.
Yearning is about the loss of the civilization of Vorsanchu. After the abandonment of the original town, humanity was lost forever, with the exception of the the Antarctic civilization.
Dead Language refers to the loss of being able to communicate effectively after the loss of Vorsanchu.
Voice 67 is about Reve Isga's arrival to the new world from the world of Zeffon, and describes her grief when she realizes her daughter is dead. Being one of the last humans, she seeks shelter in a cliff side. From there, she lives another 45 years before she dies.
Wave Thoughts is about how the Antarctic civilization becomes cursed with the same thing that cursed the Zeffon civilization: the inability to conceive children.
Birdstream is a short piece about the peaceful death of the last king.
Abandoned Apprentice (By the Lake) refers to how the Antarctic civilization makes a public decree to kill each other as part of a ritual suicide. They figure they have nothing else to live for.
Death Fields refers to the Day of Death, where most of the remaining humans commit suicide.
Antarctic is a closing piece for the story of Zeffon.
Hands Are Tied is about a young child who manages to live. He knows one word and nothing about his name or origins. He crosses the southern Tundra and lives a long life before he passes away.

Zeffon.title: Apathy
Zeffon.about:
i. Apathy
Apathy is the second album that represents Kerragan's dream sequence. In this album, Kerragan sees a broken world ruled by a brutal monarchy.
When the boy arrived in an unknown land, he was broken, beaten, and tired. It was only after being adopted by a priest that he gained a true home. The priest never asked where the boy came from, and the boy never told him his name. Eventually, everyone called the boy “Unknown Iahae”, a name that the boy adopted himself.
ii. Ashes
The boy grew up with everyone believing that he was some sort of child that would bring holy protection to the priest’s temple. The boy, eventually growing into a man, dismissed this, saying that there was no being in the world that could ever conjure up such a barrier.
iii. Spin?
The boy would always go the beach on which he was found, always unsure of what to do next. His parents were killed, and everyone he knew and loved was dead. One night, the boy would go and find that someone had left a bastard sword on the beach. There was a note left next to it, explaining that it was for Unknown Iahae.
iv. After the Storm
The boy didn’t gain much excitement from his discovery, since he had been doing everything in his power to forget his time in the Wysteriascape. He hid the sword deep in the temple, sat on his bed, and wept.
v. Astronomy
The only true friends that Unknown Iahae had were in the stars. He would often stand outside at night and begin to make pictures out of what he saw. He thought that the stars themselves were the only steps to his salvation.
vi. Anomalies
Soon though, the holy temple would come under attack by a certain Arc-Demai. By that time, Unknown Iahae had already fled.
~
Accessing the Wysteriascape has been a puzzle for years and years after it was discovered due to it being Unknown Iahae’s homeland. One can supposedly leave the Wysteriascape, but never come back. Anyone who has done so (or claimed to have done so) is also found to be clinically insane, and therefore unreliable. According to records left behind from the destruction of Unknown Iahae’s temple, the Temple of the Sun, Unknown Iahae himself preferred not to discuss it, and in fact seemed to regret ever mentioning the Wysteriascape. The only clue has been considered to be the Serenade for the Dead, a tune apparently in five parts and curiously linked to the Kingdom of Lavu by means of an ancient Lavulese composer named Harris, who supposedly collaborated with Unknown Iahae on the piece.

Zeffon.title: Awaken!
Zeffon.about:
Demo 12.
i. Underwater Cave, Squid, the True Median, Mossy Branches
When it comes to various things, I'm just glad that I was able to escape the Chaoslands. Another thing happened that I should not write about, but that's in the past. Naturally, I was very curious when I began having the visions that begged for attention. Eventually, I regained the ability to speak, and I found myself on the shores of a certain beach with the woman I had helped rescue. She described her name as Lydia, and I introduced myself as Cyane. I didn't know about my origins very well, but Lydia would often speak of the old days of a place called Unkardia. She seemed to love it so, and also seemed eager to return. She also mentioned a place called by a name I found so particularly foul that I never inquired about it again. The nature of this relationship became rather odd, as she would not stop talking about it. Eventually, she disappeared one night, never to be seen again.
The bulk of my story begins when I destroyed my parallel. After Roanin's parallel Kerragan was killed, he was hastily replaced with a being that was pulled out of the dimensional rift, the one where all the Dwellers came out of. Dwellers manifest themselves only occasionally, being the leftover material from a world generated by chaos. Their parallels are the Mandras, small people who live in the Crystal Forest. In a sense, everything in Zeffon has to have a parallel. Unkardia is on the opposite side of the rift that the Chaoslands are on. Dreamers in Unkardia manifest themselves as the people in the Chaoslands and the Chaosland dreamers become the people of Unkardia. Thus, a loop is formed, each individual being a figment of another imaginary person's imagination. Thus, things can be absolutely chaotic. I shouldn't have been able to kill Roanin, but somehow I did, and the world was returned to a normal state. Unfortunately, it will change following this writing. If the moderator of this world locked the world's protocol was a giant armored gate, Roanin was the key.

Knowing the man that came to my house one day, I quickly became angry. He was the one that killed my parents. After that, he burned their remains. He left, without even looking at me, as I was hiding in the hall closet.
ii. ???
Eventually I came to know Reve Terra Lyeon. She was looking for her mother, and I knew that I needed to help her. She seemed very quiet, but I knew what she need almost all the time.
iii. ???
We went to a spot by the river. She said that there was a young girl who saved her brother here, and that she had a clue to the whereabouts of Reve Isga, her mother.
iv. ???
Teran was her name, according to Reve. She had journeyed to Ratayu for help, but she eventually that everyone in Ratayu was dead due to the mist that came from the Temple of Faces.
v. ???
While she was in Ratayu, she found a document that the head lord had created, describing a tower in a valley with mountains that still move, and she felt obligated to take it.
vi. ???
The leaders of Ratayu were apparently still breathing, but they seemed slightly demented, constantly looking around them with wild eyes.

Zeffon.title: Beyond the Realms of Sharmiah
Zeffon.about:
i. Matheus
This album is about the current state of the Marat Empire, and how they use their riches to hide from the world's problems.
Emeroch began acting very strangely after we arrived in Meredith. He began acting indecisive and often second-guessed himself. I began to slowly realize that Gaine’s soul, with which Emeroch was combined, was slowly beginning to return. This would mean that Emeroch himself would be erased and killed as Gaine finally reemerged. This meant that I would probably die as well, and Reve’s son, Vari Cathrop, would become himself again, effectively killing me. I didn’t bother me, though. On that day, I would pay for my mistakes. That day however, would come before I expected. The streets of the city of Matheus were in chaos. Bones littered the windy cobblestone roads like trash. People were sobbing and peacekeeping forces were constantly busy. Vant Ruan didn’t seem to mind the invasion as Rowland had hoped. Rowland issued a decree soon afterwards, annexing the Marat Empire as part of the Kingdom of Lavu, causing for massive protests. Vant Ruan still did nothing about this, and instead relaxed in the Presidential palace.
ii. The Ritual Illness
Underneath the palace was a sprawling network of chambers and torture devices, conceived in the days of old when the Marat Empire was ruled by the War Party. The destruction of this party came later, but not after many lives were lost underneath the cobblestone streets. Civilians or political prisoners, no one was safe. Supposedly connected to the bottom of the temple is an even larger network of tunnels and chambers, one that connects all the way to the planet core. This is called the Temple of Faces. Suddenly, the church bell tolled, and I began to feel nauseous. I stumbled down a path and struggled to see. My conscious was fading away from me. Vari Cathrop was returning. Then all was black…
”Wake up, you fool…”
I awoke to see myself as I was before I stole Vari’s body. I must’ve been dreaming.
”Hello…”
My clone grinned.
”Finally, I’m going to get a body of my own…”
I just smiled back.
”What’s so funny?” the clone asked, turning its head.
”I’m not sure I care about whether I die or not. Frankly, I think I’ve committed enough damage as is to this world. To the civilians of Cathrop, to my sister…”
”So you’re honestly willing to die?” The clone looked befuddled.
”Yes.”
”Then…” The clone suddenly started to fade and then was gone before it could utter another word.

vi. 8: Untitled
Something to consider is the way of the Castle of Gehehehe. Nothing gets in there, and nothing gets out. It lies far across the desert, on an island that requires certain equipment to access, as the island is raised far above the ocean waves that surround it.
vii. 13: Untitled
The tenth dream, or Dream X came into being around this time. Whoever had it, we do not know. The Creator is still dreaming and slumbering.
viii. 21: Untitled
There was an eleventh dream around this time as well. Caria had this one, and she was well acquainted with Tellh by this time. This allowed for her to have Dream XI without any distractions. Tellh guarded the way as Caria slept and began to see the prophecy.
ix. 34: Untitled
It was in this stage that the battle of Yeuauggeg began to occur. Muagarah was dead at this point, and the Third Eye had conquered everyone that there was to conquer. It was then the battles ceased, and peace began to flow throughout the land. Eresymcaion had the twelfth dream, or Dream XII at this point in time, allowing it to re-energize and reform as a god.
x. 55: Sleep Twice
The two gods, the Third Eye and Eresymcaion began to work together and contemplate the meaning of Zeffon's existence. Although the dimension had been in existence for millennia, it was obvious no one knew exactly why. Caria had the thirteenth dream at this point, or Dream XIII.
xi. 89: Untitled
Soon, other towns began to rise throughout the land, the farthest, most distant one from the original town of Ratayu being located in a more temperate climate, being called Nanta. There is a forest near this town where the inhabitants of Nanta built a shrine, which eventually became a temple.
xii. Distant Observer
To see the town of Nanta is to die...
xiii. 0: Untitled
It became clear that in the time it took to travel to Nanta, that Nanta itself had vanished into thin air.
xiv. 0: Significant Dawn
The eyes of the sky began to change according to the thirteenth dream, or Dream XIII. They would not receive another dream for the Eternity of Iuuufug, which is a traveling unit of time. Due to the new rotation, it became clear that the Jahhhhh, or the old king of the land around Ratayu, knew nothing about his old state's secrets. He was the king, yet he behaved quite naively.
xv. 0: Sleep Thrice
Kaiubahh was the influence of the Third Eye. It was the first counselor for the old king of the land around Ratayu. He had it so that the king killed himself thinking about the fourteenth dream, and when it would show up. The Fourteenth Dream is one with the number 48, which is the Sun's number, and can be used to destroy the Dragon in the Sun.
16: 0: Untitled
It was obvious that the Yeueannja didn't know what he was doing either. He had a plan for the evil ones within the stone temple that was underground. This temple was shaped like a pyramid, and thus became the way that Caria was not supposed to venture through, as the water was poison.

Zeffon.title: Blue Tape
Zeffon.about:
i. Hind Titanium Legs
I found that I understood nothing about what was said about the awful creatures that inhabited the mire when it was told to me. Supposedly, they were creatures that grew stronger in death, but no one was sure. Death was merely a device for these creatures, one that was utilized to allow them to get stronger.
ii. Potent Fire-breathing Apparatus
The men who were devoured in the mire in the region next to Dotajmari were good people too. Thus, I set out to take revenge on these evil creatures. I took my machete with me, and traveled by boat across the lake to Goatha, the ruined town that existed next to an old tree that was said to grow throughout several dimensions at the same time.
iii. Substance X Archive
I found myself in a very interesting situation. There was a trail of blood (relatively fresh) that led to a hole in the ground. Against my better judgement, I crawled into the muck, which sucked me in quicker than I had anticipated. I was quickly drowning in mud, and I had no idea how to escape. In an attempt to find air, I quickly grew tired and lost consciousness.
iv. Dr. X Plus His Ambitions
A strange flopping sound woke me up, and I realized that I was no longer in the mire east of Goatha, but a stone floor covered in a slime that glowed blue in the dark. Thus, even in the thick musty air, I was able to see. I had lost my machete in the mud, and so I proceeded to press onward unarmed, as there was no way back to the surface that I could immediately see.
v. Space Patrol, Part 4
A loud bang startled me, followed by a mysterious and rather disgusting-sounding bubbling sound, the kind that you would expect to come out of a giant insect or something with large mandibles. I ran away from the sound, the slime making loud clapping noises as my feet made contact with it. Then I saw a shadow rounding the corner in front of me. It had the most grotesque shape - the outline of it was rippling and pulsating. I tried not to yell and ran back the other direction, knowing full well that I was likely surrounded.
vi. Mutations in the Reef
As I waited for my fate, I noticed that the shadows of giant beasts were not being cast by something of similar size. As odd as this sounds, the shadows and sounds were being generated by small wingless, earthbound birds that lived below the mire. Relieved, I managed to move about the cavern until I found an exit and made it back to my hometown. For record-keeping purposes, I kept one of the feathers I found in the cave to commerate my small journey. When I told a professor in one of the libraries nearby of my experiences, he laughed and said that there was no mire there - one hadn't existed near Dotajmari in millenia. When I went back, I found he was right - there was nothing but canyon and rock.

Zeffon.title: Box
Zeffon.about:
In my travels that occurred via True North, I encountered a strange land. It was full of people who wandered about the nearby deserts often, never really stopping for food or water. Occasionally this would occur, but many would continually search until they had either died from hunger or thirst. Their perseverance was stunning. They said they were looking for someone. Someone who could guide them to the Frogplain. I met with one of the few non-wandering individuals and he said that an approaching glacier had threatened the desert recently, and thus they were looking for a way to keep it from enveloping the desert. The Frogplain was their solution. I state this because although I am back in Karij, I sense I'll die sooner or later. All the others who searched for the Frogplain have.
Recently, I've heard hideous howls coming from the bottom of the giant lake that was once the Kingdom of Lavu. Supposedly, fell beasts wandered the Great Marsh. They were called human brady-somethings or other, the result of the experimentations of Félix Oarr. At least, that's what I've heard.
Also, apparently the lifeblood of Dynamix16 is located in the deepest part of the Sharhodeon Forest (((99). Dynamix16, the non-existent entity, also has a leader. MUO993.

trackinfo.title: Primitive Glacier
trackinfo.lyrics: There was a meeting about how to destroy the Big Stick. The Battle of the Third Eye occurred, and the Big Stick was sealed in a glacier, hopefully to never be used again, according to the people who committed the crime. It was clear that the Big Stick could solve all of the problems of the world (including those of humanity), but the humans refused to believe it. The Sulka leader was imprisoned, and the humans continued on the prospect that esoteric means of solving dimensional anomalies were, in fact, the answer.
trackinfo.credits: from Box, released October 10, 2014

I really do wish this was something I could understand legibly.
I wish I could understand anything.
Anything.

There is nothing with wings.

trackinfo.title: Fortomyaglane
trackinfo.lyrics: As the sun began to go down, Ophelia and her company made camp in the Homroge Plain. The soldier they had seen on the hill vanished as soon as they tried to approach him, which was unnerving, but many considered it a trick of the light. They had been traveling for a long time, and they were hungry. In a strange dream, Ophelia began to imagine herself as a different person, someone with a sacred heritage that had been long since forgotten. She began to dream about the times she and her sisters were in Castle Paradise, and how traumatizing it was when Natalie mysteriously disappeared. There was a loud screech, and when the Sulka ran into her room, they found her tattered clothes, not only torn to shreds, but decayed, as if they had been recently dug out of the ground. Fortomyaglane, the captain of the Sulka, searched far and wide for the Princess Natalie, but no one was found. Fortomyaglane, being part of the Sulka, was a bird. While his reptile soldiers scoured the ground, the bird element of the Sulka gave reconnaissance information from above. Suddenly, one of the reptilians from below gave out a mighty call, and the avian element came down to the ground. Bodies of giant bees littered the ground, as if they had just attacked a giant beast. Fortomyaglane didn't know what to make of the situation, but he noticed that there was buzzing in the nearby Jala Woods. A blood-curdling scream rang out from Jala, followed by a dull thumping sound. Fortomyaglane led his soldiers down the path toward the sound, and that was last that was heard of him.
trackinfo.credits: from Box I, released October 25, 2014

trackinfo.title: Ancestor of Xuþy, Pt. 12
trackinfo.lyrics: As the story goes, Ophelia became lost and became subhuman due to the beast's call. Any human that hears it is reduced to a muted subhuman state from which they can never return. After she left the Homroge Plain and began to journey into the Jala Woods, she and her company began to act strangely. She herself had the incredible urge to cry out, even though she was not in pain. It was as if her inner soul had something to say regarding the malicious forest she was in.
trackinfo.credits: from Box I, released October 25, 2014

trackinfo.title: Man in the Thorns
trackinfo.lyrics: It was after the events of Ophelia that Paradise began to crumble. Yvette did everything in her power to prevent the destruction of Paradise, but it was inevitable. A plague began to spread over the kingdom in the form of a mist, and soon, the power of the Big Stick was nullified. The mist made the reptiles and birds, proud followers of their lord and savior, sick, and soon they began to perish. Yvette fled the castle with Captain of the Sulka Sebastian. Eventually, the two, along with Sebastian's wife, made their way west to an abandoned fortress. The mist kept creeping over the land, but in this fortress, they were safe.
trackinfo.credits: from Box II, released November 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Rapture
trackinfo.lyrics: In the fortress, there was a strange howling noise, like some spirit of old was crying out in agony. As they ventured deeper, Yvette found the King Dragon, High King over all the Reptiles, in a pool of its own blood. He was still alive however. Opening one of his eyes, the dragon spoke to Yvette in her mind through telepathy. "A human? What is your name, young one?" Yvette responded in kind by imagining the words in her head. "My name is Yvette." "I have not seen a human in a long time. The one who sees the Mysterious Unknown did this to me. He says the Sulka killed all the humans in this fair land. You're a human, so you should leave this place." With that, the dragon died. As Yvette, Sebastian, and his wife fled the fortress, the feeling of eyes continued to bear down on them, making them feel as though they were under some sort of scrutiny.
trackinfo.credits: from Box II, released November 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Colour
trackinfo.lyrics: As the party tried to escape the fortress, Sebastian suddenly disappeared. His wife, Mghel flapped her wings in surprise, and began to call out for him, to no avail. Suddenly, a strange crackly voice could be heard. "None of the Sulka are welcome in Dragös". A eerie low wind began to blow through the tunnels. Mghel cried out and looked at Yvette and spoke to her with her mind. "My husband! He's gone! What will we do?!" The wind became stronger, and soon it became difficult to move. As much as Yvette tried to go back deeper into the fortress, she couldn't move very far before being blown back. It was then she heard a voice in her head. "Run. Take Mghel with you." Suddenly, Yvette's head began to ache, and she collapsed on the ground. Mghel shrieked and tried to grip Yvette with her talons, spreading her wings hoping to ride the wind out of the fortress, However, the air current was too strong, and Mghel was blown out of Dragös, with the fortress doors closing behind her. As much as she clawed at the door, it wouldn't budge. There was no way around. Mghel was the last living thing in the land of Paradise, an eagle with no home or companions.
trackinfo.credits: from Box II, released November 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Covet
trackinfo.lyrics: Mghel flew for hours before nesting in a tree in the middle of the forest north of the wastelands where Dragös was. The feeling of eyes haunted the lone eagle, but she had learned to cope with it by now. She began to remember Teran, the High Queen that the Sulka had brought into Paradise, a now wretched wasteland. She had had three daughters - Ophelia, Natalie, and Yvette. Ophelia and Yvette were dead, but perhaps Natalie was still alive somewhere. And who was the father? All of these things perplexed Mghel, and she drifted off to sleep. The sun departed, and did not return by the time Mghel woke up. Where was the daylight? A voice in her head quickly answered her question. "Do you desire to see?" Mghel answered yes, but recieved no response.
trackinfo.credits: from Box II, released November 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Nor Will There Be Colour
trackinfo.lyrics: As Mghel found her way out of the forest, she looked around, realizing that there were still stars in the sky, and the sun was showing no indication that it would appear. She heard a voice, but it was fainter this time. She had no idea what to do, and the landscape was beginning to grow cold from the lack of sunlight.
trackinfo.credits: from Box II, released November 17, 2014

Zeffon.title: Box III
Zeffon.about:
When the world began to toss and creak, I knew the end was near. I was "born" in this world, but not by normal human means. I was created in the sense that my body was broken and reassembled as code. Who knows how many dimensions (including Earth) have been created this way. Nowadays, most of us look up to Dynamix16 as a way of knowing what is going on. Dynamix16, in our perspective, has never existed. They manifest themselves as the sky serpent Sol, which is never seen, but provides the sun for this world. If you imagine that even though the people of Ghel built Suntowers and Moontowers to create the day and night cycles, they never actually saw what the Dwellers of Earth call "The Sun". The moon was there, but the Sun never manifested itself as a blazing ball of fire. It was never more than ambient light, as if shrouded by a veil above Zeffon.
Speaking of Zeffon, if anyone reading this knows of Purgatory, Limbo, or any sort place where spirits go to wait, this is it. It feels like everyone is either insane or just empty, like they not only refuse to respond to you, but they seem to be soulless entities wandering about the world. However, Zeffon seems to be a little different from a more generic description of Purgatory. It seems it was once a world of happiness, but something infected the world and caused it to die. I've met very few people who would tell me otherwise.
One day however, after I was burned in an asylum on Earth, I met with Keliu, a member of Dynamix16 who gave me the information that I am describing to you now in a strange vision.
According to Keliu, I was the only member of the organization the I would be able to comprehend. He looked human to say the least. He told me that I was the rebirth of a human who originally existed with the sole purpose of stopping any sort of apocalyptic occurrence in the world of Zeffon. My name was not given to me on Earth, but I, according to Keliu, exist as Tereban in the world of Zeffon.
The previous form of Tereban was born five days before he became an adult. Naturally, he died quickly, but he was able to destroy Nightmare and Roanin quickly. The problem was that Roanin kept reappearing.
Of course, none of this made sense to me at the time. I was simply unable to understand what the relevance of this information was. Was I simply a robot? How did Roanin's presence affect Zeffon?

Zeffon.title: Burial Far From the Sea
Zeffon.about:
i. Instance: Eres
The next day, Cyane managed to make it to the top of the center of the island. The red soil made the terrain difficult to traverse, but he knew that he would make it up eventually. At the top of the mountain, Cyane gazed about the land around him. There was nothing but ocean beyond the isle as far as the eye could see. Given his isolated circumstances, Cyane went back to his shelter. Moving through the forest, he heard some groans of pain. After pushing through the dense foliage, Cyane encountered a woman with her foot stuck in a bear trap. The woman yelled for Cyane's help and Cyane obliged.
ii. Instance: Healing
"Thank you for your help, sir!" The woman cracked a smile, but quickly winced. Cyane helped the woman up and carried her over to the shelter that he had built the day before. Soon, the two had a fire burning on the beach.
"Again, thank you for your help, sir. I'd be dead if it wasn't for you!" The woman made a crooked smile and looked at her foot, which was mended with part of Cyane's sleeve.
iii. Instance: Omitages
"It feels better already!" Cyane remained silent. The woman seemed curious, but also seemed like she had an idea. It was closer than she thought.
iv. Colony / Mirror
That was Dream IX, or the ninth dream. Cyane knew that there was a anomaly in the way he had been dreaming lately. The other dreamers were in their hammocks, tucked away and trying not to think of the ongoing battles outside.
v. Dark Comet?
According to Tellh, there was a girl named Caria that recently came into Zeffon's second phase. She just appeared right there, in the middle of the square. She most likely had to overcome a few obstacles in her stay in between phases, as the god Pahhau was not the least bit merciful to "invaders".
vi. Citadel Icrifeani
Tellh came into the room and ushered Cyane out so he could talk to his superiors. In the meantime, Caria was being taken care of in a building in Ratayu. This is when she began to remember that she had a purpose. She had made a promise to her mother, that she would find a way to bring peace to Zeffon and get both of them out of the dimension for good.
vii. Giants Live in the Faraway Lands
Amidst the Battle of Uiiiegaaahrahh, many people in the town of Ratayu huddled in their homes, trying not to feel the effects of the awful ongoing war that raged in the lands beyond the massive desert. Although it was true that the war wasn't anywhere near Ratayu, it became clear that the war was causing a psychological effect on the townsfolk.
viii. House of the Rats, Pt. 2
The house of Yerrrrahhgroa was the only family in Zeffon's first phase that seemed to understand the extent of the Third Eye's power, even before he rose to his supreme being.
ix. Somehow
The use of their psychic abilities seemed to prove that. Their abilities rivaled even the psychic powers of the Isgas, or the Royal Family, as they are more well known. When the Third Eye rose to power, he called upon his followers to create the Mirror Throne, so many individuals could reflect upon the power that he had in his two hands.
x. The Mystery of the Barren Planet
The people began to wait around for the tenth dream, or Dream X. This one was said to resolve many of the problems that the people faced, and help them move through the Castle Yuuuorgahh, which lay in the distant sands, as well as give them resources to survive the ongoing battles.
xi. A Cry For Help
Nanciiigaeuu is the daughter of Raggoooh, and is in great peril, according to the documents that have been found on the outskirts of the town of Yuauauu. The town was invisible to the average person, and thus required the use of followers of the Third Eye to see.
xii. 29: Burn in the Sssssun
This was the time of Mauuuuagagg to shine. Given his ability to see past the enemy lines, it became crucial for him to continue to do so. The enemy was trying to burn him and his followers in the sun, but he would not let that happen.
xiii. Mirror Throne
With a wave of his hand, Mauuuuagagg continued to cast his enemies of the Third Eye aside, even though they were tough as forged steel. Eventually, Mauuuuagagg made it to the Castle of Yuaoao and began to find all the hostages that were kept in the ancient walls.
xiv. 25: Burial at Sea
It became clear after the battle that Mauuuuagagg was the leading participant. His armies never faltered. In the meantime, the Third Eye, for the first time in its life, seemed to be having difficulty. Many of the battles continued to rage, but the Third Eye had been gambling that he could win this one in particular.
xv. The Dragon Not So Distant
It became clear that the distant dragon began to creep closer to the Earth after a season...
