Zeffon.title: Castle Dränsilane
Zeffon.about:
i. Dead Souls
Wisps guide the way to the next destination. The concept of the ritual dream is a strange one indeed.
ii. Crystal Forest
The Crystal Forest was also known as Silver Forest, but the name “Crystal” referenced the large stones that grew in the center of it. The woods used to be a sacred place of healing, the same place where Archer Revenge once stood and proclaimed it as such. Several temples were littered about its interior, their names lost. The only temple that had a name that anyone knew of was the Sun Temple, or Temple of the Sun. It was under the control of a handful of different priests while it was still in its prime. These priests were some of the ones that had such despicable control over Unknown Iahae, the original composer of the Serenade for the Dead. As the wind continued to blow, Reve decided to move towards Castle Norfell. Her family would be there waiting for her.
~~~
Upon following a trial that some wisps laid out for her, Reve comes across the Crystal Forest. Within the boundaries, she gives Tereban a proper burial.
”I don’t know exactly who you are, but you saved me,” said Reve quietly.
The forest itself seems to be a lot different from the surrounding desolate landscape, like a sanctuary for those who seek it. Thinking about it a little more, Reve began to wonder whether this forest and the one on the southern part of Unkardia were connected. And for that matter, were the two islands connected in the past as well?
iii. Ocsania
On the way to Castle Norfell, Reve entered Heretmedel. However, after the Sharhodeon colonists arrived, they gave the ruined town the name Ocsania. The town never really was much to look at until the settlers made it into a port of commerce. Unkardia was an untapped land full of natural resources, and the Sharhodeon Territories knew it. Competing with the Kingdom of Lavu was not always easy, but at the capital of Lavu was destroyed by a giant dragon carrying a weapon of war in its talons. Thus, the Kingdom of Lavu was still recovering. It was before the 100 years ago when that occurred that Reve took her ritual dream in the Crystal Forest. It was quite an enlightening experience, and it helped shed some light on a couple of different things. Reve continued walking through the town. Though she was well known throughout the Unkardian land as royalty, most of the townsfolk in the village were Sharhodeon fishermen and miners. They didn’t know that she was normally feared. Then at last, Reve spotted her informant, but it was only after she got closer that she recognized who the person was.
“Adelais?”
Reve’s sister Adelais turned around. Somehow, she had managed to brave Du Garma Canyon to get to Ocsania.
“Reve! So you’ve finally woken up. Have you had a good nap?”
“Yes, more or less.”
“What did you find out?”
“Let’s discuss it once we get back to Castle Norfell.”
“Reve…”
“What?”
Adelais turned pale.
“Castle Norfell was attacked by three men. All of them used magic to encase our soldiers in ice in an instant. They went for the throne room. Dad, Dränsilane, and Emeroch managed to escape, but Mom, Lydia, and I were trapped. Then, out of the blue, a young swordsman came and wounded one of the attackers. I didn’t catch her name.”
“So why are you here? Did anyone survive?”
“Everyone did as far as I know. The attackers didn’t seem to want to kill the guards. I’m here search for our brothers and Dad.”
“Adelais, we need to go back to Castle Norfell. Let’s move through the canyon and get there before nightfall.”
iv. Glory
Isaac, another one of the Terror, was feeling rather anxious. He felt he needed to do something, but he wasn’t sure what it was. He quickly recalled after pacing around rather frequently. It was that boy Roanin that needed to be found. He was a strange boy, that one. He was the son of Rowland, the first Governor of Lavu. Of course, Isaac wouldn’t have known what Lavu was if he hadn’t traversed the Putrid Sea in his past. The Putrid Sea was generally treacherous, but that one day, it just suddenly opened as if in a dream, and he was able to cross into the abyss that lay beyond. The Chaoslands were and interesting place to be sure. When he crossed the ocean and landed in Icrifeani though, he had something else in mind besides looking for Roanin. He had to visit the Kingdom of Lavu itself in order to save the world. He knew that although he was not the strongest of anyone he had ever met (he was a bit of coward), he knew what had to be done. Tereban gazed in the direction of Anne. If he were able to see miles, he could see its scraggly coast, full of dark, pointy rocks jutting out of the coast and the cliff sides. Apparently, Lydia had gone there to do some work with her brothers. Although Dränsilane and Emeroch had once ruled with some integrity, they had lost sight of what was truly important.
v. Across the Plains
Dränsilane and Emeroch’s joint reign was not a pretty one. Taxes were high, starvation was also incredibly common. Plagues would rip through the resident town of Cathrop, while the brothers sat like kings in their own strongholds. Eventually, the people rebelled, not just to save themselves, but also prove that they were not to be stepped on by their leaders. They soon invaded the castles and walled the brothers up in their own rooms, condemned to never emerge alive. Archer Revenge also met doom at the hands of the villagers of Cathrop. When he visited Anne, the people accused him of neglecting their colony and misusing his powers of omnipotence. Regardless of the fact that Archer only commanded an army of thirty, he also had command over a mystical power known as “Darko”. People feared him because of this, but due to the desperation and anger that he caused the villagers, he was unable to stand against their own power. The day Archer Revenge died became known as “The Day of Glory”. While the villagers rioted, Archer Revenge managed to come back to life. How he managed such a feat was unknown, but nevertheless, he returned. People began to panic in Cathrop, since the prospect of vengeance seemed imminent. Attacks on regular citizens began to occur, as other citizens fought over shelter from the imminent attack. It was when a ghost descended from the two castles in the mountains that the people were forced to make peace. The ghost claimed to be that of the then-late Dränsilane, and by using the magic that he possessed, he temporarily paralyzed the movement that was destroying the main town. The townspeople suddenly became more passive.
~~~
Reve, after her asking around is approached by a man.
”Hello, do you need something, sir?” she asks.
”Actually, yes. Are you the one who’s asking around if you’re in Ocsania?”
”Why…?”
”You are truly?! Oh happy days! Please, come with me!”
The Isga brothers weren’t always evil. According to an obscure legend, there was once a horrible, horrible winter that struck. The Isga brothers, along with the King, Queen, and their sisters were in the castle. Suddenly, the guards suddenly dropped dead to what was assumed to be some sort of psychic power. Three demons then advanced into the throne room. They were Arc-Demai. However, the King, the Queen, and the two brothers escaped into a secret passage near one of the columns in the throne room, leaving the three sisters behind. According to the legend, the brothers were cursed for abandoning their sisters in their time of need in order to save their own skins. In fact, the King died exactly seven days after the escape. The Queen would later return and find no sign of her daughters or her step-daughter. The harsh winter would later kill Queen Mathilda, who died without knowing if any of her sons or daughters were still alive.
”If you’re asking around, and, if my calculations are correct, you must be Reve.”
”What if I am?”
”Well, there’s no need to be nervous about it. We’ve been tracking your various movements across time, and we have come to the conclusion that we should entrust a certain item to you.”
”Movements across time?”
”You’ve gone back to this time a total amount of 513 times if I remember correctly…”
Reve suddenly remembered. Her dream self had mentioned something to that extent.
”We need you to help us with a certain issue that has happened in Rasoe. Since you and Tereban are experienced, we’d like you to aid us.”
”Sir, Tereban’s dead.”
The man appeared to be shocked.
”Are you… Are you serious…? We’ve… we are no more then.”
He sat down, as if he was trying to grasp the gravity of the situation. Tereban seemed to be of a large amount of importance to this man.
”What’s going on? Who are you…?
”Reve… I mean, whoever you are, I really can’t explain. We may be being watched. In any case, I need you to help a party of men defend a town from an unknown beast. Here, take this sword I was going to entrust to you. It will hopefully aid you on your journey.”
vi. Rasoe Bell Tower
When Reve arrived from Ocsania with Adelais, Lydia was missing. The castle was cold with snow, as all the windows had been broken in some sort of attack. Reve quickly dashed into the throne room. “Mother!” she called. After searching, she found no trace of Queen Mathilda. It was only after she reached the Queen’s chambers that she saw the slightest trace of blood. It was on the carpet and it wasn’t much, but a thin trail of it led to a wall. Upon knocking on the wall a few times, it gave in, allowing Reve to follow a secret staircase to the lower levels. The stench of bodies soon became apparent, and at the very bottom of the steps, there was a fairly expansive room. It was like the throne room, but Reve had never seen it before. On the left, there were two seats, covered in years of dust. At the foot of the stairs leading up to these thrones, there was a ragged red carpet that led all the way to two doors at the right. Quickly wiping away the cobwebs, Reve drew her sword and looked about the walls. There were no human remains in this place, despite the dark appearance. Surely there must’ve been someone here. Looking at the dust on the faded carpet at her feet, Reve could make out footprints.
“How did you get in here…?” said a voice.
Adelais approached from behind Reve, looking paler than the full moon.
“Adelais! What’s going on? What is this?”
Adelais didn’t respond. Instead, she quickly drew her sword and lunged at her sister. Reve was prepared for this, however. After a quick parry, Reve stabbed Adelais through the stomach and kicked her to the dusty ground. Holding her gleaming blade against Adelais’ neck, she spoke in harsh tones to her dying sister.
“You wretch! What made you think you could just come and take my kingdom away from me while I was asleep?!”
Adelais coughed and moaned but had no answer.
“I should just kill you right now, sister…” Reve said to herself. She thought about it briefly, but then decided against it. It was odd. Something in her head was telling her to resist the temptation. Well, whatever. Leaving Adelais to her death by keeping her in this hidden room was much more satisfying anyway. Suddenly, a familiar scent drifted into Reve’s nostrils. It was one that she feared.
“I leave you to your death, Adelais!” Reve said hastily as she ran up the stairs out of the room. Adelais had no words for Reve. It pained her greatly that she could not speak to her sister in the way that she normally could. As the light disappeared due to the closing door above, Adelais knew for certain that she would die down here.
~~~
Another legend is the one of the demon that haunted the Rasoe Bell Tower. The demon, supposedly the decaying angel of the late Queen Mathilda, came to torment the town. But just as it arrived, it was struck down by a woman clad in chain mail, calling herself Reve. Later on, the Decaying Angel would return, this time cursing the entire population to only appear in the light of a full moon. Remarkably, the Decaying Angel would be challenged another 514 times, all by a woman named Reve. Although the Decaying Angel took some victories, after the 514th time, it appeared that the beast was slain for good. Reve wasn’t sure about this. She had been trusting too many random people. Though she had a sense of who all of them were, she wasn’t entirely confident regarding their identities. Ooh, if only she could remember! She kept trusting them however. That’s the only thing she could do, since time had been manipulated so many times. But enough was enough. Here was the town of Rasoe. It seemed rather empty, with not a single person to be found. The bell tower was still ringing though, and a lot of the other men were starting to show signs of anxiety. Reve wondered what could be up there, since there was no wind. The sound of the bell wasn’t that pretty either. A certain smell filled the air as they began to climb to the top of the bell tower. It wasn’t quite a rotting smell, but it was close. A chill went down Reve’s spine.
vii. On The Roof
Reve descended from the tower, trying to gain control of her senses. She could hear frogs croaking, and the smell of decaying flesh had become overpowering. This couldn’t be happening now! A voice began to mutter ominously in her brain, telling her to quit resisting. The host and already begun to separate from its parasite. Reve was slammed onto the floor and watched as another figure began to manifest itself in front of her. It was a strange being, one in torment. It let out a loud scream and sprouted decaying wings, moving swiftly out of Castle Norfell. As for Reve, she was now just an empty shell, incapable of thinking or feeling.
~~~
A malevolent presence was in the air. Reve told the men to stay on their guard. The smell was getting stronger.
viii. Decaying Angel
Suddenly, a large flying zombie attacks the party. Many of the men are pushed off the roof. However, Reve clings to the railing, determined to stay in the battle. As the beast came around for a second strike, Reve held up the sword that the strange man gave her, catching the zombie in the stomach and slicing a long gash through the length of its abdomen as it flew by.
ix. Do Without It
As is apparent, time and time again, history had repeated itself. When Roanin Meylith was born, he was born with a special gift. His father, Rowland Meylith, was not of the world commonly referred to as Earth. Although he had been at one point, he was not now. In the past as a boy, Rowland had befriended a certain man who had been experimented upon by Félix Oarr. His name was only something he came up with, and he didn’t seem to recall his real name. The man introduced himself as “Dr. Uy”. Although the young Rowland had heard of this man through the wanted posters that were plastered all over Blueheart, he decided to make friends with the strange man. He was starving, Dr. Uy had food, and he had no other friends anyway. It was after a day or so that Dr. Uy revealed that he had been destined to be the one to speak with the gods. When Félix Oarr found out, he and the rest of the Windy Summit made an effort to extract through scientific means.
x. I Can’t Shake Him
Reve and the men quickly made it back to Ocsania by nightfall under the order of the strange man. Upon reaching the man’s compound, Reve and the man enter a room to have a discussion about the current state of things. The man does everything in his power to seal all the doors and windows.
”Now that that’s over with…”
The man sat down. “Let’s begin, shall we? As you may know, you have been sent back in time 513 times as part of a loop in time that is currently occurring for the 514th time. In order to break this loop, you need to preserve everything in your memory that I will discuss now.”
”What’s that?”
”You were born to a very important person in the future. This person was a ruler of the Kingdom of the Pathiers, better known as the Kingdom of Lavu.”
xi. Castle Dränsilane
One of the most prominent legends in all of Unkardia and Anne is the legend of the Human Overmind. Although it is speculated that it began with the Isga brothers, the idea is that some humans plague others by just existing. It was later hypothesized that each human represents a cell in a larger omnipotent being call the Human Overmind. However, just like the Isgas, cells of this Human Overmind can psychically “fuse together” and form hostile organisms that destroy the rest of the cells. These beings, once they become complex enough, sporting about fifty human souls or so, become hypothetical parasites, called “human bradyzoites”, and manifest themselves in the real world as distorted, dark, corrupted beings.
~
”It started when a young boy was seduced into thinking that he could rule all of the world by himself. Disillusioned by the death of his parents, he sought to find his way to a place known as the end of time. That place is a little east of here, right where Tereban was taking you before the ship you were on was destroyed: Anne. Due to the properties of Anne, anyone who travels to the island causes time to flow faster and faster until it reaches a point of infinity. Thus, anyone who travels too close to the island ages faster and faster until they die. But the boy somehow made it. It was here he met two ancient monarchs, one by the name of Emeroch, the other by the name of Dränsilane. The two had been walled up in their castles by the townsfolk of Cathrop, who had then escaped the island. Bit by bit, the two monarchs of the house of Isga began to die. But Dränsilane escaped, chipping at the walls bit by bit, moving to Castle Emeroch to save his brother.”

trackinfo.lyrics: viii. Decaying Angel  Suddenly, a large flying zombie attacks the party. Many of the men are pushed off the roof. However, Reve clings to the railing, determined to stay in the battle. As the beast came around for a second strike, Reve held up the sword that the strange man gave her, catching the zombie in the stomach and slicing a long gash through the length of its abdomen as it flew by.
trackinfo.credits: from Castle Dränsilane, released February 20, 2011

trackinfo.title: Do Without It
trackinfo.lyrics: ix. Do Without It As is apparent, time and time again, history had repeated itself. When Roanin Meylith was born, he was born with a special gift. His father, Rowland Meylith, was not of the world commonly referred to as Earth. Although he had been at one point, he was not now. In the past as a boy, Rowland had befriended a certain man who had been experimented upon by Félix Oarr. His name was only something he came up with, and he didn’t seem to recall his real name. The man introduced himself as “Dr. Uy”. Although the young Rowland had heard of this man through the wanted posters that were plastered all over Blueheart, he decided to make friends with the strange man. He was starving, Dr. Uy had food, and he had no other friends anyway. It was after a day or so that Dr. Uy revealed that he had been destined to be the one to speak with the gods. When Félix Oarr found out, he and the rest of the Windy Summit made an effort to extract through scientific means.
trackinfo.credits: from Castle Dränsilane, released February 20, 2011

trackinfo.title: I Can't Shake Him
trackinfo.lyrics: x. I Can’t Shake Him Reve and the men quickly made it back to Ocsania by nightfall under the order of the strange man. Upon reaching the man’s compound, Reve and the man enter a room to have a discussion about the current state of things. The man does everything in his power to seal all the doors and windows. ”Now that that’s over with…” The man sat down. “Let’s begin, shall we? As you may know, you have been sent back in time 513 times as part of a loop in time that is currently occurring for the 514th time. In order to break this loop, you need to preserve everything in your memory that I will discuss now.” ”What’s that?” ”You were born to a very important person in the future. This person was a ruler of the Kingdom of the Pathiers, better known as the Kingdom of Lavu.”
trackinfo.credits: from Castle Dränsilane, released February 20, 2011

trackinfo.title: Castle Dränsilane
trackinfo.lyrics: xi. Castle Dränsilane One of the most prominent legends in all of Unkardia and Anne is the legend of the Human Overmind. Although it is speculated that it began with the Isga brothers, the idea is that some humans plague others by just existing. It was later hypothesized that each human represents a cell in a larger omnipotent being call the Human Overmind. However, just like the Isgas, cells of this Human Overmind can psychically “fuse together” and form hostile organisms that destroy the rest of the cells. These beings, once they become complex enough, sporting about fifty human souls or so, become hypothetical parasites, called “human bradyzoites”, and manifest themselves in the real world as distorted, dark, corrupted beings. ~ ”It started when a young boy was seduced into thinking that he could rule all of the world by himself. Disillusioned by the death of his parents, he sought to find his way to a place known as the end of time. That place is a little east of here, right where Tereban was taking you before the ship you were on was destroyed: Anne. Due to the properties of Anne, anyone who travels to the island causes time to flow faster and faster until it reaches a point of infinity. Thus, anyone who travels too close to the island ages faster and faster until they die. But the boy somehow made it. It was here he met two ancient monarchs, one by the name of Emeroch, the other by the name of Dränsilane. The two had been walled up in their castles by the townsfolk of Cathrop, who had then escaped the island. Bit by bit, the two monarchs of the house of Isga began to die. But Dränsilane escaped, chipping at the walls bit by bit, moving to Castle Emeroch to save his brother.”
trackinfo.credits: from Castle Dränsilane, released February 20, 2011

Zeffon.title: Catoblepas
Zeffon.about:
i. Gloomy Night Streets
Catoblepas is an album representing the uneasiness of the Kingdom of Lavu and the eventual public assassination of a murderer. Sharhodeon is undergoing political turmoil, but Lavu and their ally, the Seraph Territories rest easy. However, within Lavu's poorer southern district, in the town of Blueheart, an unknown assassin is wandering around, keeping the public on their toes. The secret police have nothing on him except a photo that was anonymously submitted to their headquarters via the mail. It features a somewhat well-dressed man with his back turned, a trumpet in his left hand, and a knife in his right...
The first murder attributed to this man was committed when a man by the name of Joren Luck was attending an appointment with a doctor by the name of Dr. Uy. When Joren didn't return to his home, the police entered the office, only to find Joren lying on the floor. His wrists were slit and Dr. Uy was nowhere to be seen. A state-sponsored funeral fit for a hero is held the next day in order to raise awareness regarding this man. Later, the police receive the infamous picture.
A private detective with the code name Roy is assigned to the case and does some research at the capitol building in Lavu. Since no one has ever seen this man, despite the ongoing investigation, Roy assumes that the mysterious assassin may be taking advantage of a recent discovery - the possibility of another dimension. If the assassin can slip in between the dimensional fabric of space, it would allow the perpetrator to escape the scene undetected. While looking carefully through the texts, a man brings Roy his lunch - a simple beef sandwich. Biting into it, Roy makes a painful discovery in the form of a poisoned sewing needle in his food and is quickly rendered unconscious.
After Roy is hospitalized, investigators find a note in the sandwich that reads, "Du Omerideöth". "Du Omerideöth was the old name for Castle Adelais, ruins that the government began excavating despite public disapproval. The note leads investigators to believe that the attack is politically motivated. While desperately scouring around for clues, new information arrives - The assassin has been identified and will be playing at a club in Blueheart. His name is Samuel Cathrop.
The gloom of the Blueheart streets has always held some sort of foreboding atmosphere. After O23 was destroyed by Creator using the power of the Bell of Noor and the Magot Tower, Dr. Uy and Creator had a falling out, and Creator destroyed his empire on Exeräise due to the residual effects of using the cursed bell. Creator then retreated back to the Kingdom of Lavu, where he took on a new name: Rowland Meylith. Being the deity he was, he quickly gained seat No. 1 in the Kingdom’s luxurious government. However, all was not well.
ii. Breathe Deeply
Although no one knew the identity of the soon-to-be murderer of Blueheart, Rowland knew very well of the intentions of his former associate. He didn’t warn anyone, though. It was never from malice or depression, just simple neglect that caused the murders to occur. A letter, meant for Governor No. 1 himself was submitted via the mail, but it never reached Rowland. The letter, although brief, described a particular gas attack that was to be released by means of three chlorine canisters in Blueheart. The secret police quickly foiled the insidious plot by removing the gas cans from the alleyway in which they were placed. The only other thing included was a old photograph of a man with his back turned. He held a knife in one hand, and a trumpet in the other. Signed on the reverse side was the phrase “Breathe Deeply”. However, only the top executives of the secret police had the picture and letter package. The street patrols knew nothing of it.
iii. Client
The first murder attributed to this man was committed when another man by the name of Joren Luck was attending an appointment with a doctor by the name of Dr. Uy. When Joren didn't return to his home, the police entered the office, only to find Joren lying on the floor. His wrists were slit and Dr. Uy was nowhere to be seen. Bloody footprints of someone in dress shoes led outside of the compound, but were washed away by the rain.
iv. Memoriam
A state-sponsored funeral fit for a hero is held the next day in order to raise awareness regarding this man. Later, the lower-ranking police receive the infamous picture.
v. Éblouissement
A private detective with the code name Roy is assigned to the case and does some research at the capitol building in Lavu. Since no one has ever seen this man, despite the ongoing investigation, Roy assumes that the mysterious assassin may be taking the advantage of another dimension. If the assassin can slip in between the dimensional fabric of space, it would allow the perpetrator to escape the scene undetected. While looking carefully through the texts, a man brings Roy his lunch - a simple beef sandwich. Biting into it, Roy makes a painful discovery in the form of a poisoned sewing needle in his food and is quickly rendered unconscious.
vi. Arrogant Piece No. 131
After Roy is hospitalized, investigators find a note in the sandwich that reads, "Du Omerideöth". "Du Omerideöth was the old name for Castle Adelais, ruins that the government began excavating despite public disapproval. The note leads investigators to believe that the attack is politically motivated. While desperately scouring around for clues, new information arrives - The assassin has been identified and will be playing at a club in Blueheart. His name is Samuel Cathrop.
vii. Du Omerideöth
A sting is set up to capture Samuel Cathrop, but there are some at the police station who doubt the legitimacy of the information. Meanwhile, using the best medical attention that the Kingdom has to offer, the detective Roy is out of bed within three days of the staff neutralizing the poison in his body. He heads off to Castle Adelais in order to find some more legitimate clues regarding the true identity of Dr. Uy.
viii. Shadowplay
Despite being in the chaos and confusion that covers the land after the apocalyptic events that nearly destroyed it, Kerragan Cathrop is contacted Rowland Meylith. Rowland wishes to make Kerragan one of the rulers of the Kingdom of Lavu. Rowland, knowing Kerragan’s true identity as Emeroch Isga, decides to ally him to the Kingdom in order to make use of his power. Of course, before this occurred, I talked with Emeroch, telling him about the more refined Instinct technology that was available there, technology that would allow the both of us to reach 100% Instinct and survive.
ix. Madflÿ
It was possible I thought, that Dr. Uy already knew about this, and was seeking the same thing. On the night of the performance, Samuel Cathrop was nearly captured. He narrowly escaped, using the methods Roy predicted he would use, escaping into a dimensional rift and reappearing at least a mile outside Blueheart. Catching that man was going to be impossible if the police didn’t have my help. Completely impossible.

Zeffon.title: Chagrin
Zeffon.about:
i. The Legend and Legacy
Chagrin is the fifth of the prophetic dream sequences experienced by Kerragan. The album shows the Seraph Territories (in between the Kingdom of Lavu and the Sharhodeon Territories) expressing embarrassment over using chemicals to reanimate corpses. Or so they say.
In the abandoned town of Dragös, there is a way to travel back in time. In the labyrinths below it, there are rooms full of treasure, gold and other things. At the very bottom of Dragös is an entrance to the Temple of Faces, a large network of tunnels and caverns. But to access this Temple, you need the key to the door. The key itself is hidden amongst the treasure. Now get moving. I need your help with this. You have six days.
ii. Great Beyond
And so, I sent him off. He was a dependable man, but I wasn’t sure about how dependable. So far, I still exist, so he couldn’t have gone back in time quite yet. Four days have passed through this horrid, tainted air and I have not felt the time flux. Perhaps it is time to give up…
iii. Anthem For The Lost
”He’s lost, Creator.”
”Your vision of becoming truly immortal is clearly out of your reach.”
”Why do you even try?”
I’m fed up with this world. This world, ruled by my master. I want to make a new world where everyone could live in peace, one that is not destined to end.
”Is that why you sounded so harsh?”
I needed to be firm. Roanin is a dependable young man who can pull this off given the right instruction and motivation. I’m sure of it.
“I see…”
”So Félix Oarr is an agent for D23? I doubt that.”
Just stop bothering me, please…
iv. Reunion
Roanin continued on towards through the trees. Suddenly he saw the spirits of his parents, guiding him. Opehla and Rowland pointed Roanin in the direction of a strange cathedral. It looked like it had been abandoned for some time, the ceiling crumbling, and moss growing amongst the seats for the congregation.
v. Exodus of the Seraph
It then occurred to Roanin that there was a reason why he was feeling obligated to continue to get lost in the forest. He could remember a little, but not much. It was all a little too hazy. He decided to continue deeper into the woods, hoping that somehow, he could satisfy this internal urge to accomplish something. Then he saw it. A man, lying down in the leaves. Or at least, that’s what it looked like. Upon closer inspection, this man was missing both of his forearms, which had been roughly cut off. The blood caking the ground below the man was dry, so Roanin could only assume the man was dead. Upon even further examination, the man had the crest of the ancient Royal Family on his stained clothes. He was an Isga! But how did this corpse wind up in Unkardia if Castle Dränsilane was across the ocean on Anne? Maybe he was traveling, and some sort of argument took place with a stranger? A rustle from the leaves filled Roanin with fear, but he nevertheless continued on his wayward path deep into the forest.
vi. Chagrin
The vines seemed to move around him and the birds became fainter and fainter…

Zeffon.title: Chaosfoundry
Zeffon.about:
i. Ghost Ship
People are cruel. Or the universe, for that matter. Whether it was bad luck, cruelty, or the universe was simply drunk was debatable, but one thing was certain: Something was keen on setting the hopes of humanity high, and then taking the same group for a spin. In the oldest of days, a ship was created by unknown forces called the Ghost Ship. This ship would later be harnessed and tamed by the wild and great Archer Revenge, who would cruise the world, and do all sorts of things that adept and professional adventurers could only dream of. The original purpose of the Ghost Ship however, was to escort the Bride of Ryan to Unkardia. Ryan was a great ruler and many adored his admirable looks, which apparently bestowed him with good luck as well. It may have been because of this winning streak that Ryan was destined to lose. When it was announced that Ryan was searching the lands of Unkardia for a bride, a mysterious ship with no crew aboard brought a young woman named Yvonne to the shores near Castle Ineje, what would later be named Castle Norfell. The two fell instantly in love and were married within a week. It seemed too good to be true. Meanwhile, the Ghost Ship disappeared.
~
The Ghost Ship would live on in legend as the ship of Archer Revenge, also renamed as the Archer Revenge. Archer however, was both the first and the last man with the ability to commandeer such a finicky vessel. After Archer’s murder at the hands of the people of Cathrop, the Archer Revenge disappeared yet again. Some say that it still haunts the water around Anne and takes out any vessel who dares venture towards Archer’s grave. Because of the inter dimensional properties of the Archer Revenge, the ship was still able to attack a small vessel holding Tereban and Reve, despite Reve being “behind the mirror”.
ii. Take No Prisoners
Ryan was a great two handed swordsman. Him and his bastard sword were seen throughout all the land as the best combination of skill, wit, and proficiency that the land had ever seen. Some viewed this with envy, however. One day, a man named Aed came and challenged Ryan to a duel. Aed had been training for years and years, and was finally ready to meet Ryan at an appropriate climax in order to further his training and become the best in the land. However, when Ryan won anyway, Aed threw a dagger in Ryan’s direction, nearly hitting and potentially killing him. With that, Ryan beat Aed within an inch of his life in his own fit of rage. Aed lived the rest of his life in recluse, along with his horse. Thus, the legend of the rider of Inejeheim was born. According to the villagers in Inejeheim, a raider supposed to be the tormented husk that was Aed rode through the blighted night of every 27th day of the 7th month, following 13 years after he had been defeated. On the fourth year, Ryan was waiting for him. A shadow rode up on a black horse when the sun disappeared on the horizon, and before Ryan could do anything, several houses were ablaze, the ghost shooting fire magic in various directions. Upon seeing Ryan however, the horse reared and fled with its rider, with Ryan in hot pursuit. Eventually, Ryan caught up as the horse had stopped in the Autumn Grove. The ghost removed its cloudy veil of shadow, revealing its true form as the recluse Aed. One sword fight later, Aed again found himself at Ryan’s knees, this time at his ever-dwindling mercy. Aed then took the dagger he had thrown at Ryan 17 years earlier and stabbed himself in the gut. According to legend, the dagger had been tainted with Aed’s treachery, and, upon touching him, turned him to stone. Aed didn’t leave Ryan without cursing him first, however. And this is where the tale of the Instinct comes in.
~
According to Unkardian lore, the soul of Aed was unable to rest after his second humiliating defeat at Ryan’s hands. And thus, after Ryan had left the grove, he fused his soul with the soul of his horse. His horse haunted the grove around Rasoe ever since. Supposedly immortal, the horse stalks the forest, searching for the children of Ryan’s ever-thinning bloodline, turning them against the population of Unkardia. After receiving Aed’s soul, the horse became able to use some techniques that wouldn’t have normally been possible. One of those things was the ability to talk. However, this is strange to consider. After Aed was nearly beaten to death in Ryan’s fit of rage, he received injuries to his throat that kept him from speaking ever again.
iii. Ambush and Tragic Serenades
In Unkardian lore, the Decaying Angel is supposedly the hideous winged corpse of the late Queen Mathilda, tormented by the loss of her children following the attack on Castle Norfell from the three Arc-Demai. However, if one considers the possibility that one of the three Arc-Demai is the Decaying Angel of Rasoe, then Mathilda can hardly be the culprit behind the curse of the Rasoe Bell Tower. In fact, it is told that the Decaying Angel came way before her time.
~
In the wake of the legend of the Rider of Inejeheim, a new curse began to afflict the blighted swordsman. He had enormous pain in his back, and soon he was on the floor, crying out to the heavens. Doctors were perplexed. It seemed as though something was trying to grow out of his back, judging by the two knobs that had appeared between his shoulder blades. It was later that night that the servants assigned to clean Ryan’s room found that he was missing. The window was open, and a ghastly smell filled the air about his bedchamber. Rushing to the window, the servants looked down at the rocks below, thinking Ryan had committed suicide by jumping. Fortunately, there was no sign of his battered corpse on the sharp rocks. In fact, Ryan was still alive. But just barely so. When the sun had departed the skies above Rasoe, a flying zombie (the Decaying Angel) landed on the bell tower and began to ring the bell. The Bell of Amma was considered the holy treasure of the town, as it had been inherited by from the Temple of the Sun, which had had it crafted in a faraway land by a people known as the Uaa. Before the relic had been destroyed, a woman clad in chain mail dispatched the evil beast and began to leave the town without saying a word. Before she was gone, she mentioned her name, and then departed forever. The Decaying Angel lost its right hand in the battle against the female swordsman, and was swiftly burned where it had landed. According to legend, the sun did not rise until every part of the Decaying Angel had been consumed by the flames. It was then that Ryan was found in his bedroom, covered in blood and missing his right hand. No one knew about these unusual circumstances initially, but Ryan knew that someone was out to destroy everything he had worked for: a ghost of someone else, long since dead.
iv. Remnants of Seasons
The ghost that had guided the man into Castle Dränsilane is surprised to find that they have been followed.
”What are you doing here?!”
The man turned around. A woman stood in the doorway of the chamber, carrying a two-handed sword with only her right hand. She was tall, skinny, and very beautiful.
”I’ve come to dispatch you, Emeroch. Did your brother tell you that it would be an easy job to con Gaine here into reproducing that so-called “time loop”?”
“You have no idea what you’re talking about, you. Gaine has arrived here on his own accord, preparing to become one of many great rulers to come.”
”Ha. Your obvious cowardice works against your confidence.”
Gaine looked nervously in both directions. If there was going to be a fight here, he didn’t want to be part of it.
”Gaine…”
Gaine turned to look at the ghost of Emeroch Isga.
”You poor young man. If you can trust me, I can grant you courage, your kingdom, and the ability to speak again. You’ve been mute since birth, but no longer…”
”Stop it!” yelled the woman. “You’re not fooling anyone!”
Unfortunately for Gaine, the promises that the ghost of Isga gave to him were too tempting to pass up. With that, Gaine took Emeroch’s hand, fusing his body and soul with Emeroch’s soul, creating a new being that took on the name Kerragan Cathrop, seemingly out of some sort of divine inspiration, but would later be revealed to have been in the plans of the Isgas all along. A fight ensued, and the woman, not used to wielding the two-handed bastard sword, was left in a pool of her own blood by the time the fight had finished. Kerragan left the scene and encountered two other men. One man seemed familiar to Kerragan’s former self, and instead of killing the pair, Kerragan fled. The pair of men rushed down to the bottom of the castle after navigating the treacherous maze of staircases and hallways, but upon reaching the room with the body of their leader, she was dead.
”Miss Lyeon!” said Stephane was great difficulty.
The other man looked at the corpse with tears welling in his eyes. They had lost her once. Then a mysterious man came and saved the other man from both his injuries and his illness, while informing them that Miss Lyeon was still alive. He gave them passage to Anne on his boat, narrowly dodging salvos fired by a ghost ship, and then they made it to the chamber at the bottom of Castle Dränsilane, only to find that their leader had bled out. This was a sad day indeed. Rest in peace, dear Reve Terra Lyeon…
~
Aed’s Curse, present in his dagger, his horse, and pretty much the entire island of Unkardia affected everyone who lived there for years to come, even after the Sharhodeon Territories came seeking to annex the stricken land as one of their own territories. Later, a group of men representing the Sharhodeon Territories would travel to Rasoe and would fall 513 times. The leader would sometimes survive, but the men lost that day would turn the Sharhodeon Territories against their colony, and soon they would cut off any further communications. Despite having successfully chased the invaders away, the Curse of Aed, which became better known by another name, knew no bounds. There were still Sharhodeon soldiers stranded in Ocsania. Then, the Curse began to develop a mind of its own, becoming a strange unknown beast. It was the night after the Unknown Beast’s completion that Ocsania simply disappeared and became suspended in Limbo. Yet, the Unknown Beast was not satisfied. It craved for the destruction of mankind itself. After destroying Ocsania, the Unknown Beast managed to find the Village of the Uaa, the residents being some of the first humans to collaborate on the face of the Earth. A few of the Uaa knew this was coming too. After helping the Travelers from Far Away create the Bell of Amma (and partially create the curse as well), the holiness of the first bell caused a second one to form out of the spare darkness that the Bell of Amma left over. This bell was named the Bell of Noor, and was in fact the bell that was given to Unkardia and the leader of the small, but proud Temple of the Sun instead of the supposed “holy bell” that they had received. The Uaa were told by their prophets that they themselves should be the ones to deal with the Bell of Noor, since it was their creation, and not the fault of an innocent people. The Uaa who peddled the bell off to the Unkardians did not listen, however. They lacked the foresight to see how that could come back and bite them. Luckily, by giving away the Bell of Noor, they still had the Bell of Amma. Sadly, they did not use it during their battle, since they had grown so headstrong, so prideful, that they believed the deities that they themselves had created would save them from the death the surely awaited them. However, there was still a part of the Unknown Beast that was light. The small part of Aed that had felt remorse for his actions was still present in the monster. This light part was drawn to the Bell of Amma, hidden away in the Uaa Ruins. With that, the Unknown Beast split in two, its infernal blood falling to the ground like rain. The smaller light part of the Unknown Beast fused with the Bell of Amma. The larger dark part fused with the Bell of Noor, still hanging in the Rasoe Bell Tower. Thus, when the two parts, or the two bells are brought close together, legend says that the Unknown Beast will be reborn.
v. Elements of a Curious Demeanor
It was only when the older man and Stephane brought the corpse of Reve to the surface that they realized something: there was still a chance the Reve was still alive somewhere. She had gone “behind the mirror”, a phrase used by the people of the Large Continent to describe going to another dimension. Though she had been in the other dimension and returned, it was possible Stephane suggested, because the glass had suddenly shattered, that her adventure in the other dimension was on “pause”, meaning if they could by chance find another Rift with the same dimension in it, they would be able to find another instance of their leader. It wouldn’t be easy though. The thought of trying to look at every reflective surface in a hope that it would spawn a Rift by chance (and the right one for that matter) seemed impossible. Clearly some work would need to be done. Or so it seemed. Just as the weight of the task began falling on their shoulders, the same man appeared. The one that had cured the older man.
”Hello, Lloyd,” said the man.
”Hello, Tereban,” said Lloyd with some eagerness. “I never got to thank you properly for healing me…”
”The pleasure is all mine. I dedicated the rest of my life to the purpose, you know.”
”Excuse me, sir,” said Stephane, stepping in, “Is there a way you can revive Miss Lyeon? She…”
”Is dead?”
”Yes.”
”Unfortunately, I cannot revive someone who has already passed away…”
”Oh.” Stephane seemed crushed. Reve was like a mother figure to the boy.
”However,” continued Tereban, “There is someone who can…”
Stephane began to tear up again.
”Out of curiosity, why is it so important…? Despite the fact that someone died, why do you need to revive Miss Lyeon?”
”There’s been a change of plans in the Terra Operative, Tereban,” Lloyd said with some amount of urgency. “The Terra Operative has been dedicated to…”
”…keeping the peace, I know,” finished Tereban. “I’ve explored the world for a while. I get the general idea surrounding your group.”
”Mr. Tereban, have you heard of a man named Félix Oarr?”
”Yes, he’s governor No. 8 of Lavu.”
”And his experiments…?”
“Unfortunately.”
Lloyd bit his lip. Tereban didn’t seem to be getting the idea, and he didn’t want to mention what he was about to say, in case Creator was watching. Creator of course, was the leader of the curious civilization that was on the continent of Exeräise. That person could listen in on whatever he pleased with the help of the Magot Tower. The grim and disgusting mass of limbs haphazardly assembled into an altar gave Creator the power to see all and know all. But it wasn’t necessarily the tower itself. The Terra Operative had always thought that the tower was used to appease something below the surface, something that could give Creator the information he wanted. Still, he had to be open with Tereban if he wanted his help.
”Have… Have you ever heard of Derek Unmattias?”
The wind abruptly changed direction. Tereban looked very solemn, then began to walk away, beckoning that the others follow him.
vi. Chaosfoundry
”They know. That slimy civilization and their cronies, they know. It’s best we revive him.”
~
In the time of Ryan, his wife Yvonne began to act suspiciously. She seemed to be drawn to Ryan’s bastard sword like a moth towards light. Every evening around the time the sun would disappear on the horizon, she could be seen observing the sword in its case and pedestal. Ryan rarely used the sword now, due to the sudden loss and disappearance of his right hand. But he couldn’t help but notice Yvonne’s odd behavior. One night, after he couldn’t stand it any longer, Ryan went to his wife and demanded to know what she was doing. Yvonne looked in Ryan’s direction, but looked like she was dreaming. When Ryan put his hand on her left shoulder, Yvonne seemed to come out of her trance. She said that she was experiencing a vision, being trapped in a forest near her home. She could hear men calling out, as they were being swallowed by the vines on the forest floor. She would always reach out to help them, but when she touched the vines ensnaring the men, she would lack the ability to cut them free. Then the entire scene would change to that of a foundry, and she would be placed on a platform dumping giant metal faces into a giant boiling pot of liquid metal. She never talked about it with Ryan again, except once. That time, she said that she had the same visions, but at the same time, the sword would be calling out to her…
vii. Dark Comet
”Return me, return me,” it would say. The bastard sword would constantly chant that message whenever Yvonne came to see it.
Note - Ghost Ship, Take No Prisoners, and Ambush and Tragic Serenades are reprises of previous songs.

Creator of course, was the leader of the curious civilization that was on the continent of Exeräise. That person could listen in on whatever he pleased with the help of the Magot Tower. The grim and disgusting mass of limbs haphazardly assembled into an altar gave Creator the power to see all and know all. But it wasn’t necessarily the tower itself. The Terra Operative had always thought that the tower was used to appease something below the surface, something that could give Creator the information he wanted. Still, he had to be open with Tereban if he wanted his help. ”Have… Have you ever heard of Derek Unmattias?” The wind abruptly changed direction. Tereban looked very solemn, then began to walk away, beckoning that the others follow him.
trackinfo.credits: from Chaosfoundry, released October 22, 2011

trackinfo.title: Chaosfoundry
trackinfo.lyrics: vi. Chaosfoundry ”They know. That slimy civilization and their cronies, they know. It’s best we revive him.” ~ In the time of Ryan, his wife Yvonne began to act suspiciously. She seemed to be drawn to Ryan’s bastard sword like a moth towards light. Every evening around the time the sun would disappear on the horizon, she could be seen observing the sword in its case and pedestal. Ryan rarely used the sword now, due to the sudden loss and disappearance of his right hand. But he couldn’t help but notice Yvonne’s odd behavior. One night, after he couldn’t stand it any longer, Ryan went to his wife and demanded to know what she was doing. Yvonne looked in Ryan’s direction, but looked like she was dreaming. When Ryan put his hand on her left shoulder, Yvonne seemed to come out of her trance. She said that she was experiencing a vision, being trapped in a forest near her home. She could hear men calling out, as they were being swallowed by the vines on the forest floor. She would always reach out to help them, but when she touched the vines ensnaring the men, she would lack the ability to cut them free. Then the entire scene would change to that of a foundry, and she would be placed on a platform dumping giant metal faces into a giant boiling pot of liquid metal. She never talked about it with Ryan again, except once. That time, she said that she had the same visions, but at the same time, the sword would be calling out to her…

Zeffon.title: Chaosfoundry III
Zeffon.about:
Everything magical.
There is nothing that time can fix. Little bloodstains cannot be removed completely. Deep (seep) down (sown) on the smallest level are whole worlds that exist purely on the existence of the unfortunate blemishes.
Unfortunately, time is no longer pointing in the correct direction. Everything that could have been perfect has been blemished by wretched alternative lines. These must be stopped at all costs, even if it means destroying the thread itself. These things are not foretold.
Time and time again, these blight-ers will be stopped, however long they persist. But then, time cannot erase them. Such is the nature of time.
-1G.

Zeffon.title: Chaosfoundry M71
Zeffon.about:
Pestilence is a real issue.
With new hardware I've acquired, I'm going to try (for real this time) to take all my recordings that I've recorded via cassette and assorted analog means and digitalize them. There will be some recognizable material on these cassettes since some of them have been used for source material, while others have been released unmodified as albums. This album (Chaosfoundry M71) features six tapes (split into tracks 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 10, and 13) slowed to half-speed, and their photos and respective artwork are featured as part of the album artwork. The third one was released as Golden Cavern (2016), while the fifth one was released as Strange Day (2016). The first one has material that was featured on Castle II Vanilla & Pin'ishian Muzak (2021), but overall, they're all fairly fresh.
I had a bout of depression this month, so progress has been slow. I've been experimenting with some ambient acoustic sounds, and I'm actually liking how it's turning out. You'll hear some of it on this album.

Zeffon.title: Chinese Purple
Zeffon.about:
A preview in the style of Dustgaze for the album "Secondary Proteins".
//////
"For thee, I shall construct a shrine of amber.
From there, you will never know happiness."
This is what that curator said when he passed away last year. The strange man housed a lot of the odd people he met in little amber coffins, much like flies. No one knows how he managed to do it, but many of the subjects in question appeared to be completely bald, male or female. When I approached him, I was naturally curious regarding his love of ritualistic arts, and he allowed me, after becoming his experiment for many years, to finally see his collection. Many of the amber subjects were imprisoned with clothes, but as mentioned before, lacked much of the hair on their heads. It was then I swore I saw one of the eyes of the woman closest to me swivel in my direction, as if it were studying me and saying "Oh you poor soul. Why couldn't you be like me?" The curator made it known to me that the absence of true happiness was in fact just the reverse polarity of itself, and not true grief.
"In lack of happiness, you will find ecstasy."
That is what he said to me.
Naturally, I have lived here for quite some time, contemplating over my inability to move. How did I get here again? I've completely forgotten. I certainly enjoy the scenery here, though. We stare at each other, day after day, with not a care in the world. After all, we are merely enshrined in amber, unable to do anything other than exist for the rest of time.
"For thee, I shall construct a shrine of amber.
From there, you will never know happiness."
This is what that curator said when he passed away last year. He was a good man. A very, very good man in ecstasy. Who knows where he is now?
//////
The numbers seven and eight are perhaps significant.

Zeffon.title: Circle
Zeffon.about:
i. Circle Seating Six
Throughout my life, I've encountered many different cultures. My mother told me to observe the world and what it could produce before she disappeared. Thus, as a consequence, I have made the decision to document as much as I possibly can. My mother was Reve Isga, hailing from the land of Inejeheim. Here, there is quite an interesting kingdom (at least in my opinion.
ii. One is Missing
My father is a man by the name of Kerragan Cathrop. He died a while back, and I hadn't heard from him since I was a young girl. My mother told me that he cared for me greatly, and he was just away for a bit. Yet, it would turn out that that "bit" entailed "my whole life". After a while, my mother disappeared too.
iii. Joy
After a while, I adopted the last name Crowa, according to my mother's wishes. Although I was technically a Cathrop, my mom didn't want me associated with my father. She said it was too dangerous, and she feared for my safety. She would tell me until I got older, I was to avoid my real last name. There was someone after our family that could very well kill us.
iv. Horrible Cries
When I grew older, my older brother Vari disappeared. I have no idea what happened to him, as my mother vanished as well soon after, just leaving me and my younger sister, also named Reve. We found a place in the Kingdom of Lavu, being related to Kerragan Cathrop, who, incidentally, was Governor No. 6 of Lavu during his life. However, we kept being drawn to the idea of finding what happened to the rest of our family, as we were very close. Thus, we decided as sisters to use any means (as long as it didn't entail stooping as low as torture or killing someone) to find out what happened to Mom and Vari. While we lived with the Windy Summit, we heard strange and horrible cries coming from the north. We didn't know what they were, but they filled us both with a sense of anxiety.
v. Deep Event Horizon
I personally kept dreaming of Mom, wondering why she moved away. Reve Terra would wake me up on occasion and tell me that the noises outside frightened her. At the time, I told her to stay quiet and go to sleep, but after a while, I began to feel her anxiety. Apparently, there's a certain group of people that have the ability to sense certain energies: psychics. Both me and Reve Terra seemed in tune with whatever this thing was. In my dreams, I kept appearing above some sort of deep pit, and every time I would look down, there was a face of white and black looking back at me. I didn't know what to make of it, but I knew it was something bad.
vi. Reconstruction of Me II
Eventually, we left the Windy Summit one night. We knew that the guards would be looking for us, but we didn't care. We had to get away from whatever was observing us from afar. Reve Terra and I managed to travel via other travelers to Verimore.

Zeffon.title: Collapse
Zeffon.about:
Trivia: My longest album to date, clocking in at 3.2 hours, and serving as a sequel to Generys Miasma.
i. North From Here, the Old Judge of Chaos
After the village far north of Lavu mysteriously disappeared, many people began to wonder happened to it. The forest surrounding Heayth's Spiral was believed to be cursed. Yet, despite this, many people built villages in the forest adjacent to it. No one wanted to live close to the oppressive and enormous Kingdom of Lavu, so the farther north a colony, the better off it was.
The curious day came however, when a girl named Reve entered a village called Toletara.
ii. Nargraven Forest
In essence, a man who knows the least knows the most. That was the motto of Fair Onrac, the unknown one. He died in a place called Nargraven Forest, where, if one ventures too deep, the forest turns upside-down, leaving the unfortunate traveler to fall into the green sky.
iii. The Inejwood
Deeper, past the point of no return for travelers are the ruins of an old town. How do I know this? I live there. The town itself is called Inytrvia, and is the oldest town in Zeffon, created when humans were starting to find out the benefits of working together.
iv. Gallows in the Sky
Luckily, the town of Inytrvia can be approached, but only at night. If the town is approached by day, if the sky turns green, the traveler or adventurer is sucked into its abyssal clouds. Apparently, there's an entire world up there, but no one has wanted to venture into the sky to find out.
v. Exeräise
There is an old volume by Fair's grandfather (ironically) that talks about the Nargraven Forest and its dangers. Fair apparently wanted to experiment with disaster, given his desire to find the civilization in the sky. The civilization (whether it exists or not) apparently had the rare ability to understand something that the Isgas in Zeffon only just had the opportunity to grasp.
vi. Tascan
There is a cave near a small town called Ytrac. Ytrac is the closest town to Fair Tower, and a lot of people have noticed the impact that it has had on the people there and the earth around them. The town of Ytrac is constantly surrounded by decaying earth, so much so, that the town is typically only inhabited as a trading post, with no permanent residents.
vii. The Awakened Pathier
In any case, the cave is like a long tube - it travels endlessly underground until it emerges on the other side of the mountain next to Ytrac. Then, there is a long decaying plain before the terrain begins to become rough. At the end, amid broken and decaying earth, is Fair Tower.
viii. Gallows on the Hill (Piano Reprise)
The valley in which Fair Tower is built is so old, the mountains supposedly are still alive, unlike their counterparts that are not sentient and are basically a pile of rocks and earth. No one has been able to see these wonders though because of the endless cave. The cave is infinitely long, and only people of the Nargraven Forest sky civilization can break the endless pattern.
ix. Collapse (Demo 12-2011)
Another reason no one's ever tried to enter the Fair Tower Valley is because the cave has collapsed on visitors that have tried to traverse it, but it has reformed, like it's alive. However, the people inside never make it out of the cave in time.
x. Proton?
However, there still tales of the people who used to live in the Fair Tower Valley before the earth began to decay. They were the ancient Ognians, spreading their empire from Unkardia to Exeräise to Värta to Ytrac. They came across the cave and somehow managed to traverse it into the valley, where they met the living mountains and stone giants.
xi. My Love
However, there was also a curse that had just freshly been placed on the valley at the time. The ancient Ognians got there right after Fair Onrac, who created Fair Tower to harvest the power of the Earth and turn it into a type of mist that could be used to turn people into savagely competent warriors. FIghters needed simply to breathe in the mist, and soon they would become strong and practically immortal.
xii. Human Bradyzoites, Pt. 3 (Vuzoulüth)
A giant by the name of Vuzoulüth changed Fair Onrac's plans by kicking over the tower, snapping it off near the base. Infuriated, Fair Onrac cursed the valley to never again know peace and the power of the earth.

Zeffon.title: Come Here, Red Eyes...!
Zeffon.about:
i. Love Death
"Don't believe me," said the woman behind the counter. I knew that that was the secret phrase that summoned the plane. Not the lunar plane, mind you. The experimental plane. There was a strange factory nearby (or experimental facility, I really don't know what to call it) that showed and displayed the makings of something from a dream, ironically. It was supposedly top secret, but was situated in the middle of our suburban community. To top it off, it was surrounded by nothing but chain-link fence, allowing the most timid of trespassers to make their way in.
ii. Frahnjuhäsea, Part 3
The experimental plane was one that wasn't much to behold; it looked like a flying coffee canister with short stubby wings and a giant dumpster fire of an engine in the middle, so if you can imagine that, scale it up to the size of an actual aircraft, and had the sound of a V1 buzzbomb slowed down into a rumble, you will have created an accurate depiction. Dr. Frahnjuhäsea (Dr. F) was in charge of the project, or so it is said.
iii. Meredithia Value Poison Gas
One of these days, I wanted to see what was in the secret facility that had long been a part of the community and the shadows cast by the morning sun into the park, but I knew I likely wouldn't get the opportunity. I was not a trespasser or similar delinquent - I was a entrepreneur fixated on stimulating the local economy. The government site was experimenting on us in some way, but I have no idea how.
iv. The Crash of a Dead Person
After I had visited the stand I mentioned previously, I paid the lady what I owed her. Soon, I could hear the rumble of the flying pipe bomb aircraft that always found its way through the air somehow, despite being a massive engine and not much else. However, as the sound grew closer, I realized it was something else.
v. Frahnjuhäsea, Part 1
A red prop-driven aircraft about the size of a Boeing 747 slowly drifted over the park and cast its enormous shadow on the green grass. As it headed towards the experimental facility, I noticed that it had not two main wings, but four, arranged in an X-pattern. To my surprise, it managed to somehow land on the helicopter pad by gaining altitude and then diving, landing on its nose without any hint of damage. In fact, it bounced like a balloon would, eventually tipping over onto its landing gear.
vi. Primitive Urbanize 1
Curious, the townsfolk went up the hill to the lab, but a soldier with a gun shooed us away, pointing to the "No Trespassing" sign. Disappointed, many folks returned to their daily activities, and quickly forgot the matter. It was after this day that we began to have problems in our little town, as the lush green trees and the grass in the park shriveled until it turned yellow, then brown, then grey. Eventually, one of the citizens who regularly visited the facility had had enough, and him and I scaled the simple chain-link fence to confront the crux of the problem.
vii. Solar Expectation
There was nothing in the building except an elevator down, so naturally, that's what we followed. When we reached the bottom, we were near the train tracks, on top of a kind of loading dock. We knew that there had been no trains recently, so why was this place "top secret"? It didn't make any sense. Then, the sound of a train whistle broke through the dry breeze, and a small growing silhouette could be spotted on the horizon.
viii. Film From tWar
It shortly after that that we were surrounded by angry conscripts with their service rifles, and after they had pushed us to the ground, an officer barged through, picked up my friend, and shot him in the face with his TT-33. I realized soon enough that this was him: Dr. Frahnjuhäsea.

trackinfo.lyrics: vi. Primitive Urbanize 1 Curious, the townsfolk went up the hill to the lab, but a soldier with a gun shooed us away, pointing to the "No Trespassing" sign. Disappointed, many folks returned to their daily activities, and quickly forgot the matter. It was after this day that we began to have problems in our little town, as the lush green trees and the grass in the park shriveled until it turned yellow, then brown, then grey. Eventually, one of the citizens who regularly visited the facility had had enough, and him and I scaled the simple chain-link fence to confront the crux of the problem.
trackinfo.credits: from Come Here, Red Eyes...!, released February 8, 2018

trackinfo.title: Solar Expectation
trackinfo.lyrics: vii. Solar Expectation There was nothing in the building except an elevator down, so naturally, that's what we followed. When we reached the bottom, we were near the train tracks, on top of a kind of loading dock. We knew that there had been no trains recently, so why was this place "top secret"? It didn't make any sense. Then, the sound of a train whistle broke through the dry breeze, and a small growing silhouette could be spotted on the horizon.
trackinfo.credits: from Come Here, Red Eyes...!, released February 8, 2018

trackinfo.title: Film From tWar
trackinfo.lyrics: viii. Film From tWar It shortly after that that we were surrounded by angry conscripts with their service rifles, and after they had pushed us to the ground, an officer barged through, picked up my friend, and shot him in the face with his TT-33. I realized soon enough that this was him: Dr. Frahnjuhäsea.
trackinfo.credits: from Come Here, Red Eyes...!, released February 8, 2018

Zeffon.title: Conan
Zeffon.about:
i. Lava
The field of clay soldiers
Filled with empty, apathetic eyes
Except for one, who was always watching
From the river
To the sea
With a sense of misanthropy
Conan was staring from behind it
On a certain day of the month, there was a man named Ryan Maliki Sayu that approached the fountain in the middle of the Ognian city of Meyandiora-Ba and stared at it with curiosity. I sensed that he was trying to figure out if there was a way he could have saved his parents. I felt for him, truly I did, but I needed someone in power who could execute my will.
ii. Eye of Storm
It examines the catastrophe east of the soldiers.
Ryan Maliki Sayu was the lord of Meyandiora-Ba, an Ognian city before it collapsed and the royal family began its slow but steady takeover of Unkardia. Ryan was the one that caused this collapse of the empire, but the Ognian empire was on its way out already.
iii. Long Voyage to Dead
Like hands connected to dead armies, they point in the general direction of the calamity.
I knew that Ryan had access to the Ratama Fountain for a while now, but after the Ogna Empire's demise, it disappeared, as if it no longer wanted to serve anyone other than the people who created it, as if it had a mind of its own and served its original masters with fierce loyalty.
iv. Radiance Version 2
His curse glowed of Sun.
In the forest that now envelops Meyandiora-Ba (or what's left of it), there is a strange sound that calls in the night. Originally, when the Royal Family took over Unkardia, there were only two towns that survived from the original Ognian period: Heretmedel (later named Ocsania), and Rasoe. Only Rasoe bears its original name.
v. Relicaw
His weapon of choice was the Mystery.
There is a beast in the Meyandiora-Ba wood now. No one knows what it's doing in there, but some suspect that its existence may have to do with the now-vanished Ratama Fountain. Ever since the location of the Ratama Fountain was forgotten, there have been howls of pain from the woods.
vi. Dead Dragon Shrine
It is not applicable, as it cannot occur. Death is around the corner for those who wait, but cannot climb.
Where the old town of Meyandiora-Ba used to be is now hard to access. It's not because of the forest itself, but because of the location of the ruins. The town lies in the Yoau Basin, which is the lowest part of Unkardia. People who travel near the Yoau Basin often have a hard time breathing, as there is a suffocating wind that prevails around the town. The plants flourish, but even with the prevailing green scenery, no one dares venture too close.
vii. Death Machine
The smell of sulfur is prominent in the night. You have been spared this time, despite the promise.
South of Meyandiora-Ba is The Garonnyte, the shrine of chaos. There is a machine that guards the old shrine, and anyone who enters it is killed, as long as the machine detects and makes it to them before they leave the structure. The Garonnyte is an old shrine constructed around a chunk of Castle Adelais, the cursed structure that is responsible for the curse of Zeffon. This shrine exists on the Great Plain of Unkardia, to the point where it can be hard to find, as the Great Plain is vast and has very consistent features throughout.
viii. Adelais
I am the mirror-sister of the alternate man.
Adelais' castle was built where The Garonnyte is now, and was the subject of a large siege. Originally, after the demise of the Castles on the island of Anne, Castle Adelais was the last one standing that represented the Royal Family's original power.
ix. Radiance Version 3
The Mystery is the man who dares venture into Sharmiah and where it leads. Sharmiah has the ability to use the Mystery, as it is a scholar's curse - a twang - a sitar.
There was a massive famine in the land, and there was an odd glowing orange orb in the sky, as if there was a second sun. During this time, a group of people shrouded in mystery began to spy on the people who lived near Castle Adelais - Adelais herself became enraged with this constant infiltration, and declared war on the mystery people. Eventually, the campaign became so destructive, bloody, and violent, that Castle Adelais was broken into pieces and scattered throughout the land of Zeffon. Adelais disappeared for years after, and the Garonnyte was built over Castle Adelais' cornerstone.

Zeffon.title: Contrast
Zeffon.about:
i. Voice of Thine
“It was here that yet another era of chaos was born, straight from the ashes.”
ii. Malevolence
At one point in time, Ocsania became haunted by an unknown assailant, who, despite the lack of physical force used to do so, terrorized the townsfolk nevertheless. The townspeople would often have nightmares of self-mutilation, torture, and undead beasts. These nightmares became so uncanny that they sought the help of a sage in Viandor.
~
”The two invented a device born from their hardships and anger. The device created the odd time rift around Anne, but also began to cause the Earth to decay. People around here in Ocsania began to feel its effects, which manifested themselves as nightmares, for which they sought a sage in Viandor. In any case, in order to achieve a state of immortality that would allow the two monarchs to conquer the world by themselves as revenge, they needed something they named “survival instinct”. This survival instinct would be something that would allow their bodies to innately foresee certain events, such as death, something that was independent of their own minds.”
iii. Escape
“A ship left for Viandor around this time. To test their newly found powers, they tried to destroy it. Using their survival instincts to calculate for any mistakes that would other occur, the two ran on the sea and climbed up the side of the ship, killing everyone on board. Dränsilane however, was wounded in the battle, causing them to use their doomsday device to hone their instincts even more. But soon, they realized that there was a fatal flaw that would prevent them from passing a certain “instinct threshold”, one that would cost them their lives.
iv. Legacy
The idea behind the Technology of the Isgas is that all humans have a “survival instinct”, one that is separate from your conscious mind, one that can be honed so accurately, that mistakes cannot be made, and even the strongest sword can be shattered by another, and even the heaviest man can walk on water.
~
”Dränsilane created the group that kidnapped the daughter of Ruler No. 6, Kerragan. From there, he retreated back to the isle of Anne. Then they hatched another plan. Through extensive calculations, and with the help of their device, they came up with a plan to conquer even the omnipotent beings in the heavens. They brought the son of Kerragan to the isle as well, then sent both the daughter and the son back in time. The Isga brothers were getting old, and as much as they hated to admit it, they needed heirs to their grand design. Of course, Kerragan’s son and daughter weren’t chosen for any old reason.”
”What does this have to do with me?” asked Reve.
The man would not be able to finish his statement.
v. Contrast
When one looks into a mirror, one has to feel sorry for the being on the other side of the looking glass, for from the moment you look away, the reflection ceases to exist. But then, is it really you looking at a reflection, or are you the reflection, looking at you?
~
And that was the fear of a man, trapped in a location that was a mystery to him. A fear that if he stopped looking at the mirror in his cell, that the beautiful woman he was gazing upon would disappear forever.
vi. Outro
He had seen that woman before…
~
And can your realities be completely dependent on the simple diversion of sight of another?
