Zeffon.title: Cowbell Mechanics
Zeffon.about:
Cowbell Mechanics is about a civilization that destroys itself with the use of a bomb. The story is meant to parody that of the Manhattan project.
i. Cowbell Mechanics (War Factory)
It was here that the destruction of the ideal Pathier society began to unfold. The unrest following the kidnapping of the Cathrop's daughter and another event that led to the death of an entire town’s population caused due to a series of unfortunate events. A group bent on destroying everything we had worked for appeared from out of nowhere, calling itself The True Calignosity of Moth. They said they were there to bring about the apocalypse. No one wanted to believe them, but the Pathiers began gearing for war regardless. “He” would often wonder what existed beyond the waters off the cliffs nearby the mountain town of Rasoe. The sea was incredibly vast, but at the same time, it seemed so… tiny. This man was correct in assuming that there was more than just water to the ocean. If he had traveled to Ocsania and begun to gaze upon the north east, he would be looking in the direction of Icrifeani, the country that had just lost its colony on Ibiksis Island to the rebels that controlled the isle. If he had the power to view beyond that, he would run into the Seraph Territories, a rebellious country that scoffed at the implementation and execution of international law, beyond that was the notorious Kingdom of Lavu, the largest and one of the most successful states in the world.
It was here that the destruction of our ideal Pathier society began to unfold. The unrest following the kidnapping of the Cathrop's daughter led to a series of unfortunate events. A group bent on destroying everything we had worked for appeared from out of nowhere, calling itself The True Calignosity of Moth. They said they were there to bring about the apocalypse. No one wanted to believe them, but the Pathiers began gearing for war regardless.
ii. Archer Revenge, Pt. 2
The True Calignosity of Moth was a truly un-divine and dark group of unknown assailants. They did everything to make sure that the Pathier Kingdom would eventually fall, whether it was through information warfare or brute force. Many of the villages on the outskirts of the Pathier Kingdom burned for days. Then the other leaders discovered the base of operations for the evil forces, an abandoned structure out in the middle of the desert northwest of the capital city: Du Omerideöth. If it wasn’t not enough that the source of the evil was on the Kingdom’s back doorstep, the group of leaders wasn’t operating at their fullest capacity. Leader No. 6 was dead due to the heartbreaking disappearance of his daughter over ten years ago. Leader No. 8 was missing in action. Despite this, the remaining members make a commitment to destroy the enemy or die trying. With a speech given to the members of the central town, the military quickly regrouped and prepared for an all-out war. Later, the leaders received word that the True Calignosity was building a bomb to destroy the entire Pathier country. The decision was made to sneak within the ruins of Du Omerideöth and destroy the bomb where it was being made. Within a few hours, the military that had moved out clashed with the armies of evil while a secret party went into the compound unnoticed.
iii. Burning Earth
A battle was already underway in between the ancient ruins and the town. There was no shortage of fire and loud bangs were heard from all around. Luckily, the party that meant to infiltrate Du Omerideöth managed to do so, despite all the mayhem. Inside, it was a lot quieter. The leader signaled for the party of four to press forward. Soon, they reached the bottom room of Du Omerideöth. It was remarkably well lit, despite being miles under the ground. Suddenly, the party was overcome with a mist that began to suffocate them. Undeterred, the foolish party began to travel deeper until they finally found what they were looking for. It was a tunnel that led into what was known as the Temple of Faces. Thus, they concluded that the True Calignosity of Moth must be the same as the nameless Kingdom led by Vagard Tekraona. This nameless Kingdom was commonly referred to as the Kingdom of the Undead, for no man had entered and managed to escape.
iv. Prelude (11-6-09)
In any case, something didn’t seem quite right. A low rumble could’ve been heard if the party had stuck to scouting the area around the temple like they were told to, but refused to do so, opting to go inside the temple instead. The commander allowed this to happen, but the party members were traitors nonetheless.
v. Bombing Campaign
The low rumble preceded to get louder, meaning that the bomb must have been deployed at that point. Indeed, a shadow hovered over the Pathier Kingdom cast by an enormous dragon, one so enormous that the entire wingspan blackened the sky. The party rushed to the top of the ruins. The armies of the True Calignosity have been defeated by the Pathiers, but up above, large birds and other fell flying beasts came bearing explosive ordinance that began to light up the Pathier town. Suddenly, just as it started, it ended, with a large explosion blowing up the town entirely. The campaign against the True Calignosity was no more. The party that betrayed their kingdom, whether it was intentional or not, would end up scouring the world for a millennia, trying to find someone to take them in. No one would allow such hypocrites to stay in their houses. Thus, after 100 years of wandering, the party became no more.
vi. Dragös
Reve suddenly woke up from a dream. The grass around her was covered in fog. She was home at last. There were a couple of things to do, but she could finally enter Castle Norfell. Years ago, she had traveled to the Chaoslands in order to destroy the Kingdom of Lavu. Now, after 100 years of nomadic life, she was back home. A strange sound was heard in the woods behind her. She looked back. Those woods were the Crystal Forest, full of various tragedies that had befallen those who had entered them over the years. There was actually someone who she was looking for who had entered the woods in search of the boy Roanin. Roanin disappeared years ago from Rasoe much to his stepmother’s dismay, and never returned. Tereban, one of the Terror, had decided to find this boy along with someone he referred to as “Nightmare”. Moving towards the trees, a pleasant breeze whipped through Reve’s long golden hair. Yes, it was good to be home.

trackinfo.credits: from Cowbell Mechanics, released January 31, 2011

trackinfo.title: Prelude (11-6-09)
trackinfo.lyrics: iv. Prelude (11-6-09) In any case, something didn’t seem quite right. A low rumble could’ve been heard if the party had stuck to scouting the area around the temple like they were told to, but refused to do so, opting to go inside the temple instead. The commander allowed this to happen, but the party members were traitors nonetheless.
trackinfo.about: This is one of the first tracks created by me. (Hence the date)
trackinfo.credits: from Cowbell Mechanics, released January 31, 2011

trackinfo.title: Bombing Campaign
trackinfo.lyrics: v. Bombing Campaign The low rumble preceded to get louder, meaning that the bomb must have been deployed at that point. Indeed, a shadow hovered over the Pathier Kingdom cast by an enormous dragon, one so enormous that the entire wingspan blackened the sky. The party rushed to the top of the ruins. The armies of the True Calignosity have been defeated by the Pathiers, but up above, large birds and other fell flying beasts came bearing explosive ordinance that began to light up the Pathier town. Suddenly, just as it started, it ended, with a large explosion blowing up the town entirely. The campaign against the True Calignosity was no more. The party that betrayed their kingdom, whether it was intentional or not, would end up scouring the world for a millennia, trying to find someone to take them in. No one would allow such hypocrites to stay in their houses. Thus, after 100 years of wandering, the party became no more.
trackinfo.about: The society that invents a super-destructive bomb destroys itself after detonating it.
trackinfo.credits: from Cowbell Mechanics, released January 31, 2011

trackinfo.title: Dragös
trackinfo.lyrics: vi. Dragös Reve suddenly woke up from a dream. The grass around her was covered in fog. She was home at last. There were a couple of things to do, but she could finally enter Castle Norfell. Years ago, she had traveled to the Chaoslands in order to destroy the Kingdom of Lavu. Now, after 100 years of nomadic life, she was back home. A strange sound was heard in the woods behind her. She looked back. Those woods were the Crystal Forest, full of various tragedies that had befallen those who had entered them over the years. There was actually someone who she was looking for who had entered the woods in search of the boy Roanin. Roanin disappeared years ago from Rasoe much to his stepmother’s dismay, and never returned. Tereban, one of the Terror, had decided to find this boy along with someone he referred to as “Nightmare”. Moving towards the trees, a pleasant breeze whipped through Reve’s long golden hair. Yes, it was good to be home.
trackinfo.about: The name Dragös dates back to elementary school, where Dragös was the isolated capital of the dragons. Dragös in this album is an old town with a labyrinth underneath it. It's said an ancient beast roams the maze, but no one knows for sure.
trackinfo.credits: from Cowbell Mechanics, released January 31, 2011

Zeffon.title: Crime of the Curious Adventurer
Zeffon.about:
i. Cuja Awakening
The album is about the infiltration of the abandoned city of Port Raiden on the continent of Exeräise, which lies north of the isle of Meredith. Despite the state of the town, the seas surrounding it are supposedly heavily patrolled, puzzling the Sharhodeon spies. During their brief stay in Greyhold, the spies notice the state of the Marat Empire, controlling their citizens through fear. Remembering their mission objectives, they travel to the capital city of Meredith and manage to find a scrapped lifeboat that they can use to travel to Exeräise. Eventually, they make landfall without being detected.
Meanwhile, the party that tried to enter the Kingdom of Lavu is found and apprehended. The Sharhodeon Territories instantly condemn the arrests and portray their spies as common adventurers. Despite this, Lavu holds a public celebration of power, showing they're not to be messed with. A conference is held between the leading figures between the two nations, and an agreement is settled upon: The spies will be granted amnesty for their actions, but if this type of espionage is to occur again, the Kingdom of Lavu will consider this an act of war. This worries Sharhodeon, because other spies are still within Lavu's territory completing their missions, and the best the Sharhodeon Territories can do is hope they're not caught. Later, a letter is secretly delivered to the Sharhodeon offices, saying another party of spies has managed to infiltrate the Wind Temple, which Sharhodeon calls Castle Adelais.
ii. Iodine Empire
In any case, Derek Unmattias disappeared later on. We checked the vault where we kept the stone head, and the head was still there. I collapse from poison a few days later while walking through one of Blueheart's roads.
iii. Reaching the Ancient City of Meredith
With the Marat Empire's help, we managed to establish independence from Lavu. We became a territory of the Marat Empire and part of an alliance with the Icrifeani. The government in Lavu didn't like this at all, and made the decision to invade Blueheart.
iv. A Secret Visit to Port Raiden
However, as we prepared for a full-on assault from the Lavulese army, we began to wonder where they were. It had been a full month since the government declared war. The Detective's Guild that I was a part of at the time had essentially become the protectors of Blueheart, and because of that, we made the decision to investigate the lack of military presence in our town.
v. Victory
It was a short journey north, but we found a small village that the military had been at called Curja. The people there told us that several soldiers had been through the town and that they were headed towards Blueheart at this very moment. Shocked, we headed back about three miles to Blueheart, but found nothing. The citizens in Blueheart seemed equally surprised by the revelation brought on by the people of Curja. Unfazed, we continued to look out for the military, but declared ourselves safe after the space of a month.
vi. Weeping Oaken Tree
Thorn came to me later and said that he had seen the most horrid looking individuals near a lake just east of Curja. We followed his directions, thinking we might have found the soldiers of Lavu. However, we found nothing of the sort - no people, no lake. Just a weeping willow, standing in a grassy field.
vii. A Tense Meeting Over Relations and Hot Chocolate
We began to re-open the investigation into Derek Unmattias. He had killed several of the civilians of Blueheart in an attempt to uncover the stone head associated with the amber fall (whatever that means). As we were searching for clues, a representative from Lavu came and talked to us. Right off the bat, they accused us of murdering their men, that is, until we proved that our manpower was insufficient to destroy an entire army. They still were irritated when they left, vowing that we would stay a part of Lavu instead of the Marat Empire.
viii. A Hint of Warm Drink and Cold Reality
We found the figure we assumed to be Derek Unmattias later, resting on a pile of sticks. Derek seemed to have died from natural causes, but upon closer inspection, he had had the fingers on his left hand chewed off by some massive beast. There was no doubt that Derek had died in great pain. We began to look through different tomes at our own Library of Blueheart regarding the history of a certain beast called the Jalagu, and we were surprised at what we found.
ix. Another Attempt at Castle Adelais
Lavu had tried to excavate this castle before, but apparently, there was a second castle in Lavu that had once been constructed under the influence of Adelais Isga. All the Unkardian Royal children had castles of their own; we knew this. However, Castle Adelais was an oddity, as it was built in different portions at the same location, and these portions were scattered about the land, as if to be reassembled in their original location like a giant puzzle.
x. Wind Temple
We didn't understand much about the pieces, but according to the tome, they are the reason some people like me can phase through dimensions. If one is born in the presence of a part of Adelais' Castle, some creepy things can happen. We can either receive a blessing or a curse. The chances of achieving one or the other is equal. However, even blessings like mine are cursed, as I grow dreadfully ill every time I try to teleport or walk through walls.

Zeffon.title: Crysalis Rie
Zeffon.about:
i. Lands of the Creator
Some things come in pretty boxes. Other things come in paper bags covered in dust.
There's something about recieving something that sets about a course of curiousity.
The gift you recieved has a purpose.
Who gave it to you? And why?
It was only once it was discovered...
...That I knew I was never going back.
ii. Venom of Ages
As you keep travelling farther east, you start hearing voices. You glance around, expecting to see yourself surrounded by people, but such is not the case. Suddenly, one voice becomes much more clear than the others.
"What is that you're doing, Reve?"
You look in the direction of a clearing. The ghost from your dreams awaits you there.
"Who are you?" you inquire.
"I'm a distant relative of yours, Reve. I led Gaine into the ruins of Castle Dränsilane twice for your sake. I am the ghost of Unknown Iahae. You do realize that Gaine is following you at this moment, yes? Or, I think he goes by Kerragan now."
You briefly remember the days you escaped the Crystal Forest, along with Gaine. As you were told, Gaine was lost in the forest, and being only a child, he sat down and cried. He then heard someone else crying, and found a much younger girl sobbing for the same reason. You both found your way out together. Neither of you seemed to remember if you had any parents...
"His mind is lost now, Reve. One of the three Arc-Demai has a death grip on his soul."
iii. Pale Shores
It started in paradise amongst the silver weeds there began a certain element of curiousity.
I was given a gift to open
It was only after it had been opened that I learned of its true value.
Oh how we laughed when fate blessed us with souls
Oh how we laughed when we were torn to shreds by ghouls
Oh how we laughed when we were taken for the fools that we were
We used, we created, we destroyed. We the fools soon fled our promised lands...
...And dissolved, like maggots, into the sands

Zeffon.title: Dark Sulphur
Zeffon.about:
i. Dark Sulphur
3 of 4.
...Suppose one day I come.
And I break the spell.
Oh, how I remember the day...
Kjre we wene skqjv
We fjew we wene akqjv
Kb, bkw C neieiaen pbe agkkvy vhy...
I remember after Lavu grew more irritated about the disappearance of their soldiers that I became more intrigued. I didn't know everything about the Nacajda, but I still had a theory in my head as to why those soldiers suddenly vanished. Miu, the weak god, was calling to these young men, beckoning them to come to his estate. People who were raised locally near Blueheart and Curja knew as kids to not ever set foot in the Nacajda. However, from time to time, even as a dream, we would be wracked with nightmares, telling us to come visit that temple. Miu's purpose may be yet unclear, but I decided to grab my binoculars and view the temple from afar, just to be sure.
As I approached the temple, I began to see red in the mud, where blood had pooled months before, but was somehow still fresh. Rain had been falling in intervals for the past few months, yet I could still see signs of violence and slaughter. I eventually spotted the most horrific thing I had seen in my experience as a detective. A man, or what appeared to be a man, mangled and contorted in the strangest of ways, turned into a living human pretzel. He was dressed in a muddy Lavy military uniform, so I knew he must've been one of the disappeared soldiers. He was completely immobile with the exception of his right hand, which was frantically clawing and grabbing at the mud and dirt, as if to pull himself along. Looking through my binoculars, I could see a few pale figures limping about the temple. I wasn't sure what to make of this. Suddenly, the person on the ground spoke.
"Where's Curja?"
Surprised, I looked down at the figure. He was looking at me, as if he had woken from a long sleep. He began to loosen his tangled limbs, and I thought I saw a bit of pink return to his otherwise pale skin. In response to his question, I pointed to the west.
"Thank you."
He seemed dazed for a moment, but then began to cry. I helped him stand up and offered him the support of my shoulder. He looked absolutely traumatized.
"I saw the crown..." he said. I looked at him. My friend had taken to crown from the temple, but was it back...?
"There was a dragon. He told me to follow him to the Citadel in Refeaël. The one in the marsh..."
The man nearly slumped over. I took him to Curja and paid for a room for him to sleep in. It seemed I needed to go to Refeaël to get some more answers about what had happened to my friend.

Zeffon.title: Dead Drums
Zeffon.about:
The short version of Dead Drums & Popular Propaganda Plus Tribal Politics, this album is due to be released on the label Monolith Terrorism. The full version will be released on DVD and is 15 hours long.
This album describes a man named John and his relationship with God. John moves to a run-down mansion in the tropics and begins to meditate on the things that he has seen. Eventually, he makes a group of musical works called M.O.Voyager after foreseeing his demise. The original works become lost, and a distraught John creates a series of photographs, ones that never cease to change color. He places them in photo albums deemed "Love Books", and from there, he abandons the mansion and decides to seek solace elsewhere.
Track 35 of the album is available for free here:  archive.org/details/EroticFireFacestheShellIsBloodyAHiddenCurrent93Grozny93Tribute

Zeffon.title: Dead White Hand
Zeffon.about:
i. Dead White Hand
Mr. Paragi wanders outside into the Great Marsh, and ends up sinking into the endless mire. He calls for help, but no one comes to his aid.
Somehow, Mr. Paragi made it out alive. The Great Marsh usually doesn't allow people to escape it, but apparently, this was an exception. and of all places, he found himself in the Valley of Fair Tower.
Meanwhile, another soul wakes up from a long sleep in the town of Gree.
II. Axon
This soul is Kerragan Cathrop, Governor No. 6 of the former of Lavu. After awakening from the sleep, you suddenly reach out towards the ceiling of the hut you're in, hoping to remember something long lost. And then it comes to you. You are not Kerragan, but someone called Gaine. Yes, that must be it. You remember being denied your throne on that desolate hill on Anne. It was a cold day that day, and snow was falling. Your kingdom-to-be-inherited had been on the verge of dying for some time, and soon, the homes of the villagers were empty. You were huddled in the empty castle with your family. And then the Arc-Demai came into the room. The Arc-Demai were the elite guard of the Kingdom and its three castles of the royal family Isga. You ran with your brother and father into a secret passage for some reason. You can't remember why. You have no idea what became of them, or your sisters who were left in the room.
III. Journey Far and Wide
Having sensed that Gaine is finally awake, you proceed into the chamber were you put him. This village of Gree has been abandoned for generations. Being hidden in the Skragg Mountains around superstition-inducing landmarks like Unknown Falls resulted in a lack of trade. Gree never stood a chance.
IV. Untitled
Meanwhile, Du Omerideöth/Castle Adelais has finally been removed from government control, since the government of Lavu no longer exists. People seize the opportunity to explore the desert castle.
V. D.
In an old Lavulese military archive, it is revealed that the Lavulese military was capable of traveling through dimensions, and that they were at constant war with "them". The foes in the document are later described as "mindless wights". It appeared that the Kingdom of Lavu and the Seraph Territories had jointly decided to eliminate the Sharhodeon Territories with a combination of chemical weapons and a special "technique" referred to as "Detenté".
VI. BassSeraph
The conspirators in the Seraph Territories government are apprehended for planning a "routine genocide", as they called it. They are publicly executed within a week, and a provisional government is installed to maintain order.
VII. Toú Empire
Supporters of the old government escape on a ship to the isle of Toú in order to build an empire to stand up against the "evil" they face, and restore the old system, believing the Seraph Territories conspirators to be wrongfully executed. A colony is set up, but when a second ship in pursuit arrives at the tiny island, all that is found are statues with anguished expressions covered in vines.

Zeffon.title: Demo 10
Zeffon.about:
i. Dancing in the Light
The people of the fourth continent are to evolve into Arc-Demai. The Unknown Beast is the perpetrator of this curse. Thus, Vagard wishes to destroy Eresymcaion in order to break the curse on his people. An Arc-Demai is originally a person, but once that person ages to 100 years, they become non-aging, but not immortal.
ii. Dissonance
The three Arc-Demai that invaded Castle Norfell (Decaying Angel, Mist Serpent, and Jackanapes) were seeking to create more Arc-Demai, since the Dark Seraph would soon destroy them all. The Dark Seraph was formed by D23 as a bringer of destruction to the Unknown Beast, an unfortunate byproduct of his creation habits, formed from the Curse of Aed. The Unknown Beast responded by creating Arc-Demai, evil souls that would seek out any sort of husk or empty body to fill and thus become alive.
iii. Sineworks
Until the Arc-Demai were defeated, the Unknown Beast could not be slain. And that is why the three remaining Arc-Demai decided to attack Castle Norfell. In order to avoid drawing the attention of the Dark Seraph, the Arc-Demai played humans, becoming guards of the kingdom, now horribly stricken by the winter.
iv. Inferno
When all the other guards had fallen from illness, the Arc-Demai moved into the throne room. Jackanapes then let out a shrill sound, one that inflicts any listeners with exeräise. As the writer and the mastermind behind the Disynxiym, I Dränsilane, bring this book to a close.

Zeffon.title: Demo 9 (Aqua Regia)
Zeffon.about:
Demo No. 9 is a small compilation of demos that I deemed unfit for a more "official" release. More demos to follow.
For those who are curious, the following demos have been released:
1. 7429FD
2. Pathier
3. Exp
4. (untitled)
5. Silver Demo
6. Maiduex Demo
7. Endigös Promo
8. Argusphase Demos
9. Demo 9 (Aqua Regia)
~~~
i. A Decision Made For The Lunar Plane (An Alternative Account of the Past)
Domnik continued to roam about the grey land of Graghgorra. To believe that someone could actually survive in this landscape seemed silly, but not impossible. It was strange though. He had heard that the Disynxiym spoke of a "center world", also called Earth, that provided the life energy to the surrounding dimensions. At least, that was Dränsilane's hypothesis. Sitting down, Domnik began to think about the tales of Roanin that Dränsilane spun, how much was fact, and how much was metaphor.
ii. Arrogant Piece No. 2
The clouds gathered, and soon rain began to fall. This did little to stop Domnik's thought process. He knew that the Disynxiym mentioned him, Rowland Meylith in it, but that might be because he was a prominent leader of a large Kingdom that was. Rowland had ascended to the position of Supreme Leader No. 1 by bribing his superiors and killing the ones that wouldn't comply with Dr. Uy's help. Dr. Uy didn't seem to be human, and could apparently be in multiple places at once. Rowland met the man in the streets of Blueheart, starved and nearly dead. Dr. Uy, then the Murderer of Fern Street, usually destroyed his victims, hanging their innards on lampposts without a second thought. But the man seemed to bear some sort of kinship towards Rowland, and took him into his hideout. Rowland had lost much of his memory from his starvation, a condition not uncommon in the broken town of Blueheart. When asked his name, Rowland didn't even know. So Dr. Uy named him the only other word he ever spoke. And that was "Domnik".
iii. The Love Never Seems to Die
And speaking of the Disynxiym, Rowland instantly wondered if the story of Reve was actually real. The motherly figure was never quite described in detail from what was left of Dränsilane's writings. Dränsilane had died before he finished the Disynxiym, and Castle Dränsilane was raided of all its treasures by the Kingdom of Lavu and torched, leaders calling the castle an "eyesore", citing the main reason for doing the deed as "solidifying authority" and "jest". The treasures were then sold to random street vendors without a second thought as to their historical value and content. Rowland himself had found the Disynxiym in the rainy street and used it to teach himself how to read.
iv. Rowland's Return
The Disynxium never truly divulged its secrets, but Rowland figured later that some words, like "Creator", were metaphors to mean things ranging from "authority figure", and "death". He wondered if Reve was really Dränsilane's sister, a close friend, a desire, or another entity.

Zeffon.title: Dimensional Rift
Zeffon.about:
i. Omega
Dimensional Rift is about a mining community owned by the country of Verimore. Located in the far north on the Stone Isles, they are absolutely frigid, but also subject for a curious phenomenon called a sogidne. A stream of spirits and lost souls are said to be able to be seen from the isle on a blue moon. On one blue moon, Governor No. 8 of Lavu travels to the Stone Isle Mines to see the sogidne for himself. When it occurs, Governor No. 8 becomes frightened, having seen spirits once before within Castle Adelais, while it was being excavated. On the ship home, Governor 8 is visited by a spirit, telling him that he will be punished for defiling the crypt of Adelais...
I woke up in a hospital bed again. I groaned as my stomach began to hurt. Oscar was sitting next to me, and he said that he carried me back to Lavu after I passed out on the road. I believed him. I told him what I had seen in the vision that I had when we encountered Opehla Goesiadu Garma. Oscar nodded and appeared to acknowledge what I said. Just then, some soldiers from Lavu walked into the room. I sat up, but they pointed their pistols at me. I was clearly under arrest.
ii. Reversal
Handcuffed and feeling ill, I was marched to the Wind Element building, where the Windy Summit was located. In the pit of my stomach, I felt as though I was going to die. I was locked in a room with plenty of books, and I realized that this was the room with some of the oldest records on history known to man in Zeffon. I was curious to know why they would trust a person like me in a place as precious as this.
iii. Enflesh
A man strolled in. He was a very high ranking official based on his uniform. He introduced himself as a man named Keliu. He was a constantly grinning man with his elevated cheeks hiding most of his eyes. The door opened and closed behind me, and there was Oscar.
"How do you do, good sir?" said Keliu in a bubbly tone.
"I said I'm fine," I replied. "You asked that already."
"NOT YOU," snapped Keliu, his face suddenly growing cross, "Oscar."
Oscar told Keliu that he was fine, and Keliu readopted his characteristic grin. This, Oscar told me, was a man that had helped create the dimension of Zeffon. Zeffon was a strange place that was created to avoid systematic surveillance in the real world. The real world is documented in a seldom-reproduced journal called "Sand", which is occasionally handed to individuals that could understand the contents and know them responsibly. I received a copy of Sand written by a curious organization called Dynamix16. With Keliu's invitation, I sat down and began to read. The words are written as definitions to Zeffonian terminology. The origin of these words is unclear, but they read as follows:
iv. Forest, I
7429FD describes the first city to appear in the world of Zeffon in the year 35. It is called Inejeheim and its first leader is only referenced by the name “Short”. Whether this refers to his height or his name has been forever lost.
Active Origin refers to the moment the Creator came down from a purple star to visit the population in the year 16. He showed humans how to build towns and cities, how to harvest food from the ground, but more importantly, a way to constantly be reborn. This, along with many other things, was recorded in the Book of the Wind, which later became the Wind Book. Most of this book is lost since most of the pages have faded, but it, at one time, chronicled the early years of humanity’s existence.
v. Urn
Untitled refers to the civil war that broke out in the year 38 between the people outside of Inejeheim and the people within it. To defend itself, Inejeheim builds giant walls around the city, and the Creator offers his powers and raises the land underneath it, causing the city to suddenly be located on a high mountain.
vi. Stone Isle Mines
Pathier is an album about a rebellious group who left Inejeheim to die. After the mountains were raised by the Creator, the city fell into ruin as the old citizens of the town could not gather food or materials. The action that had once been seen as a city defense became a… curse. The Creator has not been seen since, and the last person died in the giant bell tower in the center of the afflicted city. According to the Wind Book, his name was Isaac, and he perished in the year 68. The Pathiers were a group that created the town and later city of Uaa, which was located far to the east.
Low refers to the curse that the Creator later put on Inejeheim after its demise. Any man who enters the forbidden city will be torn apart by unknown forces and shall initiate a new age.
Pathier refers to the success of creating Uaa, and the unification of the people thereafter.
Delta is about another conflict that breaks out in the year 79, where the original Pathiers are expelled from the town. The town is then renamed Lavu, and the people who sent their original leaders into exile become the Windy Summit, a group of leaders consisting of nine members. It also refers to the triangle of three kingdoms that exists thereafter (Lavu, Unkardia, and Exeräise).
514 refers to the predicted demise of Lavu, told be a soothsayer named Norfell. Considered a blasphemer, Norfell is expelled to the Chaoslands to the southwest, where he resides in a desert canyon that he names “Du Garma”.
vii. Sogidne
Exp refers to the building of a third, much smaller kingdom of Unkardia. Norfell marries his follower Mathilda, where they have four children named Emeroch, Uaa, Adelais, and Lydia, Lydia being the youngest born in the year 115. A war breaks out between Unkardia and a nation named Exeräise. The people of Exeräise are descendants of six of the original fifteen Pathiers, and they slaughter most of Unkardia in large battles known as grees. Around the year 119, there are only about 60 Unkardians left, who seek refuge in Du Garma Canyon. They create what becomes known as the Fortress of Winds, and Norfell uses much of his former strength to summon a large guardian known as Tereban. The year 120 becomes known as the Year of Tereban, who fends off at least 400 soldiers before the people of Exeräise decide that enough is enough.
..reel refers to the odd behavior of some of the Unkardians, who rebel and build a large city known as Cathrop. The Kingdom of Anne is established in the year 122, with Castle Dränsilane being created in six months. The center of their power apparently lies in the bell that was taken from Inejeheim’s bell tower.
Block 8 refers to an event that causes the people of Exeräise to move across the ocean to create a town named Ghel. People who later encounter their old kingdom find nothing but black sand and a very flat land with no ruins, with the exception of one large tower.

trackinfo.title: River of Wine
trackinfo.lyrics: After I became conscious (again), I realized that not everything was what it seemed. It seemed that everything, including myself was subject to some sort of empire. Soldiers marched around the cells where they held me and Adelais, and I knew nothing about them, thus being unable to affect them with my psychic power. The power is a curse.
trackinfo.credits: from Dleifesor!, released December 27, 2014

trackinfo.title: Underwater Skull
trackinfo.lyrics: I realized that I had no idea who I was anymore. The defiance of the citizens, trying to come up with a solution to their madness was the most painful thing for me to see. VII is the man behind it all. He is the man who gave the original Isga this condition, and thus destroyed humanity for the rest of time. We were banished to Zeffon as a way to keep ourselves isolated from the rest of the world.
trackinfo.credits: from Dleifesor!, released December 27, 2014

trackinfo.title: Woods Atrocity
trackinfo.lyrics: Even though we've tried to get men to exhibit the same level of psychic power as the women, it's impossible. The men are the insane. They have no soul that allows them to undergo the transformation that allows them to become psychic. Thus, it's important to understand that men inherently cannot be on the same level as knowing all else. However, there is one man who has sucked the sanity like blood from a wound from all the other men and kept it for himself, and his name is Roanin.
trackinfo.credits: from Dleifesor!, released December 27, 2014

Zeffon.title: Dustgaze
Zeffon.about:
I climbed up the hill looking for the Dragänsword, given that I had no other choice. The gloom widows would always kill and slowly devour all who climbed the mountain. I still needed the sword. I didn't think hard about it, however. Soon, I was surrounded by yellow spiders, each wanting to tear me apart. I ran down the hill, but I couldn't find where I had initially come from. My friend was waiting there and I needed to inform him of the imminent danger. I quickly became dizzy and collapsed on the ground. The spiders came over me with their feelers and fangs. The end was neigh.
Another person tried to enter Dragös recently. He was ripped apart like that fool who tried to ascend the hill for the Dragänsword. None of those people seemed to comprehend the danger of merely living in this world. They had come from a place known as the outside. A place where there was actually peace and stability. Not with this man Dränsilane screwing up all of time and space with his dreams. I'll probably expire soon as well. We always do. No matter, though. I'll be where I was within a few hours.
I think I may have found the source of the Frogplain. It lies in Du Garma Canyon.
***Thoughts are coming through the ether like flies. We swat them down and there's always more. This project will kill us eventually. Not that there was any hope of making it back to Earth.***
Yes, we found an entrance to the Frogplain. It will only last for a few seconds. We're sending a microphone down into the dimensional portal to see what's going on in there. This might be our chance.
***Thoughts are coming through the ether like flies. We swat them down and there's always more. This project will kill us eventually. Not that there was any hope of making it back to Earth.***

Hey, you guys. Don't do anything stupid. I'm monitoring you all.
KELIU, I'm calling this off. There's way too much static to safely descend. Feel free to monitor the activity, but this recording should be the state of things for a while. Out.

trackinfo.title: REC: Agent Preview
trackinfo.lyrics: The then-new captain of the Sulka, an eagle named Sebastian, gave Ophelia a healing remedy meant to cure her rotten arms, but this, after many days, did nothing except make the rot worse. When Sebastian flew up to visit Ophelia in the medical tower, her eyes were glassy and cloudy like marble, but a third eye had developed and opened right above the bridge of her nose. It did nothing but stare. Horrified, Sebastian was suddenly enveloped by a vision, being attacked by moths that crawled out of a crack in space and time, and devoured his feathers and flesh. Sebastian woke up and plummeted to the ground from the medical tower, feeling too lethargic and sickened to open his wings.
trackinfo.credits: from Dustgaze, released November 1, 2014

Zeffon.title: Dynamix16
Zeffon.about:
The last album in the first part of the Zeffon story, marking the end of a particular era and the beginning of a newer phase. In this album, a certain someone's selfish feelings for another cause him to make a sadistic machine that allows him to simulate a universe. It's later that he realizes that he never existed until the point he pushed the button that started the whole thing.
i. Rose of Many Thorns
The new temple Vagaah was created to commemorate the trials and the exploits of the third eye and god, whose name cannot be mentioned beyond a certain number of times. He is the god of chaos, but also a god of peace, and a walker of the wheel.
ii. Sadist Snowfall
The last battle would occur near the odd compartments that were underneath the Temple Vagaah. They were intended to house the spirits of the dead, but then expanded to house the Last Soldier of Eresymcaion. Eresymcaion became the last of its kind, fighting for the balance of light over darkness. The fifth dream reflects this: the aforementioned mysterious guest was a person from the organization known as Dynamix16.

Zeffon.title: Elusive BT-7 (Part I)
Zeffon.about:
i. He Was... (Part I of II)
Fair was a twinless twin with a birth defect distorting his right ear. Other than that, that's all Igen tells us about Fair's appearence. According to Lauren, Beatrice, another one of the librarians says that Igen named Fair because she believed that he would grow into a "doer of good".
ii. Understanding
Fair went to a misty lake at one point and found an armless corpse floating in it. According to Fair's diary, the cuts were very smooth, just below the elbow. Lydia Isga appearently interprets the corpse to be that of the father of Meddin's master craftsman, since in the Kingdom of Meddin, which has disappeared, he was the only disappearance under "strange circumstances". Also, the new Inejeheim from our current dimension kept two public logs from Meddin: a death book for the names of those who passed, and an "undeath book", apparently a conformation log for those who have been "resurrected".
iii. His Heart Was Out For Her
Lydia believes the corpse in Fair's Inejeheim is in fact the elder master craftsman from Meddin, because of the "Undeath Book". Although illegible to everyone except Lydia Isga, there is a page dedicated to what is known as "exp". In Block 8 (there are 8 blocks of text total), there is mention of a man who was taken from his home, despite protests from his son.
iv. Ritualistic Suicide (12'' Chopped Mix)
While Blocks 1-5 and 7 make mention of this experiment's potential, Block 8 talks about how the man died before the "experiment" could proceed further. It even discusses the increase of brain impulses when the man's arms were amputated. Clearly it was torture. But why?
v. Grandeur (Part I of II)
Lydia suggests that the man was a handroteim and an important individual who was amputated to prevent the rot from spreading from his hands (at least in theory). Adelais suggests it was more in self defense.
vi. A White Glassy Liquid (Shellshock Tribute, Part II of II)
However, a handroteim is never truly dead. According to The Tales of Inejeheim and Igen, the week after the elder master craftsman's death, dead bodies of the Pathiers involved began to turn up in odd places.
vii. Displaced Electricity
Igen mentions her father, the Lord of East Inejeheim, had become a handroteim and killed most of the Pathiers in the town. This is considered debatable. The interesting thing I've considered as well is that Inejeheim has existed twice - as a small kingdom of the Pathiers on the continent of Mödgod, a dreary rainy continent south of Värta, and a town on the Mountain of Shadow.

Zeffon.title: Elusive BT-7 (Part II)
Zeffon.about:
i. Hand Trap
The Mountain of Shadow was named post the exodus of the Pathiers. Before then, it was called Northane Mountain, the traditional name that was borrowed for the castle west of the Seraph Territories and south of here, a castle that suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
ii. Orhmesaou 3
Supposedly, the elder master craftsman was identified by a coffin with the name "Vot" on it. Although the remains were never exhumed for further inspection, the Pathier curse lining the coffin's mausoleum's walls was enough to expel even the hardiest of adventurers.
iii. Tertiary Proteins 4 (Part IV of IV)
Supposedly, the curse is one of death and fear: anyone who reads the letters in the stone will be attacked by the same beast that attacked Vot. What this beast is is a mystery, and unfortunately, Miss Lauren declined to share that information with me, as she went pale when I asked her for the beast's name.
iv. Small Grotto
Related to the Vot family who owned a large, damp ranch in some of the flatland on Mödgod was the Vah family of very similar name. They supposedly relied on the power of a scary wooden mask to kidnap the Vot family's cattle. The Vah family were supposedly unmoved by the theory that the elder Vot was a handroteim.

Zeffon.title: Exeräise
Zeffon.about:
i. Mesmerize (Intro)
He was a man of fort'nate circumstance
Of cunning wit of greater quality
Intellect was at his sight amusèd
Appearance bribing judgement over he
And so combinèd with a crew of steel
By ship new land he set off to reveal
~
At least, I think that’s how the poem went…
ii. The Cloaked Stranger
In the past, even before the days of the great Archer Revenge, there was a man named Ryan. He had had his wife Yvonne taken from him when they had barely married. Ryan also lost his hand that day, pursing Yvonne’s captors. He began searching for the mysterious abductors, but over the years, he didn’t find anyone. Much like as in the past, a mysterious person appeared on the isle of Anne. He didn’t know why he was there, but he knew there was something he needed to do. A ghost appeared, confirming his instinct, beckoning the man to join him on a trip to Castle Dränsilane.
iii. Shrouded Woods
On his way through the woods atop the mountains on Anne, he swears he sees a figure of a woman through the forest, but then believes he is mistaken.
iv. Reve
The man is taken to the depths of Castle Dränsilane by the ghost. The ghost informs him that he is no ordinary man.
”You’ve lost your memory, haven’t you?”
The man nodded.
”And your voice for that matter…?”
The man nodded again.
”Now you have a destiny to fulfill, you. It is in Lavu that you will find a beautiful…”
The ghost appeared to be silent for a split second.
”A… beautiful woman named Reve. You can see it too, can’t you?”
The man nodded.
”Yes… Continue on this path in your mind. Here, you will find eternal salvation. You will rule a kingdom, young man. This kingdom will be the bane of all darkness.”
~
On a mountain pass, below the stars, under the deepest ocean, behind the tallest grassy hill, lies a cave that harnesses the power of the universe. At least, the idol inside it does. Why this power was granted to the Earth may be the mystery of the entire universe. In fact, this idol does not exist, and neither does the cave, for a cave lying where it does would have surely been impossible. And yet, there it is. It stays there, taunting those who cannot reach it, and those who desire the contents within it. This is the Cave of Origin, lying on the infamous Lantern Island. The island itself has only been visited twice. It supposedly lies west of Toú Island, according to the sailors that have made it there. Unfortunately, that was around the time of the reign of the Isgas, leaving very few people to actually put any sort of credence into the story. Not that it was believable anyway. In the history of man (or woman in this case), there was a person born on Lantern Island.

A lot of the albums by Zeffon as of late are inspired by my apathy toward awful American politics. Extermination Extermination Extermination is derived from the idea that encouraging discrimination would inspire culling and killing of certain groups for example. Exercise 08.O is derived from conspirators' conclusions about Jade Helm 15 and a hypothetical scenario about a mass genocide in Texas.
My music has always had political metaphors, but ever since late 2014, they've been more direct.

Zeffon.title: Exp
Zeffon.about:
////// From Dränsilane's Disynxiym:
i. ..reel
Later on, life continued as normal. Kerragan quickly became better, claiming that he had no idea what came over him. In any case, the Windy Summit was unconcerned, except for one of them. Kerragan was the most “decent” of all the members of Lavu’s rule, making him a bit of an outcast. Governor No. 8, Félix Oarr had taken note of Kerragan’s passive ruling style, and had informed the five officials that ranked higher than Kerragan of the situation. The others simply laughed. They said “Passiveness? A threat?” and kept laughing, as if the matter was an incredibly trivial thing. Those pests were simply not doing their jobs. Félix decided to contact the leader of the Kingdom of Lavu. He would understand what was going on.
"Roanin!"
The sleeping boy suddenly leaped to his feet. The crickets and frogs were beginning to make their presences known. Somewhere in the distance, a wolf howled at the moon. Roanin quickly realized that it was no longer sunset.
"I've been trying to wake you up for hours, Roanin! You need to stop doing that!" said Nightmare.
"Sorry, Nightmare. I... I don't know what came over me."
"You're lucky we're friends, or I would have left you alone a long time ago."
Roanin got on Nightmare’s back and the pair began a fast-paced ride out of the forest. Across the river, a cool breeze moved over a human skeleton that was sprawled out on a dry riverbed, as if crawling around for water. Luckily, Roanin never spotted it.
ii. Block 8
Luckily, for the sanity of all of those who had keenly observed the antics of the Lavulese public, the public was released from the restrictions of their unquestioning demeanor during the time period of the next night. The public began to not only question what was going on with the Windy Summit, but where they had been this whole time, as they had not been fully conscious until now. The leader of the Lavulese people who lived in Refeaël seemed to have very little to say regarding this phenomenon. As the people began to revolt, Governor No. 0 just sat back and watched. There was no reason for him to cater to his so called “Windy Summit”. If the people were organizing a revolution, it was the fault of their government for being so incompetent. Governor No. 0 laughed. It was a time for the new age. A new age where he would truly be in control of everything, from the planet Earth, to the distant galaxies beyond it. Of course, there were a couple of things to be aware of when it came to his plan, but it didn’t matter at this point. He would simply kill his former accomplice and then not be obligated towards sharing what he rightfully deserved. With about 30 seconds left until execution, Governor No. 0 downed a small drink. There wouldn’t be a lot of these where he was going. As the clock wound down, time began to distort slightly, but the artifact that he had found assured him that what he was about to do would be stable. With that, the clock hit zero, and the entire universe was annihilated before reappearing just as quickly and restablizing.
In a quick summary, the forests are eternal.
Despite the flow and river of time
Despite the tragedy of Omua, the one of the North
They will be forever more.

Tereban created the people of Anne with his own four hands.
Following the people’s failure to destroy him,
He created Cathrop
From there, he created two voidmasters, Kerragan and Lloyd
These two could summon emptiness at will.
And with their help,
The people of Cathrop were neutralized.
Under the sea,
Under Hell,
The Lunar Plane had condensed into another being,
This being was the Beast of Para,
It also spawned the Uaa,
Before it collapsed,
Sanity was lost,
Except for the Uaa.
The Lunar Plane then rose in the sky
And became the moon we know today.
The moon watches over all of us,
And makes certain that even in darkness,
There is still hope.

The moon watches over all of us,

The Uaa figured this out a long time ago,
But Dränsilane did as well.
Because we are all linked to a cell in the Human Overmind,
We are not human any longer.

Wandering through the universe,

Zeffon.title: Experiment
Zeffon.about:
This album was created after stalling for too long after Chaosfoundry. In this release, a certain research project is being carried out in the Kingdom of Lavu.
i. Research Project (Single)
The world around Rasoe was changing around that time. Roanin had finally come to terms with his mother Opehla’s death, though he wished he could’ve been by her side when it happened. Nightmare was nowhere to be seen either. The horse hadn’t been present ever since it jumped off a cliff. Rowland, Roanin’s father, was dead too. It was only the next spring that something odd happened. While searching for Nightmare in the woods, Roanin instead came across a mirror image of himself. Roanin had heard of people in his village seeing clones of themselves, and they were undeniably aggressive, as if the villagers themselves had wronged them somehow. This clone however, seemed sad.

Zeffon.title: Fate
Zeffon.about:
i. Requiem
Part three of Kerragan's dream sequence. In this one, Kerragan sees himself as part of a secret project, being an informer for Sharhodeon.
A sudden pulse of sound was the signal. Creator had revived Derek Unmattias. Kerragan suddenly woke up yet again. Upon inspection, he discovered that he was on a large floating island. There was lava below it, as far as the eye could see. Was this an illusion? His instincts told him that it was.
”So, you’ve woken up again.”
”Who’s there?”
”Just someone you know fairly well. I’m surprised that you’ve gone and taken my body from me, Emeroch. Or should I say, Kerragan.”
”Dränsilane?!”
”Yes, it’s me, the spirit of your brother. Had you waited long enough for me, I would have granted you the use of the body of the miserable wretch you now inhabit.”
”I couldn’t resist, Dränsilane, I swear. The opportunity presented itself, and I took my chances.”
”Are you begging?”
”What?”
”It just belies your obvious talent to beg to me, your older brother. I’m not angry, Emeroch. I’m just concerned for your safety. We operate as a twosome, and I could never have gotten as far as we have solo. But that’s beside the point. My Instinct tells me that you’re in danger.”
”Instinct? That was a failed experiment, Dränsilane.”
”Only because we were unable to hone it all the way. It is still at 85 percent capacity in my body. I’ve still been able to walk on water as well, so I think that anything it tries to peddle off as fact is fairly reliable. Did you get hit by Reve’s bastard sword?”
”Only once. It’s a light scratch on my hand, but… Wait.”
”Now you’re seeing it.”
”So if she went behind the mirror to retrieve that sword, based on our theories, I’m bound for the Wysteriascape, aren’t I?”
”Probably. That was a poisoned blade, Emeroch. It’s the same bastard sword that Unknown Iahae retrieved from the beach, and the same one that Ross received from the burning rubble that was the Temple of the Sun. The people of the Wysteriascape tainted the sword with a parasite that will control the victim’s motor skills and guide him back to the civilization. Remember Lloyd Cathrop? He came down with Gondii Maledicta as well.”
”So I’m currently wondering if I should resist these visions I’m having, or I should go with it and find myself in the Wysteriascape when I truly wake up.”
”Now that you mention it, there is the power of immorality in that city. If you think you can make it home, Emeroch…”
”I should fare just fine.”
ii. Opal Resistor
”Perhaps it was because Unknown Iahae ran away,” though Kerragan to himself. “That’s probably why the people of the Wysteriascape wanted to give him Gondii Maledicta, so he could face charges back home. But why was the Wysteriascape so afraid to see the future? A few prophets could never hurt anyone with their visions.” Walking along the isle was becoming tedious. It was one thing for Gondii Maledicta to be affecting Kerragan’s vision and mind, but it was another when the vision wasn’t progressing at all. How long would it take for the Wysteriascape to rear its ugly head? It seemed that was a question to ask later. Kerragan decided to sleep for the time being. Surely something would happen that would solve his annoying dilemma.
iii. End of Square Unit
A long time ago, in an unknown part of time, two gods dueled ferociously. The entangled battlers would summon forces of light and darkness to destroy the other’s armies. Muagara, the god of darkness, was unparalleled and unrivaled in all the universe as an omnipotent being of power. The much more feeble god of light, Eresymcaion, would be defeated time and time again by his dark counterpart. This was the story of a millennium where time was both continually flowing and had stopped completely. This was the Revenence.
iv. Oracle
And who am I to know such things? I am the one who was and still is the immortal sage and oracle of the town of Viandor. Unlike many other locations on the Earth, Viandor has very little history. It is more of a trading town, with people coming and going. No excessive labyrinths, no giant towers, just a cluster of stone houses carved into the cliffs beside the Putrid Sea. It’s not always comfortable, but it’s where I’ve resided for thousands of years, silently watching from the sidelines, so it’s comfortable enough.
v. Magic Cube
In this time and place, I reside six days from the end of the world. Today, it is December 26, 9999. When the year 10000 comes into being, according to the irreversible prophecies of Kerragan Cathrop, the universe shall cease to exist in the blink of an eye. How should I know? Once again, I am an oracle. Like it or not, I know all. But in this case, I know these things because they’re my prophecies. I created them. Yes, that’s right. I am technically Kerragan Cathrop, although that’s a name for myself that I threw away a long time ago. My name now is my original name, Harris. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
vi. Research Project
Long ago, even before the epic battles of Muagara and Eresymcaion, there was a man named Félix Oarr. He was one of the nine governors of Lavu, number eight to be exact. He was also a sort of loose screw that loved to tinker with his science experiments. One day, he invited a man named Derek Unmattias to his lab for what was supposed to be a routine checkup, since Félix Oarr was supposedly a doctor. Unfortunately, he couldn’t help but want to experiment on this poor innocent man, and thus, he whipped out his pair of scissors, tied Derek to a chair, and began to make some “alterations”. I was aware of this atrocity at the time it was happening, since I lived in Lavu at the time. I didn’t do anything, though, since I can’t stop every single bad thing that occurs. As I said, I’m not a fighter or a superhero, I’m just an observer. In the end, Derek looked sort of like a raw piece of meat, but was still alive. The idea behind Félix Oarr’s madness was sort of a test to see how far the human body could be pushed before it just gave up. But now, I wish I had intervened when I could have.
vii. Fate
Then, a man entered the room and stabbed Félix Oarr with a dagger that he had ironically found lying around his containment unit and untied the pitiful Mr. Unmattias. The man, a experimental prisoner of Félix who called himself Creator, would escort Derek to an island called Exeräise, where the two would plot their revenge. But first, they drowned the wounded Félix Oarr in the Great Marsh. With powers that Creator had received from his own Instinct, he gave Derek Félix Oarr’s body, while the empty limbless husk that was Derek’s body was allowed to float away. Now, Félix Oarr was only instated as Governor No. 8 because he was family to then Governor No. 6, Kerragan Cathrop. So in order to get revenge, the two decided that killing his step-brother was not enough. After he had had his two children with his wife Reve, he was distraught to find that their baby daughter had been whisked away by the Isga brothers. But they never died because of their sadness. In fact, they were murdered. It was tragedy to be sure. But then I did something stupid. Vari Cathrop, the son who was hailed as Kerragan’s successor, went back in time. That was the first thing, despite my being an oracle, that I could not fortell. He used the Weeping Oaken Tree within the Great Marsh, a tree that had been around since the beginning of time. Surprisingly, he had grown acquainted with the tree and its powers, and knew what it could do, and therefore went into the past in order to make things right. I created a mindless clone of his father to pursue him, and soon, it was chasing after him in the past. But then it occurred to me that Félix Oarr was not as stupid as I had previously thought. Although my name is Harris and Kerragan Cathrop, it is also Creator. It is also reasonable to consider, that even though I created time and space, that I should be privileged to watch over it, experiment with it, and execute its demise. Unfortunately for you, I’m done with this world. You cannot change your fate.

released February 11, 2012

Zeffon.title: Flight of the Ivramoth
Zeffon.about:
i. Poison
Suddenly, there's a thunderclap, and rain begins to pour from the sky. Your instincts tell you this is no ordinary rain. Either that, or it's the workers outside that suddenly burst into flames. One of those two.
"Holy..."
Mr. Paragi stands there, unmoving. The sight and smell of burning flesh causes him to faint. You don't. You've seen this kind of thing before. You begin to ponder amid the tortured screams and convicts dashing into the cave with chemical burns. It reminds you of your adventures in Unkardia.
The rain begins to settle. As you think further, you suddenly feel compelled to help the poor souls that lie on the rocks, breathing heavily. Then, practically at the same time, you decide not to. You instead receive a strong prompting. There's practically no one who could stop you at this point. You could take the finds of the dig for yourself.
"Groan..."
Ulysses Paragi lies there, but is apparently awake now. How troublesome. You pull out your revolver, intent on shooting him. He was never a good ally anyway...
*BANG*
ii. Helminthophobia Radio
You wake up. You can't see, and your head hurts. You move your tongue around. The inside of your mouth is caked with blood. Your vision slowly begins to return to you, as well as your hearing. You begin to hear what sounds like a steam machine on a horrible record. As you look around the cave you're in, you see skeletons, probably those of your own workers. Then it hits you.
"That Kerragan... He SHOT me!"
Your shout reverberates through the cavern. A voice responds.
"Echo!"
"What?"
"Echo!!"
You head to the source of the sound. In a room, there's a table and a record playing on a small record player. One you've heard before, but not in a long time. There's a man sitting inside the room in a chair, holding a trumpet. A blood-stained knife rests on the table.
iii. Dirt
The record stops, and the man gets up and changes it. He doesn't seem to notice you, and adjusts the pitch settings on the player to match that of the old vinyl. You want to speak, but your throat hurts, especially after yelling about that treacherous Kerragan. Suddenly, the man speaks.
iv. Untitled
"Hello, lovely. You find your spice shiny, eh?"
"What?" You try not to speak too loud.
"Oh, right. That's my drug self. Let's start over. I'm me. And you?"
"Uhhh... Ulysses... Para..."
The man interrupts you.
"Ibiksis Island is a mighty fine neighborhood, ain't it, Mister Paragi?"
You're confused. The man looks confused too. Apparently, the feeling's mutual.
The record stops. The man picks it off the player and puts another one on. This one you definitely recognize. It's a heavily damaged vinyl of "Treasure Trove", by an experimental artist in the Seraph Territories, one whose name you can't remember. The man suddenly slaps himself and drinks out of a leather pouch. He slaps himself again, this time harder.
"Bahhh... Got to stop it with all this alcohol. It's like I depend on it..."
He suddenly looks up.
"Oh hi! I didn't realize I had visito... Holy crap, you have blood running out of your mouth! Are you sure you're okay?
You had briefly forgotten that you had been shot. You feel around the back of your head for a bullet hole, but you fail to find one. Instead you wipe your chin.
"I'm fine..."
"Ah, good. That's kind of scary to see. So who are you?"
"Ulysses Paragi."
"Ah, okay. Where are you from?"
"Uh... Didn't you just find that out...?"
"No."
"Ibiksis Island. I'm the leader of that country."
The man seems confused. Then he reaches for the leather pouch and offers you a drink.
"Here. You'll probably want this."
"What is it?"
"It's a concoction I've made..."
"A concoction?"
"Yes. If you've been wounded out you, you need to protect yourself from... er... infections. It does send you for a loop, though."
The record stops playing. Suddenly the man looks about.
"There's been another execution."
"What?"
"Another one. It's a man from the Seraph Territories. He's been executed."
You don't what to conclude from this man's antics.
The man leaps up and grabs his knife. "I have to go," he says. "There's something I need to do."
He then looks at you.
"Actually, could you come along? I could use a wingman."
"For what?"
"Oh, you know. Leverage. Scare tactics. Assassinations."
"Who are you?"
He looks as though he's forgotten something. Snatching his trumpet off the table, he looks you. Despite the lack of dialogue, you instantly understand. This is Dr. Uy.

Zeffon.title: Fluid Compression
Zeffon.about:
i. Space Patrol
There's an interesting friend that I have who is interested in the Vah craftsman, whoever that may be. He's a very curious individual, which makes me think that he's going to get in trouble someday, experimenting with how far he can get into Inejeheim's West Castle before getting caught.
ii. Scared Coyotes
There were some coyotes that used to come around the base of the West Castle. Now they're gone. Some say it's because they got scared off by the sounds that occasionally come through the walls of the castle. It's some sort of high-pitched screech, but whatever it is, it seems to drive the coyotes away.
iii. Lumina
In the top tower of the West Castle, there's a small princess who was born a few years back. She's still a toddler, but she's treated with loads of respect, maybe even excessive amounts of that. The girl's name is Lumina, and the reason she obtains this respect is due to the things she can see and hear. Just like with the scared coyotes, there's something in the walls of the West Castle, something strange.
iv. Zeraad Nothias
The odd sounds the eminate from the walls seem to suggest that there is more to the West Castle than meets the eye. There's a large staircase to the throne room that has three steps that are much larger than the others. On these steps, the letters M, R, and S are engraved. If you tap your foot on the M, you will hear that it is hollow.
v. Zeraad Olicaratid
Many things have been found in the West Castle already. After going through one of the castle's walls, a secret room was found with no discernable entrance, as if it had been walled off intentionally. There was nothing in it save for a fireplace. Although physical items were sparce, strange groaning could be heard from the room at night. A rank decaying smell could also be detected, suggesting that the room was probably used by a handroteim in the past.
vi. Claire
The answer was found in the East Castle's vast library. The West Castle's queen became a handroteim at the break of the 515th year of the first century. She, in order to keep herself from going insane, walled herself up in a room with a special fireplace meant to burn some sort of herbal remedy, a remedy that worked through combustion. No trace of the queen was found in the castle after several years, although the stench was quite detestable and prevailent. Eventually, the queen found some sort of way out of her predicament, trusting a soothsayer to heal her. When the soothsayer was let into the room, the queen went mad, attacking the man and the guards near him. Eventually, heavily armored guards rushed in and chased the rabidly insane queen into the woods, where she supposedly lived until her demise. After this turn of events, strange bird noises could always be heard from the woods, deterring many who might have entered.
vii. Zeraad Bochaulade
More interest came into this story when groaning and chanting could be heard in the castle halls. Lumina, the small princess, was constantly pointing at a specific part of the wall in the main hall, as if she saw something behind it.
viii. Garitamao
Eventually, the noises became disconcerting enough that the guards broke down the castle wall where Lumina had been pointing. In it, they found a small hidden chamber full of old-fashioned clothes that had been preserved by the lack of oxygen. A terrible stale smell came rushing out of the chamber as soon as it was opened, causing many in the room to gag. Then, underneath all the assorted clothes, a small chest was found. In it was a small vial full of an oily rainbow-colored liquid. The royal scientist didn't know what the make of it, but took it to has laboratory regardless. The day after, the royal scientist broke down mentally, pointing at the sky and trembling, saying the word "AGOR!" over and over. The vial was examined and found to have turned into a spongy grey solid.
ix. Zeraad Proteizen
Although everyone expected that the doctor had done some sort of experiment that had gone terribly wrong, the people in the room, especially the ones who had examined the vial, had to be placed in a bed out of sickness.
x. Zerrad Youa
The vial went missing the next day, along with Lumina. There was a note left behind by someone in the lab. It said something about the vial being poison, but the words were mostly eligible. The doctor changed as well. He had stopped screaming, and had returned to normal, except for one thing. He told people he was looking for "her".
xi. Lineao
Lumina was never found. Instead, one night, on her bed, the mysterious vial of poison was found, empty. The person who found it walked into the main hallway, only to find the most grotesque-looking humanoid he had ever seen standing on one of the three large steps. It was covered in rotting hair, tentacles, and eyes that shifted rapidly, as if frantically looking at their surroundings. The servant screamed and ran into the royal chamber, telling everyone of the imminent danger.
xii. Zeraad Unliaad
Everyone ran back, only to find a puddle of green liquid where the creature once stood. The letters on the three large steps had been used to create words, whose additional letters were scratched out in the stone. The message said:
"MUST"
"REVILED"
"SUN"

Zeffon.title: Fomitiporia ellipsoidea
Zeffon.about:
i. Fomitiporia ellipsoidea
In this song, the Unknown Beast that was released suddenly splits into two gods: Eresymcaion, the god of light, and Muagara, the god of darkness. It is here that the epic battles of the gods begin to occur. That is what has been said anyhow.
Reve Terra Lyeon escaped with a young man into the northern lands. I don't know what Reve is after, but I get the feeling that she must be stopped. They're head for the rainy ruined town of Daryu. Hidden beneath that town is the Fire Element, the old relic from the times of Dotajmari. The Fire Element must not be disturbed, lest the power of the ancient town be awakened. Then again, the Fire Element might be what gave the people of Unkardia their psychic powers in the first place, so it's possible that the element was already disturbed all this time.
There can only be one sentient being and that is me. New priority: destroy Reve and revive Chyi.

Zeffon.title: Forward!
Zeffon.about:
This is the last part of Dead Drums & Popular Propaganda Plus Tribal Politics. It's a story about a boy who lives on a small island called Toú. The boy journeys to an island nation called Vahn via a small boat he made himself. The people treat him as one of their own, but he panics due to the intense culture shock of transitioning from solitary life to a full-fledged society. The people concerned for his welfare decide to Exorcise him and remove the afflicting spirits from his body. This does little to help the boy, who decides to swim off the island and make his way back home. His corpse is found 5 days later on the water. He has no water in his system, but he is found to have a cloth stuffed in one of his pockets that says "Exeräise". A murder investigation is started and the police find a previously unknown and uncharted island with two non-natives living among the rest of the people. The two non-natives say that they found a boy who had washed up on the beach who was breathing and strangled him. They apparently did not desire anyone to find them; it was too risky. They said they had sailed away from Unkardia to Anne, and then from the abandoned city of Cathrop to this isle. The natives were apparently very hospitable.
The police sail back to the Isle of Daei and the nation of Vahn with the two culprits with them. Upon their arrival, the suspects are found guilty of murder and sentenced to prison. When the two suspects are chained up, a black fog enters the prison and suffocates the jailers. The two suspects use the opportunity to escape and run to the marsh south of Vahn, the only part of the island left uninhabited due to its horrid black fog. The prisoners were never found, but it is said that a god had mercy on them and let them ascend to heaven. This was told after the wooden tower housing various Vahnian relics was struck by lightning and burned to the ground. A second tower was then closed to prevent any other casualties.

Zeffon.title: Found Stripped of Dignified Time (Shorelines II Alt.)
Zeffon.about:
archivist's note: this album is essentially a tape rip of the Shorelines II cassette. This item is the conclusion and ending of the Shorelines body of works.
Oswel woke up and quickly put on some clothes. Catherine and the twins were still asleep, thank goodness. An eerie wind whistled through some of the rafters of the house. It was probably going to be good to get the roof secured for the winter. Some of the foliage snapped outside, and Oswel knew that there was something there - Joachim wouldn't arose any suspicions unless he knew that something was coming. Quickly, Oswel grabbed a sword that had belonged to some ancestor of his. The carving in the wood that made the grip glowed very faintly, and Oswel had his confirmation that this something meant business. Oswel went outside and clutched the sword closely, like it was his only lifeline. The rune carving made a small hum as it glowed feebly against what appeared to be an unnaturally dark night. If he were to die, it would be him and him alone. The beast had to leave Catherine and his daughters alone. Please, let it be true. Hearing footsteps behind him, Oswel whirled around with the sword pointed at what was clearly a man with longish hear that flowed slightly around his ears. The warding rune in Oswel's wooden grip hissed erratically, and suddenly broke with a sharp pop. As the arcane glow was extinguished, Oswel saw the man, but also so freakish abominations that filled the hills behind him, ones that he could only describe as demons. The man tilted his head and asked why Oswel seemed so afraid. Morgan would wake up very soon and would talk to him imminently. Feeling the sheer pressure of the dark forces around him smother and suffocate him, Oswel had no choice but to oblige.

Zeffon.title: Frogcatcher
Zeffon.about:
Frogcatcher was originally called Catoblepas II, but was later changed.
The story takes place in the year 1423, following the collapse of the Kingdom of Lavu...
i. Visual Decay
Domnik, the former High Governor of Lavu, flees his country while it is in the midst of a revolution. He receives help from the Seraph Territories, his only remaining ally. The Seraph Territories begin to use harsh political rhetoric to make way for Domnik's escape, threatening to use chemical weapons if they are invaded. Domnik himself recalls one of the now-deceased Kerragan's prophecies about the fall of his empire.
ii. Ymousdeluge
In the harbor, Domnik boards a ship called the Red Anchor. When the ship departs, an anonymous man tells Domnik that the Seraph Territories has betrayed him. Instead of Unkardia, the ship is bound for Sharhodeon, where Domnik will be put on trial for crimes against humanity.
"Who are you?"
"No one you need to know."
The man quickly disappears into a crowd of people. Domnik tries to follow, but loses him.
iii. Decaying Angel (Reprise)
Later, during a long night on the ship, a sailor discovers the captain has been brutally murdered, with various body parts strewn about the bridge.
iv. XIII: Xezbr
One of two pieces of the Serenade for the Dead that Domnik took with him from Lavu.
v. Mind?
Domnik wakes up and finds that there's no one on the ship that was full of passengers. He figures he's hallucinating, but as he continues to search, there's no sign of anyone.
vi. Hidden Era
It becomes clear why there's no one on the ship soon enough. Domnik is approached by ghosts, yet remains unfazed.
vii. Ghost of Someone Else, Long Since Dead
The leader of all the other ghosts comes forth. He explains that the ship has just passed through a dimensional vortex in the middle of the Putrid Sea, effectively killing the crew and their companions, as well as all the passengers. The reason Domnik isn't dead is apparently due to his Pathierian blood, the technological race who mastered the art of traveling from world to world. As for their current location, they are now in Graghgorra.
viii. Conrad Small
Meanwhile, Conrad Small, former governor No. 2 of the collapsed Kingdom of Lavu still lives in tranquility, despite the massive bounty slapped on his head. This is due to the massive effort that the Lavulese government always undertook to protect their identities; no one knew who they were or are.
ix. Magnamout
Secretly however, Conrad searches for Governor No. 1. He wishes to reform the broken empire elsewhere, along with their followers.
x. Repominae
Conrad embarks on a journey from the luxury of the former capital city of Lavu to the Seraph Territories to learn about Domnik's whereabouts. Suddenly, when he is approached by two gentlemen when he arrives in La Mont, he is stabbed and beaten. The police quickly arrive at the scene and Conrad is hospitalized.
xi. Poisoned Glass
A bedridden Governor No. 2 is force-fed poison in the hospital by doctors due to "orders". Conrad Small quickly passes away.
xii. XI: Opehla Goesiadu Garma
The other piece of the Serenade of the Dead that Domnik escaped with.
xiii. Lakeside Cabin
When the sun goes down, a mysterious man steals Conrad's body from the city morgue. From there, he carries it on his shoulder and takes it to his lakeside cabin in the Miamat Wastelands...
xiv. Frogcatcher
...And another night passes with no one knowing or seeing...
xv. Vapuora
Back in Graghgorra, after trudging through miles of marshes following the head ghost, Domnik makes it to a place where the sun actually shines through the eternal clouds. As his eyes follow the ray of sunlight down to the ground up ahead, he sees an old radio tower with a satellite dish on top of it. He approaches the tower, and finds that it has been abandoned for years and years and years. The ghost tells him that this is the home of the Pathiers, planet Earth.
xvi. The Emperor's Facility
A little farther past the radio tower is a large plain. A large green light glows in the distance and seems to be talking and beckoning that Domnik approach it. Regardless of his walking towards it, it seems to be getting farther away...
xvii. Bogman
Meanwhile, Dr. Uy continues to venture that Bogman is a member of the sky civilization, one who continues to pretend that he's nothing more than a swamp creature.
