Zeffon.title: Industrial Sector
Zeffon.about:
Industrial Sector (Written February 25, 2016)
Something has come over me lately. I am not who I believe myself to be. Let me explain further: my uncle’s premature death came about on the 5th of May. I would’ve loved to think that I would have reacted quite bitterly to the news, since my uncle was the best of my remaining friends. But I didn’t. When my uncle died, I felt as though my world changed for the better.
“You seem rather excited…” my friend John said with a smile. His voice trailed off as he examined my demeanor more closely, as if to bite back his words. I smirked.
“He’s dead, Johnny. My uncle’s dead.”
“I’m sorry to hear that.” I could tell Johnny knew I wasn’t crazy. I was genuinely happy about this revelation, this gift.
My friend continued to talk, but I began to tune him out, just like Gregory, the dumb bird that Johnny had found abandoned in an alleyway next to the apartment, cage and all. What was that thing doing here? It just squawked all day while sitting in the corner of the room. Eventually, I had done us both the favor of putting a tablecloth over him, but even the dark apparently meant nothing to the likes of old Greg. He would not shut up.
“Are you still there, bud?” John looked distressed.
“Yeah, just thinkin’.” I said, a little bit uneasily. “My family’s basically dead, and I’m happy about it. What is wrong with me?” This was honest.
John looked over his shoulder and then back at me. Gregory had fallen asleep for the first time in our company that we could remember.
“Darren. There’s a lot of talk going on at the factory.”
“What factory?”
“The one we work at, Darren. How could you forget that?”
It was true. I had forgotten that I had a job.
“I dunno,” I said. “I jus’, I don’t know. I feel like something’s changed.”
John put his hand on my shoulder and told me everything was going to be all right. I chuckled as he moved towards the kitchen. The factory was quite a job. 18 hours was a typical shift at that place. At midday, a group of examiners would come in for about thirty minutes and peer at everyone through large, round glasses that magnified their eyes to a level of uncomfortable detail. I was told by my supervisor that these examiners had moved in near the factory to help make sure that safety protocols were up to date. I believed that this was honest.
The factory made boxes that came from a conveyor belt that passed through a hole in the wall to the factory’s other main assembly area. We had always been in Assembly Area Y1, so I had never seen the other room; the other workers barely acknowledged it existed. They just continued about the mundane task of taping these cardboard boxes together with no idea of what was inside them and who was working in the other assembly area, who were obviously privy to the secret, forbidden content of the boxes.
John was right though. Despite the other workers’ quiet, unquestioning obedience, there was a lot of talk going on at the factory. The other workers had come down with similar conditions to mine, and had made an effort to find other jobs, believing that the factory job was in fact the root cause of our mental and emotional anomalies. There was some rumor though that the factory was one of the few in the country that had not been transferred overseas, that it was fighting tooth and nail to stay where it was.
Other jobs, occasionally available at restaurants and convenience stores, soon attracted my attention as well. Johnny continued working at the factory, but eventually, I made the decision to become a clerk at the local bank. It was at this point in time that something horrible happened.
Something changed very drastically.
I came home to the apartment early. Gregory was asleep, but when I switched on the lights, he began to squawk. It was at this point that I felt a mild itching on bridge of my nose. Good old Greg started to become even more unruly as I itched my face and went for the tablecloth. Then I noticed the great pool of blood in the corner. For whatever reason, this did not disturb me at all. Instead, I decided to call John to see when he would be home. As I pulled out my smart phone, I realized that I could not push the buttons like I normally could. Upon closer examination, I found my right thumb was missing. Only mildly disturbed by this, I stupidly decided to take a walk and get some fresh air. Later, I would be found on the side of the road, wondering where I was and why I only had nine fingers left.
Since then, I have concluded that I am not who I believe myself to be. It is an ongoing issue, but one that my psychiatrist assures me that I can resolve if I just stop thinking about it. John never came home, but I did receive a letter from him, or someone purporting to be him. It contained a letter, which I will write here:
Dear my dearest Daren,
I have something you had. I wish you to retrieve. The bride is wait. He say that he no know his master. He lie. The bride lie. I coming. I bring my host. No way since way is shut. The bride lie.
I coming,
Jhon.

Zeffon.about:
Single No. 16.
---
The Temple of Fire exists under the sea. The strange temple can only be accessed by means of blood. Underneath the Putrid Sea, there was a kingdom known as Oasis. The Kingdom was ruled not by logic or reason, but by madness. Thus, when the seas rose and consumed the kingdom, the descendants of those days of Oasis created a new kingdom to the north, vowing to never begin such an era of horrendousness.
Kin would also continue onward North. Past the lost town of Night Time!, a town made of gold guard by patrolling statues, Kin made it to another town, named Hrragan. The town had never seen outsiders, for it was always hidden.
As Kin continued, mist began to creep around his ship. Soon, it was impossible to see. Could this be something new? What otherworldly things awaited him and his crew here? He could've sworn he heard cannon fire. He thought he was mistaken though.

Zeffon.title: Jumadag-Di-Rii
Zeffon.about:
i. A Small Sliver
It was discovered later that the Sharhodeon Territories was bound to reclaim Unkardia as its own. Ships bombarded the shores of the island continuously until the trees were destroyed.
ii. Mistbrand Marsh
Soon, gas canisters rained down on the battered land via artillery, releasing poisonous mustard gas and phosgene. Little did the poor inhabitants realize that their attacker, or, person who ordered the attack was from their own heritage.
iii. A New Age
Over the next couple of days, the poisonous gas did its work. The few people who survived the initial onslaught retreated into Du Garma Canyon, never to emerge, for the Mandras and other creatures of that cursed valley would not allow it and instead would drain their sanity like Dränsilane, writer of the previous chapters of this book, the Disynxiym, the archive of records of this world.
iv. Canyon of Various Tragedies
Once the Sharhodeon Ships had done their jobs, they returned to their port at the capital city. The leader of the Terra Operative, the political group that controlled the Sharhodeon Territories was waiting.
v. Octopus
Miss Reve Terra Lyeon, the figure that the people of the Sharhodeon Territories credited with ending the depression that struck the country following the Day of Revolution where the crown was torn down.
vi. Cicada
The next project was to investigate the Lunar Plane. The Lunar Plane was the theory that the purity of the sun was directly affected by the impurity of the moon. The moon itself was considered by many to be a three dimensional shadow of the sun.
vii. Jumadag-Di-Rii
Of course, they weren't referring to Luna, but a new moon that was suspected to be revolving around the Earth. It was not nearly as reflective as the regular one, but always invisible. The only reason it was suspected to exist is because its shadow had been observed in the former Kingdom of Lavu, according to secret government documents that had been released.
viii. Isolated
This was no ordinary moon. It was the Dark Comet. As secretly prophesied by Reve's brother Dränsilane, the space anomaly had finally arrived. Reve was not surprised in the least, but gave the order to destroy Unkardia as a result. She was not going to allow anything else to happen to the Earth.
ix. Approach
Because of Dränsilane's ability to make his prophecies come true, a lot of the Earth had suffered. Nothing of the sort should be able to occur again. Now to repair the damage.
x. Pain Receptors
The remainder of Unkardia died within an age or so.
xi. Sword's Edge
When the Sharhodeon Territories made landfall on what remained of Unkardia, she knew that they would come back to life. They always did. But then there was a chance.

Zeffon.title: Kelué
Zeffon.about:
i. Time of the Summoning, Pt. 2
The tricky thing about Dränsilane is that he knew. He knew about the lunar plane. He knew about the Sorrow, the large cloaked bird that wanders Graghgorra, picking off any humans that happen to appear there.
ii. Ixis Ansede
One day, it would be the son of Thorn Ansede that would appear in that dimension. Ixis knew that the horrible experiment that Félix Oarr conducted all those years ago would have consequences here, but he couldn't resist observing those things with his own eyes. After all, his father had disowned him. What did he have to lose?
iii. Median
Unfortunately, those who are devoured by the Sorrow are led to Limbo, unable to return, ever since the Weeping Oaken Tree died. Ixis would never learn the consequences of his actions. However...
iv. Evolution
Ixis did observe the Human Overmind. What was once a giant was reduced to a blob of flesh when Félix Oarr used his experiment to transfer most of the giant's energy into his human "project", Dr. Uy.
v. A Sudden Crash
And that was the last thing he observed ever...

xii. (unintelligible)+kerväkähstanderelictanmast+bath
The drums continue to play in my head. Although I have many things to say, I must say as well that following the patrol tonight, I will be no more.
I hate them all. The very Mandras that slyly coaxed me into their woods. The same Mandras that play on their accursed drums. It is because of them that I must die tonight, when the patrolman comes at night with his flashlight to oversee the murky night streets.
I am sensitive to light, you see. The light that continues to shine through the cracks in my boarded-up windows causes me much agony, so I feel as though that I must die young. Not before describing my objects of terror in this journal.
I was walking to Northane, the great castle that lies beyond the forest. The thing that always thrilled me about travelling to that location was the walk itself; it contained many pleasures that I had previously known, such as birds, the movement of water, and the wind in the trees. The Mandras were from Unkardia, but I don't think anyone knew that. In any case, they also happened to inhabit the bulk of the trees that filled those woods.
It was noon, which is generally not the time of day the Mandras come out of their homes. However, a few were brave enough to talk to me. They are incredibly small people, no longer than my thumb. They told me they would like for me to visit their chief. I felt no obligation to do so, but given the circumstances of time (the sun was not about to set), I decided it was appropriate to wander off the beaten path and give them what they wanted.
As I traveled through the foliage, I became aware of small shards of porcelain that were scattered amongst the weeds. Travelling further, I came across a porcelain head, a doll head to be exact. There was no telling what it was doing out here. Perhaps some child had left a doll in the woods? Against my better judgment, I kept following the Mandras until I came to a clearing. There, my jaw dropped. A tall man wearing tanned leather clothes was sitting in a wooden chair. My amazement stemmed from the sheer height that this man possessed - he must have been at least as tall as five horses stacked on top of each other...
As a gazed upon his majesty, I suddenly realized that the sun was already setting. I tried to leave, but the man (whom I assumed was the large Mandra chief) beckoned me further into the woods. As I continued (I must have been in some sort of stupor), the trees began to seal off the sky, blotting out patches of light with their shade. Luminous fungi and insects crawled around in this shade, determined not to be exposed to the spots of sunlight that occasionally darted around the shadows like fast-moving ants. One unfortunate mushroom was exposed to one of these spots, and to my surprise, it shriveled instantly. As I followed the Mandra chief, he talked in a silky smooth voice about how the forest was infested by dolls. I didn't take him seriously at the time, but the dolls were to blame for the forest's decline. Eventually, we reached a clearing with a large luminous mushroom lighting the entirety of the space. There was not a speck of sunlight to be found; the sky was closed off with vines, branches, and thorns.
The Mandras began to sing and chant as they piled into the clearing and began to dance around the mushroom. The Mandra chief stood by and watched. As their song began to pick up with what became a furious tempo, I suddenly fell asleep. From there, all was black.
I woke up in the same place. The Mandras were gone. The mushroom had decayed and fallen into pieces. Yet somehow, I could see in the darkness perfectly. I then realized that I couldn't exit the clearing. The miniscule specks of sunlight were absolute horror to my eyes, causing them to burn with incredible intensity. As I ran out of the forest, my eyes burned so much that soon I was blind. I was found on the forest road later, apparently wailing in pain.
That sums up what I was going to say. The patrolman continues here. I shall use this lantern to burn my residence. To the underworld with the Mandras and their mushroom lord Chyi!
I still believe that the mushroom's name was Chyi.
Post the patrolman's departure, I have decided to take a bath instead. I have the strangest urge to do so.

xiv. Condense to Nothing
It was not Gondii Maledicta, but something else.
xv. Particle Ocean
It was this day that Caria woke up from her dream.
"Hello..." said a voice.
Caria looked around and saw that her mother was watching her. After a swift embrace, the two began to discuss their trials that they had been through. Madeline, Caria's mother, looked pale. When Caria asked what was wrong, Madeline simply shook her head.
"It's been a while since it happened, but your father is still trapped in Zeffon..."
Caria hadn't heard of her father Ross in a long time. She began to use her psychic powers to try to reveal his location, but to no avail.
"It's no use," said Madeline. "I've tried myself. The only people who could see into Zeffon nowadays are your aunt and grandmother. Your grandfather Kerragan is in the other room. He's remaining quiet on the subject. I suspect he knows something."
"How would you know?"
"He blocks my attempts to converse and read his mind. He wasn't born a psychic, but he sure has a strong will."
"I'll talk to him," said Caria.
She gave her mother a hug and went to find her grandfather. The old man was in a building in Ratayu known as the "observatory", her mind told her. Within minutes, Caria was knocking on its door.
"Come in," said a voice.
Opening the door, Caria found her grandfather Kerragan studying something in his hands. It looked like a glass box with green sparkling fluid in it. "Hello, Caria. Did you just wake up from your dream?"
"I did," said Caria. "I saw a temple like the old ones in Unkardia. You know, the Silver Forest Temple? It was completely enveloped in trees."
"I see."
"Kerragan, mom says you know something about dad."
"I do. He's trapped in the Chaoslands. Do you remember Dotajmari? The old ruined kingdom? He's there, but something's taken place since we left. Dränsilane, your great uncle, isn't pleased with being trapped in that dimension. He's trying to break free and invade Ratayu. I know your mother was trying to save him from the Darko in his soul, so I didn't tell her in fear that she'd go and confront Dränsilane. She cannot understand him the way he is now."
"What do you mean by she cannot 'understand' him?"
xvi. Untitled Forest Song
Kerragan rubbed his face with his hand. "I should take you to the Forest of Shadow Memories outside of Ratayu, he said. "It's beyond the desert to the east. There, you'll be able to visualize the previous dimension in a way that you wouldn't before here."
The journey to the east began the next day after Caria gathered some essentials to make the short journey east. After reaching the top of a sandy peak, the desert sand below the couple's feet began to transition to grass and shrubbery. As they continued to move, Caria noticed she was becoming sleepy.
"You're tired, aren't you?" said Kerragan.
Caria nodded.
"The Forest of Shadow Memories puts anyone who is sensitive to the psychic fields to sleep. The better of a psychic you are, the more drowsy you become - and as you know, I'm not a psychic, but your grandmother is."
Caria nodded a second time, suddenly slumping over and falling asleep.
xvii. Chyi
A voice entered Caria's subconscious.
"Where are you, Caria? It's cold here..."
"Dad?" Caria's mind began to drift towards her lost father. Suddenly, another voice interjected through the void.
"Don't try to find him, Caria. It's no use. He's already dead..."
"Who are you? Get out of here! I want to talk to my dad!"
The voice snickered. "I'm sure you do. But first, you must listen to me. There are certain numbers that you must avoid at all costs. First, avoid the number 48. Then, avoid 987. Finally, avoid 10,707."
"What's that supposed to mean?"
"Calm down, young one. I'm simply trying to protect you and your father. Those numbers have influence on your previous dimension. With Fair Tower abandoned, those forces have free reign over the dimension of Zeffon. Listen to my words - your father is as good as dead. Don't pursue him, as he will not make it out of Zeffon alive."
"...How do I get to Zeffon again?"
"...So you're not going to listen to me, huh? It would be good actually to ask Dränsilane himself. He knows a lot of the different aspects of Zeffon."
"Where can I find him?"
"You may not need to, Caria. He'll find you."
xviii. Moldy Bathroom
Caria began to have a vision. She was in Unkardia, and there was a red sunset. For some reason, when she approached the beauty of the fire-colored grass, she noticed that it was turning grey and withering. Then she saw him: Dränsilane was there, watching Caria quietly.
"Caria?"
Caria nodded. "Yes, that's my name."
"Do you know about the sun, granddaughter of Unkardia?"
"What about it?"
"It seeks to consume everything that is on the earth. Remember that it is a dragon waiting to consume your spirit when you die. Thus, the cycle of being trapped in this world continues. As a king of Unkardia, I'm forever bound to make sure that all the spirits that die here make it to the next life. Bear in mind that once you die, as everyone will in the next dimension where Ratayu is, you'll return here to become an enemy of the sun."
Caria noticed Dränsilane's skin was turning grey and beginning to crumble as stone. Dränsilane smirked.
"Don't worry, I will return."
Suddenly there was an eerie sound, like some sort of low screeching. Caria looked around and found that a lot of the trees and everything else was a hot blood red.
"Prepare yourself," said Dränsilane. "It comes."
"CARIA?"
Caria woke from her dream and saw Kerragan standing over her.
"Thank goodness. You've been sleeping for three hours. Did you see anything?"
"I saw HIM, grandpa."

Zeffon.title: Knee Hard
Zeffon.about: A burning sensation comes when I listen, but then, if Knoll is brought into question, I guess not? Knoll is an extrapolation of the Zeffon beast Dränsilane Isga, from which there's a strange land. Dränsilane Isga's family fled a continent full of rain and the Water Element a while back. At least, it would be an island, but after the waters were corrupted, the ocean dried up. Initially, the former seas were dustbowls, but eventually became covered in grass, fields, shrubs, and eventually trees. Lydia Isga, before she died, had three children: Levin and Owain the sons, and the daughter Elisaian. That said, there are still small bodies of water that exist on the very lowest levels of the Earth of what used to be the ocean. The lowest body of water exists in what used to be the lowest point in the Putrid Sea. A small lakeside town was established on the north side of the former Putrid Sea, Lake Emrac-delas-Onr. This town is a fishing community known as Kore-Ijra (core eerah), and along with the lake, is the only thing that bears a name from the previous world. A hamlet exists towards the eastern cliffsides called Shemgrama. It's a small community of farmers that live in the shadow of the cliffs for most of the day - Morgan, a descendant of Elisaian and by proxy, Norfell Isga, is the only member of her heritage that she's aware of, though she has kept her origins a secret for the 24 years of her life. She leads a quiet life in Shemgrama with the others and often keeps to herself.

Zeffon.title: Lapis Lapis
Zeffon.about:
i. Ancient
I came across an odd piece of parchment tucked away in the wall of my previous residence. The building was considered unstable and was therefore demolished. This paper was amongst the rubble, and by the look of it, it is written in some sort of ancient dialect. I'll have to inform Professor Stephane about this discovery. You never know what he will interpret as an "interesting find".
???. ???
I realize this, but you may not. The whole reason I exist is for your amusement or despair. Whichever comes first.
ii. Blood Bones
According to the paper, a strange skeleton was unearthed from the dust of a older building in a residential district. The remains are currently being examined. It's an odd find - the bones are mature, but are only 1 and a half feet in length. This was obviously a very short man in life. At least, that's what the report says. I call it rubbish.
iii. Shade Cast by the Tree
I like these night walks I've been going on. They really revitalize my soul. Recently, I've taken to walking in the park, by the old tree that resides in the middle of it. There's just... something about it that thrills me. Perhaps I'll be an adventurer when I grow up. That'll be quite the day.
iv. Pioneer (Blood Bones Reprise)
I'm forced to work for the gentleman down the street, though. The only way I've been able to manage the high cost of rent in this district is by working there. I'm not at liberty to reveal what I've done there, but I will write this down: There are strange pipes lining the walls, with a strange sound emitting from each one. It's like each pipe has a mind of its own because I often see fluctuations in the pressure gauges, which has damaged our equipment in the past. This has resulted in discipline for all of us workers, though I'm not entirely sure we deserved it. I was working later at night, and the sound of shrill calls filled my ears. I promised my mother before she died that I would not let this job go too far, but I feel I've crossed the line somehow. Somewhere, somehow, I will die if I keep this up.
v. Voices
The gasoline in the room stunk. I sat there for a while, hoping the fumes would wither away, but they didn't. I just hear the voices, telling me that I should return to the broken land of Unkardia. Bothersome things. I'll just resort to the stronger drugs if I need to. Just making sure that I don't smoke. The room'll go up like a powder keg.
vi. Just Latitude
I am now officially awake. I found a trail of dried blood running down the length of my arm, which tells me I probably injured myself. The walls continue to bend above me, and I keep thinking I see her. The ghost of my past just keeps trying to taunt me. I wish it would go away. Just for tonight.
vii. Sleeper (For A While)
I found an old phonograph record among my old things. It was one of the first and I'd be surprised if it still played. Aside from my latest discovery, the day has not been going well at all. Dee is acting up again, that little twerp. I found him passed out from the sheer stench of fuel and I was forced to open a window. Something about that room seemed cold and ominous, but I decided it was just me. Honestly, if that man wants to keep his job, he needs to improve has awful behavior. In the meantime, Experiment No. 1 went off without a hitch. Given this was our one and only opportunity to pull this off within our lifetimes, my superiors were pleased. I hope to continue this prestigious line of work in the future as well.

Zeffon.title: Large Moon Musick
Zeffon.about:
Soon available on iTunes and Spotify and such. Purchase includes two bonus tracks.
~~~
i. Chant 1 (Subsidence crater)
I finally made it to Karij, the island town. Due to the ancient flood, what used to be the Lavulese frontier was completely submerged. What Charlie wanted with me over here was beyond me at the time. When I met him at the Lonely Claw, I realized that was no joke.
According to Charlie, there was a huge war for control over the city of Lavu, the city that used to be a metropolis but was drowned in the flood I mentioned before. The city then became the atrocious kingdom that served as shelter for the Frogplain, the great god Dränsilane's place of dreaming. Little did Dränsilane realize that his dreams would often manifest themselves in the real world.
In any case, before Dränsilane's asylum and 10,707 days of chaotic meditation, there was a war to secure the city of Lavu. Charlie says that the battle ended with a large dragon that blotted out the sky with its wingspan.
Charlie wanted me in Karij because of certain reasons regarding the power void that Dränsilane had left after his death. People who were once figments of the man's imagination suddenly had things like "will" and "resolve". They had already began to declare wars on each other. Charlie talked about this for a bit, but then abruptly diverted to another topic. Apparently, there was some valuables hidden in the Sharhodeon Forest (I). IUHIJNH. Another thing to consider was the girl.
KNDKHSAA))).
ii. Chant 2 (Subsidence crater)
1CH412 yieldeth Hecaba.
iii. Giant Blue Moon (Something beyond tangible)
I hear terrible echoes of the past.
iv. Chant 3 (Subsidence crater)
Hecaba yieldeth Lepsaylulah.
Everything is meant to be.
v. Calcified birds from the abyssal maw
The Raven Boy killed Hecaba and Lepsaylulah and ate both of them. The dead calcified birds from the abyssal maw cut open the Raven Boy and released Hecaba and Lepsaylulah from his stomach, causing them to be reborn. The halves of Hecaba and Lepsaylulah became one, yielding Hahgara.
vi. Chant 4 (Subsidence crater)
Hahgara yieldeth Ananketoha, or the mental idea of Ananke.
vii. Chant 5 (Subsidence crater)
It became clear to Caria that the thing Enöigimras was going to destroy the town unless they did something about it. Quickly, she walked towards the door.
"Don't go, Caria! You'll die!"
"Then I'll die with the innocent people who have come to call this town home," muttered Caria. Despite her mother's pleas, she dashed out into the street. The desert wind roared in the distance, and a little bit of the sand on the ground began to swirl around Caria's feet. Enöigimras was coming. Caria closed her eyes again, and envisioned the approaching monster. It certainly seemed to hate light and water, based on her psychic analysis. Unfortunately, there was no rain for miles. Unless...
Caria opened her eyes again and ran to the church tower. She had remembered that the people of Unkardia and Anne had left the dimension of Zeffon and created Ratayu because of the harsh conditions in Zeffon, including lots of rain. This occurred because the Water Element, which was stolen from the island of Värta, was taken to the island of Anne and deposited in the ruins of Castle Emeroch. Soon, the rain came down, but there was too much, and the foliage took over the land. Perhaps, Caria thought, if the Water Element could be transferred to Ratayu, albeit temporarily, Enöigimras could be repelled.
Suddenly, when Caria ran into the church to access the tower, she stopped. There was a person here, and not a citizen in hiding either. This was someone that had lived in the Chaoslands, and survived the fall of Dotajmari.
viii. Chant 6 (Subsidence crater)
Ananketoha beareth twin powers that become anew. Add a single wholeness to the light of the star, and watch it turn around.
ix. Chant 7 (Subsidence crater)
Anankehota yieldeth the twins Hailola and Yiech.
x. Chant 8 (Subsidence crater)
Hailola is the end of the universe.
xi. Chant 9 (Subsidence crater)
Hailola is the end and Lyhb is the innocent that suffers from nausea.
xii. Overturned Moon
Halo Manah is and whill be the terrifying v. Gahaa.

Zeffon.title: Lava
Zeffon.about:
i. Lava
The First Major Battle of Gerrah occurs. The two gods appoint the people of the world as their warriors, granting unto them power that can be used to destroy all that stands in their path. In one fell swoop, Muagara tears open the earth, exposing the lava underneath, and swallowing many warriors of Eresymcaion. The people who now inhabit the Wysteriascape try to survive, while the heroes of the First Chapter begin escorting refugees into the mighty fortress. Whether the people are Sharhodeon, Lavulese, or other nationalities, they are welcome. Meanwhile, Vagard Tekraona prepares to take the continent of Exeräise from Eresymcaion's mighty 8th army. His people, inhabiting Morningsilver Island, are hardly up to the task, but follow him loyally nevertheless. Vagard, now 89 years old, has led his country faithfully for over 60 years.

Zeffon.title: Limbo
Zeffon.about:
i. Vagarditam
With Vagarditam, an evil kingdom rises above the ashes of its former self. Heretmedel describes Ocsania in a state of Limbo. In Limbo, two brothers realize their brother Nathaniel is in danger and try to warn him.
It is unknown how much of Sand is actually true. However, has been discussed that multiple things can happen at once. After visiting with Keliu a second time, I resumed the search for my friend. Free of distractions, I managed to re-travel to Refeaël and make it to the larger town of Desdemond. I received very little acknowledgement during my stay. The people in Refeaël seemed to desire keeping to themselves. Finally, I got the courage to ask where my friend had journeyed off to. I described him the best I could, and the townsfolk seemed to agree that my friend had returned from the evil citadel to the northeast and traveled to Reeveslin on the west coast. They had no idea of what his business my be, but I thanked them for their help and traveled to Reeveslin.
ii. Heretmedel
Once there, I met a man with a large hat at the inn. He seemed to understand what I was talking about, and it took me a bit before I realized it was my friend. He seemed a bit shaken when he told me of "the other side". In this other side he said (which he explained was another dimension), he saw a kingdom that had long since been destroyed. There was nothing but ruins everywhere. Eventually, by the guidance of the voice that eventually led him to the cursed Refeaëlese ruins, he found an old castle, crumbling and in the middle of a forest filled with pink and purple flowers. It wasn't very big, but there was a sense of comfort in it, like it was a place of solitude and safety. On top of the only standing tower, a woman was standing. She had long brown-blond hair that was very wavy. The voice told my friend to go inside the castle to meet her. My friend, who told me he was in a bit of a trance, obeyed without question. Eventually, he found that he was talking to the lady, but no words came out. He was speaking to her with his mind, and she to him.
My friend stopped short. "I'm sorry," he said. "I'll have to be honest with you." He took off his hat and the shade lifted from the face of my friend, who I quickly realized was actually female. "I'm sorry I haven't told you everything about me, but I was hoping I'd have your approval for this..."
I don't remember what happened after that.

Zeffon.title: Liu Mrjattas Mjata\us
Zeffon.about:
"There are clues."
The old one's factory limit continued throughout the day. Eventually, she got tired (and rather sick), opting to go back to the cage from whence she came. The old philosophy album sat at his feet, containing pictures that contained images of weary pasts and other events. This could not compare to the jet airplane that seem to blast overhead, dropping chemtrails (or so it is said) to keep the masses under control.
Eventually, Adelais came out of her coma, and saw the Ouldumaizai patrolling outside. What was the deal? She was in a prisoner's garb, and she was in a musty cell, not the others. She had a few clues at her feet as to where she was though. Then, as the haze departed from her senses, she realized she was in some sort of prison. The soldiers spoke some sort of weird language.
"Clockwork."

Zeffon.title: Longbow
Zeffon.about:
i. Untitled Outro
The record of what happened to Unkardia (or Reve and her brother) is very unusual. What we know now is that there was some sort of great flood, which potentially gives the Lavu Sea its name. The Arc-Demai and their descendants, the forgotten people of Ghel and Uaa perished in that flood. Creator himself was also destroyed in the cleansing that occurred on this barren Earth. The Holy Ocean was named thus, for destroying the evil force. Unlike in the past, people now respect the ocean, as a sign of the salvation that came and the peace that is still here. Roanin should return from his trip across the sea soon. He said he would.
ii. The Cross Tape
We knew that the dream was occuring. Not the first, but the second dream. This dream told people of the prophecies concerning the battle of Uyrak. This battle would be the end of all battles, one that would destroy everything the everyone had worked for. But there was a certain solace that this battle contained in the past.
iii. House of the Rats
Yeuesi was not pleased with the results. He decided as a being of extreme power to undergo the third dream.
iv. Euphoria
To understand the way of the Yaaahreyagaw, one has to understand that they are an interesting brand of people, interesting in the sense that they create this wonderful but chaotic dimension in which every weapon, every sword, every shield, is used correctly to destroy the evil within the third dream. Yeuesi should not have known the contents of the third dream, and thus the people felt the obligation to destroy him.
v. Sidelines
Xain is the person and steed behind the evil that is the third dream. He has influenced Yeuesi in such a way that Yeuesi does not have any sort of defense against his promptings. Yeuesi is not completely innocent however, as Xain and him have collaborated in the past.
vi. Manor House (i. Path, ii. Arrival)
The fourth battle of Uhhhaahgahh occurs during this time, and the people of the world retreat to the Samuelus Mansion for safety. Despite being in the realm of Oahdaaoore, it is actually a safe haven for those seeking some peace from the turmoil that goes on outside.
vii. Calm Mindspace
And then the fourth dream came into existence. The fourth dream exhibits the world as it really is, one with no compassion or metaphors. The loss of this art is terrible to the mind of who sees the fourth dream. Thus, Najauuuro, the first seer of the fourth dream, retreated into a calm mountain peak where he lived as a hermit for the rest of his life: the Pol Mountains.
viii. Some Laid to Rest
Some say that Haroeaaagrra is one of the many gods that can bring about the dreams of people. This may or may not be true, but it is one of the many things that brings the gift (or curse) of prophecy to the people of Zeffon and Ceyeokkaa nowadays.
ix. Fear of the Scaffolding and Falling Piano
Nothing can be said about the scaffolding holding its world afloat. The Chaoslands are actually atop ancient piers and stakes that allow it exist above water, for the ruins that used to be underneath the ocean contained Harorragga, an ancient material capable of producing dreams.
x. Ornamental Garnet
In the dimension of Ceyeokkaa, there is a single island in the middle of a vast ocean. This island has lots of trees, and is often referred to as the Lost Isle, as it is easy to become lost within the evil forest on top of it.
xi. Defector Surgery
The evildoers that cruise around the oceans and lands in search of the ancient rituals that bring about dreams are often stopped in their tracks. The dreams remain in the hands of Muagarah, the dark one, but the most trustworthy one.
xii. The Rains Come
Someone looked vacantly out their window, as they did not see the light.
xiii. Murky Gloom Widow
There is something that I cannot say about the gloom widow spiders that roam around the pillars that hoist the Chaoslands above the waves. They have a purpose, but I cannot know what they are, and they begin to have a strange idea that the gloom widows are the enemy in this situation. They are not.
xiv. Pot
That was the end of the battle of Heyuaaagrr. In this stage of the changes that are being made into reality, the existence of battles and dreams shall be made eternity.

Zeffon.title: Lotus
Zeffon.about:
i. Lotus
I continued my travels the next day. I admit I wasn't truly interested in the man in the moldy apartment, since he sounded as though he'd gone mad. I was more concerned about my own skin. I had been an assassin for years for my boss, whom I'll only describe as Charlie. He's a man of many tactics, but he often doesn't use them. Instead, he prefers to lay low, looking at situations from afar. Though he usually hung out in bars in the Seraph Territories (not in Ramalest for obvious political reasons), he was in the wastelands this time. Karij was the only town that had survived the flood that overtook Lavu (not that Lavu had anything going for it at the time).
Charlie had contacted me with a second letter, confirming that he was indeed in Lavu. For what purposes I wasn't sure, but I was beginning to sense that he was NOT the patrolman that shot at me as I initially suspected. That patrolman seemed to be around ever since the moldy-man lost his mind. It was like an insane guardian - there was no chance at all that this thing was human, it detected and anticipated my every move.

Zeffon.title: Magick
Zeffon.about:
i. Human Bradyzoites, Pt. 2
The eldest of the four brothers disappears in the swamps far east of Blueheart. When the Kingdom of Lavu refuses to investigate, the phonautographs for Catatomeniumas and Stagouros are stolen in the dead of night.
~
The loop is broken...
Never to return...
When I woke up, I found that I had fallen asleep on the street. The rain hadn't stopped in the time that had passed, and I was sopping wet. I returned to the inn and found the people inside talking to each other, gossiping as usual. I found that I wasn't the only one to feel the presence in that odd past evening though. I talked to the soldier. He seemed to be feeling a lot better now, as he didn't look nearly as traumatized. He identified himself as Oscar, and told me that he and his group had been sent from Lavu the captial city to interfere with Blueheart's declaration of independence, as I had previously suspected. However, he said that when the soldiers had left the town, they saw a strange purple light that they followed across the Lavulese plains until they realized that they could not see on another in the darkness that was beginning to envelop them. Their vision began to blur, and soon they couldn't see anything and were in severe pain.
ii. X: Catatomentiumas
While they were in the blackness, a voice gave them information about what he referred to as "Degree 8". There were 8 Degrees total, and they went from 8 to 1. Degree 8 revolved around instinct, and it was what allowed individuals like Emeroch and Dränsilane to achieve biological perfection all those years ago. Ironically, there is a curse associated with every Degree, and Degree 8 speaks of an illness that spreads like acid through a wound. This, Oscar told me, was Gondii Maledicta, the disease that wiped out the Sharhodeon Territories until it was recolonized. Supposedly, invoking Degree 8 for the sake of one's own desires invokes its respective curse. That's what Oscar said to me, but I have no way to verify it.
iii. XII: Stagouros
In any case, after the blackness, Oscar told me about a dreary wasteland that he saw and seemed able to fly through with the swiftest of speeds, as if he were a pulse of light. Over the course of exploring this land, he found nothing but grey waste. Eventually, he reached the sea and found an island in the middle of it. The isle still had foliage on it, and according to him, it didn't seem quite dead yet like everything else around it. There was still an ominous presence about it however. Then Oscar spotted two figures resting on the shore. He watched with an intense curiosity that he was unaware that he had before, and, before he knew it, it was nighttime. That's all he could remember, he said. The isle intrigued him, but he said that his focus should be elsewhere. Because of me helping him, he said that he would like to help me in return. He had grown weary of his role in the armed forces of Lavu, and thus felt it was appropriate for him to ally himself with me. I told him that a dear friend of mine had disappeared in Refeaël, and I need help finding him. He agreed, and soon become a close companion.

This album describes the Marat Empire (across the sea from Sharhodeon) and their ancient discovery they try to keep a secret from any other nations. Recently, the soil around their colony, Port Raiden has become contaminated by some sort of bacteria, causing the soil to look as though it is moving.

Zeffon.title: Maledicta
Zeffon.about:
i. The Ocean
“Miss Lyeon, the ship has departed!”
There was silence from behind the door.
”Miss Lyeon?”
The room seemed the same as when Stephane had left it. The fact of the matter was, Miss Lyeon was not back yet. That’s all there was to it. Turning to leave, Stephane stepped on a piece of broken glass. “That’s curious,” he thought, picking it up. “It’s almost the same kind of glass that they use on a mirror, judging by the reflective surface of the material. Wait…” Stephane burst back into their leader’s office. The full-length mirror on the wall had been shattered.
ii. Waters of Fortune
This marked when Lloyd Cathrop would leave on his adventure to seek fortunes overseas. Or so the people said. In truth, Lloyd was going to find the isle of Anne on the reality plane, establish a base of operations, and work their way from there. The people of the Sharhodeon Territories jovially celebrated his bravery, since no one had ever returned from the ocean in recent times. It was as if the ocean simply swallowed the innocent sailors that dared to sail it. Meanwhile, the Terra Operative was in grave danger. Having lost their leader, there was little they could do regarding their future. Miss Lyeon was one of a kind. It was only after Lloyd had cast off that the Terra Operative realized the magnitude of the danger they were in, and decided to call Lloyd back. Unfortunately, he was already lost.
iii. Anticipation
Years pass, and there is no sign of Lloyd Cathrop or his crew anywhere on the horizon. The Kingdom of Lavu has gotten kind of finicky regarding its territory over the past few years, and there doesn’t seem to seem to be any progress made in colonial negotiations either. The Kingdom of Lavu has been a thorn in the side of the Sharhodeon Territories, ever since the first colonists arrived from the Marat Empire in 1005. Though they were friendly at first, about a century ago, they began to have massive disputes regarding the existence of both the Sharhodeon Territories and the Seraph Territories. Meanwhile, the people on Ibiksis Island were beginning to try to seek independence from the two Territories, whom were constantly fighting over which one of them got to annex the island. Suddenly, amid the various legalities that were swamping the country’s politicians, a ship appeared on the horizon. Lloyd was back.
iv. Gondii Maledicta
Lloyd and his crew are discovered to have come down with a certain disease, one that affects their motor skills. Lloyd constantly fades in and out of his illness, but manages to tell some sort of story at the same time. The story Lloyd tells regards a woman named Reve, who has managed to obtain “what they were looking for”. The obtained item itself is said to be a bastard sword of some sort, originally belonging to a one-handed man. A complete account of the story is recorded and then delivered to the leader of the Sharhodeon Territories. These people have completed their task to some degree it seems. Now to remove them from the Well. Or the item in question. Preferably the latter.
v. Overtaken
According to Lloyd, a man named Ryan owned the bastard sword, driven by the death of a loved one to master the blade, despite the absence of his right hand. The man, well renowned for his prowess and skill, became entangled in a job that he was to dutifully fulfill for another man. He later dispatched this enemy and built a marker on top of his corpse. This marker was later adapted and turned into a mysterious tower. Ryan would later become a father figure for the great Archer Revenge, but he mysteriously died in what was only described by a frail Lloyd Cathrop as an “odd circumstance”. Lloyd’s control over his body is later terminated by the disease, which has been established to be some sort of genetically engineered parasite. When Lloyd is put into an asylum after medical treatment is administered, he begins to create all sorts of unusual lopsided machines.
vi. Gondii Maledicta, Pt. 2
A machine is created by Lloyd Cathrop and begins to terrorize the town of Sharhodeon. It is at least as tall as 5 houses, and moves slowly, as though it is limping. It carries a massive arsenal of explosive devices, and is only stopped after the Terra Operative comes and disposes of the machine. This raises questions for the Terra Operative, but mostly for the people. Surely Lloyd Cathrop couldn’t create that machine out of madness. There must have been some other influence, hidden from the public eye. Conspiracies that the government is responsible for both the sickness of Lloyd Cathrop and the destruction he caused later abound in the current state of paranoia.
vii. Hemlock of Society
A slow but sure collapse of sanity begins to take the Sharhodeon territories with it. The people, conspirators or not, fall into the groove of revolution, and begin to shout anti-government slogans at various rallies. The Kingdom of Lavu offers no help to the government of the Sharhodeon Territories, despite the multitude of requests for their assistance by various politicians. Eventually, the people begin to raid the presidential palace, tearing down paintings and lighting the palace on fire, trapping the president inside and burning him alive.
viii. The Ocean, Pt. 2
…And to think this began with the Ocean…
ix. Ancestors of the Mist
A woman appears on the shores of an unknown land. Everything was going so well. And then, the reality terminated. Her memories of the point onward were just filled with coldness and black. After picking herself up, she realized that she was still alive. In an unknown land perhaps, but she was still alive. Curse everything. Where is everyone? The bastard sword was lost… The woman moved up to a small hill off the sandy beach and lit a fire using the flint she had on her person. And then she saw it. The bastard sword was sitting amongst the dead briars on a grassy knoll. She gingerly pulled it out of the plant, and the put it in the bag she had designed for this purpose. How did it get here? That hardly mattered now. It was time to figure out how to get home.
x. Echoes…
The first of many civilizations to collapse was the Kingdom of Northane, once an item was brought to the wealthy town of Dragös by a man named Archer Revenge on a ship of the same name. The town, followed by the country, collapsed under the influence of the item, but not before it was placed in the depths of where it was supposedly made: in the Temple of Faces. Other civilizations would collapse under its influence as well, but Northane was the first. The process continues to repeat to this day, for all great civilizations shall fall someday, as Northane fell in the past, and Sharhodeon is falling today. And such was the prophecy of the Uaa, the first people to ever collaborate and create a tribe on the face of the Earth. After the prophecy was made, the Uaa suffered a bloody and gruesome fate after crafting what is nowadays known as the Bell of Amma. The Bell of Amma was a gift to the people from far away who said they were building a temple for the sun, the presence that warmed their daily lives. The Uaa knew the dangers of this kind of worship, since they knew that it lead to a degree of pride. Despite this, the Uaa collaborated with the people from far away, and gave them a bell to grace the tower of their new temple. Even though the Uaa constantly looked at the flaws of the other people, they never saw the flaws in themselves. When the harvesting beast came to their villages, they relied on the god they created as well as the idea that they could not fall under his influence. And still, they did. They were no match for the Unknown Beast. And so, they were never heard from ever again.
xi. Gondii Maledicta (Piano Version)
A short piano piece to honor those who died.

That hardly mattered now. It was time to figure out how to get home.
trackinfo.credits: from Maledicta, released August 16, 2011

trackinfo.title: Echoes...
trackinfo.lyrics: x. Echoes… The first of many civilizations to collapse was the Kingdom of Northane, once an item was brought to the wealthy town of Dragös by a man named Archer Revenge on a ship of the same name. The town, followed by the country, collapsed under the influence of the item, but not before it was placed in the depths of where it was supposedly made: in the Temple of Faces. Other civilizations would collapse under its influence as well, but Northane was the first. The process continues to repeat to this day, for all great civilizations shall fall someday, as Northane fell in the past, and Sharhodeon is falling today. And such was the prophecy of the Uaa, the first people to ever collaborate and create a tribe on the face of the Earth. After the prophecy was made, the Uaa suffered a bloody and gruesome fate after crafting what is nowadays known as the Bell of Amma. The Bell of Amma was a gift to the people from far away who said they were building a temple for the sun, the presence that warmed their daily lives. The Uaa knew the dangers of this kind of worship, since they knew that it lead to a degree of pride. Despite this, the Uaa collaborated with the people from far away, and gave them a bell to grace the tower of their new temple. Even though the Uaa constantly looked at the flaws of the other people, they never saw the flaws in themselves. When the harvesting beast came to their villages, they relied on the god they created as well as the idea that they could not fall under his influence. And still, they did. They were no match for the Unknown Beast. And so, they were never heard from ever again.

Edge of Mist is a coexisting town.
ZEFFON - Manipura 16 (Tragically, Pêvse Ants Reduce As, And Then Ashes...)
Just thought I'd record a few notes for this one, as opposed to the way I usually publish without any additional context for the listener. Like a lot of my releases lately, the production started slow and culminated in a massively productive Sunday evening on the 13th of March (early morning hours of Pi Day for most people on planet Earth), where I recorded and finalized about half the tracks. I wanted to have a bit of a combination folk/noise album this time around, and I think I did that in a way I found satisfactory.
Anyhow, this album is dedicated (rare for me to dedicate something, I know!) to the three bassists that were a key influence on how I play fretless bass. Thanks for introducing me to this lovely instrument.
Laszlo Panyigay
Masami Chiba
Koh Morota (R.I.P.)
These are the lyrics for the two songs that have words on Manipura 16. Bear in mind the lyrics for "A Company of Fools" aren't that accurate, since the song was recorded in one take, and I can't even hear myself over the Electribe ambience. But it's close enough for you guys to get the idea.
The Manipura series will have 19 releases total. The first 13 were released three-ish years ago in the months of August and September of 2019. The remaining 6 will be larger, extended releases, as this first album in the series since the end of the hiatus demonstrates.
~ C ~

Zeffon.title: Mark of the Beast
Zeffon.about:
i. Temple of Faces
The Temple of Faces lies beneath the Putrid Sea, built entirely from the spoils of wars. Whether it be riches or skulls, materials obtained through bloodshed are the main components of the structure. Along with endless hallways filled with columns, there are faces on and in the walls that appear to move from time to time. Their origin is unknown.
At the very bottom of the temple is a Shrine of Chaos. The Arc-Demai were supposedly birthed in the depths of this shrine, which lies at the very bottom of the temple. Yet it is unknown how deep the temple actually goes. Supposedly, it connects Meredith, Dragös, The Great Limb Forest, Rasoe, a mysterious fifth location, and the bottom of the planet, the Planet Core. At the bottom, there's what is rumored to be an old church bell, one that brings about a terrible curse. According to the texts of old, it was originally forged in the depths of the temple itself, stolen onto a vessel called the Archer Revenge, taken ashore to Dragös, and finally stolen again, becoming the main feature of the Rasoe Bell Tower. Yet, though producing a soothing timbre, it also destroyed more than it created. Or so they say. In a last ditch effort to save their kingdom, the bell was moved into the depths of its origin, sealed with fifteen different tribal magics, and erased throughout many manuscripts. Yet the civilization died anyway. Before they died however, one manuscript was taken to a prosperous civilization on Exeräise. Like the civilization before, Exeräise perished. The manuscript, now called The Ymousde, moved again to another continent before being moved to The Kingdom of Lavu's Royal Archives. It was only discovered again much later, by a detective calling himself Roy, on the tail of a certain Dr. Uy.
The curse of the Uaa continues to haunt the race of man...

Zeffon.title: Matheus
Zeffon.about:
i. Escg Eglico
Escg eglico, the final destination, a stone of holiness
Was discovered by a tribesman during the storm
A traveler visited later
And took the stone with the tide
The waters no longer approached the shore
As the elders sat by the river
Watching the sun go down
Watching the sun rise
The harvest was no good
The harvest
The harvest...
This led to starvation
We had no food for our children
It was then that we were led to the black, into the burial mound behind the source...
Final Comments by Translator Thorn Ansede:
Dränsilane's Disynxiym will have a profound effect on the rest of us for the rest of time. This not necessarily because the writing is artistic or aesthetically pleasing, but because there's a certain... power hidden within his work, and within the being of Dränsilane himself. His real name, not the current one he gave himself, shall be revealed in due time. However, it would be best not to pry too much, as he who knows the least knows the most. Believe me. I've tried.
My best advice is this: Treat the universe as if multiple things can happen at once. We as humans are incredibly singular on our ideas, especially when we consider being in multiple places at once, or the fact that we may not exist at all, since if we did not, we would have no consciousness of it...
ii. Recording Tropical Storms
There is a puzzle to be had throughout the world of Zeffon, for the alternate identity of what may be perceived to be a full man is naught.
He cannot walk, but he can run. He is an element.
Overall, the mysteries that surround the world of Zeffon and its existence are many, but one has to wonder, why does Zeffon exist?
Many have said it is a world for the insane, one that people of insanity find themselves in after traveling too far into the abyss that is the mind.
iii. Traveler
In the future, he is risen, associated with the train that escorts the dead to the afterlife. What is he?
I've been mulling over these puzzles for a while now, and I can honestly say that it has me stumped. There are a couple of clues that I have stumbled upon however, and given that I myself exist within the dimension of Zeffon, I have to wonder the purpose of my existence. My name is something I have never quite known - it sounds odd to not know someone's name, but for me, I cannot recall.
iv. Source of Recording Tide
The crystal that harbored such an atrocity was broken.
I call myself Ixis however. My true name was something I was stripped of when my parents died. When my parents were killed by a mysterious army of shadow warriors, they hid me with zeal. According to them, I would never see them again, and I was told not to pursue them into the shadows.
v. Origin
I am grey, I am black, I am the bringer of misery upon the shoulders of wounded soldiers.
I became a soldier later on until I was wounded in a battle - I had an arrow shot into my calf, and has permanently caused lameness. For the time being, I was then in Inejeheim, recovering and reading about the lore that is Zeffon.
There was a day however when a man by the name of Gero came to the Castle of Inejeheim where I was being kept, asking to see me. He said that he had come to express his condolences for the loss of my parents. I told him that I was going to see them again somehow. I just had to!
vi. Starvation
It approaches like a unexpected wind.
Sadly, Gero informed me about the nature of my parents' demise, how they were beaten by a shadow army, and how an ancient weapon had done them in. He began to tell me about the connections of Zeffon to the "alternate dimension" or the "true dimension".
vii. Pehuén
The old ship of souls displayed the prized possession out in the open. The first character of the name initiates the characters that follow.
Anyone who is lost to shadow shall be lost forever according to him. He knew this because he had tried to save his own sister when she was lost to the shadow. There was a tale about a certain castle near Unkardia that cursed whomever the shadow of its ancient steeples touched.
viii. Slash-And-Burn
Like the misery I evoke in real life, I have a purpose.
This castle, known as Castle Dränsilane, was built in the year 1405, for the son of Norfell, at the time known as Uaa. Unlike many of his peers, Uaa had a strange obsession with poisons, despite being a kind young man. But when the Castle was built, and Uaa sold his soul to the Creator, he became known as Dränsilane.
ix. Place Where ? Died
These people are poisoned with the knowledge of scathing sun.
Dränsilane is never truly dead, yet he is never truly alive. It is because of this factor, Gero told me, that no one can be rescued from the world of shadows. Once you die in Zeffon, you disappear forever. I had heard about Dränsilane and his ambitions, and so I decided to ask Gero about Dränsilane's involvement with the shadow armies that had plagued Zeffon for the longest time. Dränsilane, according to Gero, was still dangerous enough that he dared not utter his origins.
x. Ocokblnkihpei
Though strong, he was weak.
He did, however, say that there is a desert in the west that contains clues on how to overcome the shadow soldiers so that no one else can be lost. The beast that lurks in the desert there is one of the stone giants formed by the creator, according to him. I was to ask the giant if I wanted more information. Gero vanished suddenly without a trace.
xi. Drought
The drought initiated the obstruction.
After I recovered, I traveled to the Continent of Eadei. Using Rufus Ansede's old writings as a guide, I found myself in Desert A (as it was known by the locals). However, according to Rufus' writings, the A stood for Affirmation. I was soon to find out why.
xii. Mettera
What the future holds is indeed terrifying.
I found the stone giant of Desert A, which turned out to be a giant statue of a tiger. The sun began to become intense as I walked towards it. I then presented my question to the stone tiger:
"Who is Dränsilane?"
A period of silence followed as the wind suddenly vanished. I saw chips of rock begin to fall from the giant stone tiger, as if the sun was causing it to dissolve and break apart. I then heard this response in my head:
"You must free us. We have been under siege here for far too long. The wind keeps blowing the rain in our direction, and we cannot stand it."
A large rock fell to the ground, and I realized the tiger was crumbling, and I was going to be pressed for time. I asked a different question:
"Where are my parents?"
The response came quickly.
"They no longer exist. You would be wise to forget them."
I asked a third question:
"Why do you crumble under the sunlight, statue?"
The mysterious response came swiftly.
"You see not the rain because it is the sun!"
xiii. Maíz
Indeed, there were only four of these sons. They realized their error from the one. The fifth was forward and unmodified in name.
I traveled after seeing the Giant of Desert Affirmation and then I moved to the desert of Re Affirmation, or Desert RA. According to Rufus' text, there is a book known as "255 Words", that has a commandment in it that states the following:
"The Deserts of Affirmation and Re Affirmation concern sight and knowledge. The first gives thee knowledge, and the second sight. The first gives prophecy and the second confirms it."
Unsure of what I was about to uncover, I went to the desert of Re Affirmation. Unlike the previous, which was full of tiger statues, there is only one tiger statue in the Desert of Re Affirmation. It, according to Rufus, looks sadder than the others, and it possesses the name of "Äiouley", given to it by the locals. The locals insisted that I do not talk to this statue, but I told them that it was imperative that I figure out how to rescue my parents from the shadow world.
xiv. Poeunhb
The key word is the law, but is irrelevant.
As I approached Äiouley, it got VERY quiet. The winds died and the sand around me began to quiver. My head was suddenly assaulted by mental imagery of people being torn apart in ways so grotesque, that I threw up and fell to the ground. The words "LEAVE" continued to bounce around in my head as I ran away from Äiouley.
xv. Fomitiporia ellipsoidea
In essence, the namesake is one of many different daughters of the eastern way, but is in FACT western.
I found out later from the doctors at Inejeheim that the arrow that had been shot into my calf had a slow acting poison on the tip, but I remain convinced that I should live. I shall continue this journal after my recovery, as I will my quest.

Zeffon.title: Mist
Zeffon.about:
i. Into The Misty Mire…
After a close encounter at a club in Blueheart, agents fail to successfully capture Samuel Cathrop. He is pursed into the swamps east of Blueheart, but suddenly disappears.
Little known to anyone, even Creator, D23 had another name that he seldom used. D23 had not only a kinship with my father Norfell, but a family relation as well. After Ryan of Inejeheim passed away all those years ago, he had given birth to only one son with his wife Yvonne. That was my great-great-great-grandfather. Then, when Yvonne left to return to Lantern Island, her homeland, Ryan died heartbroken. However, in his later years, Ryan became engrossed in the theories of Dark Manipulation, and his spirit became D23.
ii. A Forgotten Trip Through Time
It’s an interesting thing for one to consider. D23 created Ryan which created D23, which created an endless loop of time. That’s why D23 wanted his universe to end after a certain period had passed: to break the loop.

Zeffon.title: MOKRT - The Shroud of the Multiplier of Shapes Gold
Zeffon.about:
preservationists' note: D$$TA1A (Ferric Mix) & 'Poison Trials' are Tape Archive release No. 9. The two parts of A Sacred Song are Tape No. 10.
"Be still my child, and continue to dream." Those are the words I heard uttered before I awoke to a red flash of light in the sky. I got out of the small hut I had built all those years ago and looked for the source of the voice. I didn't find one. The various farmers seemed confused too.
Slightly intrigued, I went to discuss my plans to travel a little farther up the cliff face with my friend, Oswel. He had a wife named Catherine, and they had had a set of twins together (two daughters). As Catherine went to take care of the children, I worked pulling out some handrot out of the ground, handrot being a vicious weed that (unfortunately) grew rather aggressively in this parts. That said, Shemgrama also grows oi'em, a rare plant that quite honestly makes the hamlet necessary in the first place. As pretty as it is, there's not really TRUE life to be had in such isolation unless oi'em is growing in abundance.
That said, oi'em being the spiritual plant that it is, we export a BUNCH of it to the religious sermons in Kore-Ijra. There's several different congregations that hold the plant in high regard because it lets you speak to your ancestors. My lineage being, well, what it is, I have held off on such a ceremony. Curiosity's gotten the better of me as of late though, so I am planning to travel up the cliffside and look for outcroppings to camp out on for a few days. i want to know who my mom is or was. I've never met her.

Zeffon.title: Music for the Burning Sun
Zeffon.about:
i. [Corona] Protoasma
I received the report the other day: a man, going by the name of a lesser god, recently was found in his moldy bathroom. He's insane; there's no other explanation. The man seems to be hypersensitive to light and demands being kept in conditions were the sheer level of humidity is unbearable. The man glows in the dark. Yes, he bloody GLOWS IN THE DARK. Honestly, this man must have eaten half a gallon of radioactive paint to pull this one off. Yet he's still alive. This intrigues us greatly.
In another report, a run-down mansion abruptly burned to the ground. It is said that the old hag who owned the place lived with a 5-year-old daughter with a passion for dolls. This of course is purely trivial.
The thing that has been concerning us the most is the summer heat. Some people have died from the incredible heat wave that is upon us. Ironically, the sage Cyane prophesied what he called the "Coming of the Sun", or, the sun basically crashing into the Earth. I don't believe it one hundred percent, but there seems to be a grain of truth in this odd prediction. The sun, as far as we've been observing, is getting a little bigger with each passing day. We'll make an announcement if we reach anything conclusive though.
In any case, I'm going to conclude this entry in the usual way:
Ramalest, may she burn in our hearts forever!
(I also feel the desire to tone down our loyalty laws. They're a waste of time in my honest opinion.)
Kindest, most respectful regards,
F.HGNS.

Zeffon.title: Naju - Colurcoradu Urgühr, rähnd sie
Zeffon.about:
i. Stone Men
There was an accident in the field today. A man got his arm blown off by a carelessly loaded shotgun. I told him that thing was dangerous and he didn't believe me. I guess he's suffering the consequences now.
ii. Tearing Him Apart
He's recovered, but I'm worried about him. He's constantly saying he sees things, like there are ghosts around him constantly. I'm not sure what he means by that, but some doctors took him for medical examination. It's possible that they might try to justify their theories of how he's an imperfect human physiologically. I'm hoping they don't.
iii. Rotting Paper
He disappeared. I have no idea where he went except maybe to one of the asylums in the hills. He was a good friend of mine, so I certainly hope that he's all right.
iv. Naju, Part 1
I just realized that I'm going to be under surveillance for a while now. Supposedly, the people don't want me to suspect anything about the disappearance of my friend, although I already do. I WILL find out what happened to him.
v. Anti-Social Disability Trial
I don't think I can really say much more on the matter...
vi. Representation-Disgrace
I don't think I'll ever be able to forgive the government for letting this happen. They will feel my wrath. Everyone else who has been affected by this incredible and awful program shall be liberated if I have anything to saw about it.
vii. Split Red
More people were found - what was left of them anyway. Parts of them were strewn about dissecting tables, and limbs were hanging on hooks in a nearby freezer. This butchery cannot be allowed to stand, but the government isn't doing a thing about it.
viii. Urgühr, rähnd sie I
I myself was commited to an asylum recently. Apparently, my mental health has sunk below an acceptable level to join any of the armed forces. Completely resigned, I'm in my cell, waiting for fate to decide what to do with me. I probably will not escape this.
ix. Tertiary Proteins 5
There is loud banging from outside. Perhaps there's a jailbreak happening in the asylum. I can barely write at this point; I barely have energy to move.
x. Raw Sand
Perhaps I'll wake up in some sort of desert paradise, instead of this horrible cell. I wish that this was some sort of dream.
xi. Urgühr, rähnd sie II
If only, if only this was a dream. All this is a dream. All this is a dream. All this is a dream.

Zeffon.title: Necessary Foliage
Zeffon.about:
Info // General Concept:
Improvised into a portable tape recorder during a power outage and imported into my computer with reverb. This album consists of ambience meant to be played alongside other Zeffon albums, the goal being to allow the listener to create their own mix and utilize their own creativity, hopefully finding the same joy I personally find when making this type of music. Specifically, this album is meant to be played alongside "Proteins", but any album can work. This can be accomplished by playing Necessary Foliage in Bandcamp and another track in a media player or something similar.
This ambient album is based off Easter Island, thus the ocean wave sounds and the title. The title also refers to the idea of a forest growing around older Zeffon tracks. Enjoy if you wish.
Va Perila refers to nameless graves.
Proteins 9 is continuation of "Proteins", but different from the single version, which is a tape rip in mono.
Reepa refers to Soulcage from FFIX.
Plot in Elsewhere (as in, a plot of land) refers to the swampy forest around my house. One day it will likely be destroyed to make way for housing developments. Until then, I preserve as much as I can.
The Crash of the Empire refers to a certain frustrating monster-in-a-box from FFVI and the Veldt.
El Gigante is an unfinished moai from Easter Island that would've been the tallest ever erected.
Necessary Foliage again refers to forests and lost woods in general.
Proteins 8 and 2 are remakes of the originals from the Proteins album.

The inspiration to document the world came in the form of a dream for Kin Tekraona, King of Ghel. 2510 had supposedly died of natural causes in his small dimensional space where he moderated the world of Zeffon. With the world of Zeffon in chaos with the exception of Ghel, Kin Tekraona felt the need explore the vast world. Kin knew from the years spent in refuge in the Great Limb Forest that all these "dimensions" were connected, that if one traversed the ocean far enough, one would even reach the Frogplain, where in the center 2510 had set up a small hut and sat down to meditate and dream. The dreams of those in the Frogplain control the happenings of Zeffon, and thus chaos was present for the 10,707 days that 2510 spent in the Frogplain without food or water.
From the Last Suntower that his people built to raise the dawn, Kin prepared for his journey. It was time to put the Agateitam to good use. The Agateitam was the remains of Vagard, Kin's father. Vagard, while in the Great Limb Forest, used his power as an Arc-Demai to sacrifice himself to be sure that no harm would befall his people ever again. It seemed to have worked, since Ghel had expanded since then, the land being so fertile that the harvests were very plentiful. Clean water flowed from Mt. Etehr, allow other villages to pop up around the rivers. The land was no longer grey, but a healthy shade of green. Things could hardly get better.
i. Agate (Suntower)
This describes the dream that Kin had in his chamber in the Last Suntower. The Suntowers were the towers the Arc-Demai built to raise the dawn. Arc-Demai were normally violent creatures, so the people of the continent Ghel would often stay on the island where the town of Ghel was. When their 100th birthday would come about, the old men and women would take a small boat to the mainland, where they evolved into Arc-Demai. Although three of these Arc-Demai migrated to Unkardia in the old days, the majority of them stayed on the island to fulfill their responsibility to create a Suntower and a Moontower every 12 hours in order to raise the sun and the moon. With their magic, it was hardly an issue. However, once 2510 died, the Arc-Demai died, and along with it, Eresymcaion and Muagarah, the two components of the Unknown Beast. Given that the sun and the moon relying on a civilization to summon them was a product of 2510's meditation, the sun and the moon returned to normal. The dream that Kin had covered all these topics, but was made especially significant when a strange voice made itself known. The only remaining blood of Unkardia was still alive. Her name was Sarah Lyeon.
ii. Kelué, Pt. 3
The first place Kin traveled to was Oasis. The country of Oasis and their single town of Fairion was delighted to do trade with Ghel after so long, and soon, they too as a country were successful. Kelué is the temple from which Oasis worships the god of Keliu, the continent farther to the north. Keliu supposedly has not been inhabited for years. Thus, Kin decides to explore Keliu first, and see what kind of odd natural phenomenon that the continent holds. A rainstorm marks their arrival there.
The music itself is meant to represent a ceremony that is normally held in Oasis to worship a strange type of creature called a Itam. These creatures, as their name suggests are immortal, due to the name Vagarditam or Agateitam implying immortality.
iii. Night Time
Keliu, upon exploration, seems uninhabited with the exception of the strange birds that are heard throughout. Suddenly, a large fly rockets past, drawing eyes towards the dark woods. Camping for the night seems out of the question, since the ground is goopy and so unstable, that standing for a few seconds causes considerable sinking. Eventually, ruins are found of an ancient city made of gold-colored stone and rotting wood that was likely also golden in the past. Giant stone statues patrol eternally around the city, making it very hard to get in. Eventually, Kin accomplishes this and looks around. There's nothing but waste, mud, and a lot of rain.
The song itself represents the statues patrolling around the city.
iv. Pink Vines of the Divine
Horrible beings with bodies of iguanas and heads of mutant humans with small eyes, sharp teeth, and a lack of a nose and ears worship their own idols, the pink vines that grow deep within the temple.

Zeffon.about:
A brand spankin' new album from Zeffon with a couple of re-released tracks mixed in from Grievances, and album released in 2012. Three of these tracks pay tribute to the Tristram theme from Diablo II, a video game I have yet to finish. Enjoy songs about death if you so choose.
Spending time on the idea of hammering a nail into the space of wood is something that cannot be understood. Remember the being understood is the essence of the Trinity. If I wash my clothes in water, can I be purified, or does the water need to be purified first?

Zeffon.title: Normal Autumn
Zeffon.about:
Improvised on January 30, 2015. Free.
i. Normal Autumn 1
When one considers the extent of Dränsilane’s power, it becomes obvious why he is lord over Zeffon. The dimension is caused by a certain individual on Earth who died a long time ago, killing many of the people in the world. Because of his power, he left behind a curse.
ii. Normal Autumn 2
The curse that Dränsilane left on Earth has to do with one of the world’s most notorious attempts at world domination. Once his tomb was opened, it left a mark upon the land on which his tomb was established. The strain of thought in which this mystery is understood is called the Adamandote, and it is the way Dränsilane summons his weapon, the acid rain.
iii. Normal Autumn 3
Back in his time, there was a siege of a certain town where the soldiers did everything they could to push back against the enemy. The acid rain however, hampered their progress, that is, until Dränsilane died. The people whom he killed became the permanent residents of Zeffon, Dränsilane’s dominion, eternally fighting against the person that caused them grief.
iv. Normal Autumn 4
Dränsilane seeks to exit the dimension of Zeffon and be free from its purgatory. Once the Creator combined himself with Uaa Isga, he became Dränsilane and became bound to Zeffon to hobble and limp for eternity. After being shunned by the people of the isle of Anne, he was walled up in his own castle. It was at this time that the Ognians, who had lived in exile from Unkardia due to a prophecy of the Royal Family taking over Unkardia and killing anyone who was not an Isga.
v. Normal Autumn 5
The Royal Family did not do this on purpose – they were being controlled a malevolent force beneath Unkardia. However, none of the Isgas have expressed true remorse for their actions, except for one: the adopted sister Reve. While the other Isgas have tried to establish themselves as people that are neither cruel nor genocidal, Reve is the only Isga who has tried without any doubt or limits to make things right again.

Zeffon.title: Nuia Terra
Zeffon.about:
i. Rotating Brown Star Eye (Extended Death Mix 2)
Deep in the oceans of Zeffon, there's light. This may sound strange, but it's true. The only light that Zeffon can see is beneath the Putrid Sea. When I was left behind in Zeffon, things changed drastically. The waters rose, drowning everyone who couldn't escape it. It was after that day that lights appeared beneath the Putrid Sea, what once divided Unkardia and the Chaoslands. The Dotajmari region (north Lavu), which used to be mountains, quickly became a couple of islands. There are people who are living there that are quickly developing superstitions about the place. In the night, there are strange calls, calls that sent chills through our bones. We build little stone monuments to keep the voices away, but they keep coming back.
