Zeffon.title: PtoT-Lônfirm
Zeffon.about:
When Oscar woke up, mom was gone. She left a lengthy note on their family table that described her dilemma. Although he and his twin sister Beatrice were both 13, their mother tended to treat them as adults. It was for this reason that Catherine hid nothing from either of them: Dad had been kidnapped. Oscar looked in the bedroom. Beatrice was gone too - it looks like she had already woken up and gone after Mom. Her bow was gone too, and in its place, Oscar noticed a note clearly scrawled out quickly:
"Notice. Just in case, brother!"
Oscar grabbed the other bow which was remarkably the better of the two set aside for the children for hunting, and then he walked outside. Knowing he had his ancestor's gift of Perception, Beatrice probably would've found an obscure place to hide an addendum to the 5-word note. Sure enough, a severed reed in the tall grass produced a much longer note when split down the middle.
"We can't have them following us. Remember Kell and his two sons? Yeah. They're back and they're looking for that Paskrerek they kept bemoaning about years ago. I didn't think Paskrereks were real, but check out the little crevice in the cliff wall. I know you know the one."
-- Bee
Oscar reached in the crevice and pulled out a disembodied eye made of antimatter, and it pulsed gently in his hand.

Zeffon.title: Radio
Zeffon.about:
////// From Dränsilane's Disynxiym:
The final verses are essential, but non-existent. There is no way we can go back.
In essence, following the discovery of the Royal Family, who had been sealed in Mandra statues, they moved their kingdom to the continent of Exeräise, based on what little real-world authority they had left. This authority was pre-destined though. It was impossible to prevent anyone but the immortal from being the leaders in the forever-Darkness.
They built a castle with their powers, though it was small, it was still grand. A town sprung up, and the once flat continent became rife with mountains. The Magot Tower remained however. No one had the power to remove that, not even the permanent rulers.
Emeroch Isga became the permanent king of the east part of the continent, and he set up another castle to the west, so Reve Isga could rule that domain. Reve refused, and instead gave the throne to Adelais and Lydia Isga. Both, according to her, were more learned in the way of ruling than she was. Reve herself went to the town of Rasoe in Unkardia. All of Unkardia was either dead or abandoned, save for two people. Reve's daughter, Reve Terra Lyeon, had finally found her father Kerragan Cathrop, and the two had met briefly before heading their separate ways. Kerragan left for Fairion, the capital of Oasis. There, he hoped to better understand what had happened to Vari Cathrop, his son and Reve Terra Lyeon's brother. His mind was blank except for the memory of his daughter.
Reve visited the grave of a young man who had died quickly after escaping from Castle Dränsilane. His name was Gaine. The action of possessing the young man was something Dränsilane finally realized in an effort to keep himself immortal. Emeroch found that path through peace. Dränsilane did not.
Emeroch kept his kingdom for years in East Exeräise. His power to foresee conflict gave him that ability. It was given to him quite painfully, as he was born with an eye in the palm of his left hand, but needed one upon his right as well, something very rare, even rarer than the former. A fell beast had attacked him, tearing him apart, spreading his entrails throughout the depths of the forest. The beast then stole Emeroch's left hand. Yet despite the enemy's efforts, Emeroch managed to still revive himself and destroy the beast, whom he says was Muagarah. He has never discussed his methods.
////// From Earth Book I:
We declared it,
And so it shall be,
Corpses mount up and continue to rise.
You are a child of light
You are a child of light
He is a child of darkness, yet he is superior,
For he does not allow for you to follow the path of fathers
Logic, reason, radials, ideals, they are all dead.
The massive pillagers continue to stomp on the dead castle
And yet you do the best you can,
And yet it means nothing,
The fear must change, or be crushed underfoot,
There is a strange atmosphere tonight,
And the night thereafter,
The first night shall remove the river that defends the keep,
The second shall initiate the attack
Blood becomes the river,
The voice of death becomes you,
You are Radio
////// From Fire Book:
I cast fire upon the dancer,
It does no good,
The dancer is a shadow,
Waiting to seduce me,
All I do is flail about,
Trying to destroy it,
And it remains,
And through its spell,
I turn to rust
The voices continue,
And I move through the doors,
The giant pitfalls are obvious,
And I have to make sure I don't fall,
For then I shall be no more,
Yet, the dancer returns,
And tears me apart.

Zeffon.title: Re-amble (Feasting on the Magic Spamming Berry)
Zeffon.about: Despite the trials getting started, Morgan manages to get up some distance on the cliffside. Midway through her climb, she finds an outcropping to use to potentially begin camping. However, she had scarcely gotten to the middle of its foundation before she saw a rather grotesque carving in the stone. It seemed to depict some sort of skeleton wearing a large skirt and perhaps some sort of shawl. That said, it made her feel uneasy. Morgan had heard some rumors of people with wild hair that was scraggly and just about the size of the heads that the hair grew on. They supposedly had some intricate paintings or tattoos covering their arms, but Morgan thought about the different religious congregations that she had worked for, and thought this was probably one of them. Still, as dusk set in and night took over, the wind that blew by and over the outcropping felt damp, musty, and altogether filthy and unpleasant.

An addendum to Generys Miasma. The track is improvised.

Zeffon.title: Resolve
Zeffon.about:
i. Over And Around
On that eve, the Kingdom of Lavu celebrated both the birth of the heir to the sixth position of the Windy Summit, and the new year. The Windy Summit made the executive decision to be rather lenient regarding the celebrations. They weren’t big baddies when everyone was looking, after all. The year 1300 was here. Despite the joy and euphoria that would take place on that day, the ever slow movement of the calendar year affected the lands overseas quite differently. Though technically part of the Earth, they were also different. In between the two lands, the land of the Royal Family and the Kingdom of Lavu, there was a large divide. The land of the Royal Family resided on the large island of Unkardia, while the Kingdom of Lavu, while being on what was referred to as the “Main Continent”, or Mist, was known as the Chaoslands overseas. In between the two continents was the ever blighted Putrid Sea, an ocean only the valiant and brave would ever traverse. The crossing also came with side effects, ones that were unknown to the men in Zeffon.
A small, chanting hum filled the air. There were Mandras in the forest. Roanin quickly hopped on Nightmare's back. Now was not the time for chatting. Luckily, there wasn't much to worry about. Mandras were harmless as long as their singing didn't affect you.
ii. Grinder
This strange rift would occasionally open up, revealing dimensional beasts of an absolutely terrifying nature. Though little more than slight clouds of haze, these beasts were known as the Dwellers. They appeared intelligent, since they rarely showed themselves, and only killed selectively. No one knew exactly where they were originally from or what purpose they had, but the legends persisted that if you met one within a few paces, you were already dead. Roanin was aware of this like other things, and decided it was time to exit the forest as quickly as possible. While riding, Roanin heard a strange howl, one that chilled his bones and made Nightmare uneasy.
"Nightmare..."
Nightmare began to lose his nerve. In a sudden move, Nightmare began a full-fledged gallop away from their destination, away from the moon.
"Nightmare! C-control yourself!"
There was no stopping him now.
iii. Conflict
Years pass in the realm east of the Putrid Sea, and another child is born to the Cathrops. Kerragan and his wife decide to name the child after her mother. Thus, the name Reve is bestowed upon the child. In the following days, Kerragan just could help but feel like he was in peril. His wife Reve took notice of this and did everything in her power to help him, but nothing that was done made Kerragan change noticeably. Reve decided to send a letter to the supreme leader of Lavu, and hope that her trivial matters would merit a response. The supreme leader was an expert on the history of Zeffon, so it was worth a shot. Something in Reve’s memory told her that mailing a letter to the leader was a dangerous move, but Reve ignored this instinctive conclusion, certain that the supreme leader, if unmoved, would just toss the letter out. Kerragan suddenly entered the room, looking very pale.
“Hello, Kerragan, are you feeling unwell?” Reve hid the letter she was writing to the Supreme Leader in the drawer to the dresser behind her. Kerragan didn’t have any response. He just simply stood there. Suddenly, he began to dash towards an open window.
“Kerragan! What are you doing?!”
Reve tackled her husband, throwing him onto the floor. Guards dashed into the room upon hearing the ruckus and quickly restrained him. Kerragan shouted and screamed, but the guards held him down firmly and tied him to a chair. It was clear to everyone that he had gone mad. During the next few days, Reve tried as hard as she could to make Kerragan snap out of it. The Windy Summit was already deliberating whether to put him to death.
Every beat of Nightmare's hooves just caused him to go faster. What was he running from?
"Nightmare!"
The couple were headed straight for a cliff.
"Nightmare!!"
It was no use. Without hesitation, the black horse performed a huge leap off the side of the rock. It was impossible to see the bottom of the canyon below them. Not only did the fissure exhibit the absence of any light, Roanin could not bear to look.
iv. Windy Summit
“Kerragan…”
Kerragan woke up. Either he was mad or this was a dream. He was on a beach composed of grey sand. To his right, there was a group of trees with a small wooden house and to his left, there was ocean as far as the eye could see he was on an island of sorts that was small enough that there was very little to make note of. There no sign of anyone or anything. Thus Kerragan decided to enter the only feature of the island – the house. As he made his way towards the structure, Kerragan noticed that there were plenty of frogs on the path before him, leaping out of the way as he proceeded forward. The house itself was supported on four beams in the mushy ground, and a pool of water had accumulated beneath it. Kerragan followed the steps that led to the porch of the structure and opened the door. There was no one in here, but there was a table and a single shelf of books. In the corner to the right, there was a bucket of dark green paint, almost empty…
That was it. There was a slight disturbance here. Tereban put his foot down on the leaves. Someone had fallen asleep here - the leaves were smushed flat. And then, those hoof prints in the dry dirt. The evening breeze had not yet completely destroyed the tracks in the trampled terrain. It seemed that there was a horse on the loose. But was there a chance that this was the horse he had seen before? There was always that possibility.
v. Foreboding
There was a slight disturbance here. Tereban put his foot down on the leaves. Someone had fallen asleep here - the leaves were crushed flat, and there were those hoof prints in the dry dirt. The evening breeze had not yet completely destroyed the tracks in the trampled terrain. It seemed that there was a horse on the loose. But was there a chance that this was the horse he had seen before? There was always that possibility. A growl was heard, but was just as quickly followed by the sound of an arrow slicing through the air and nailing the creature in the head. Just a small wolf who had been ejected from its pack. Nothing significant here. As Tereban turned slightly, he heard a scream from deep within the night, causing the crickets and frogs to stop for the time being. There was something out there. Something that he had not seen since his childhood. Now was not the time to be loafing about for Tereban, since the Royal Family had promised him a handsome reward for the location of the long-haired man, the man known as Nightmare. It seemed rather trivial to Tereban, since there was the time rift in between the Chaoslands and Unkardia. Yes, the Royal Family must want Nightmare and Roanin to themselves. It would help them return to Cuja, and then from there, a general escape could be made.
A growl was heard, but was just as quickly followed by the sound of an arrow slicing through the air and nailing the creature in the head. Peh. Just a small wolf who had been ejected from its pack. Nothing significant here. As Tereban turned slightly, he heard a scream from deep within the night, causing the crickets and frogs to stop for the time being.
vi. Filter Snap
Another scream ripped through the night. The Dwellers were coming out of the rift in the Putrid Sea, as well as their trees and caves and beginning to wreak havoc on those who were not wise enough to leave the forest in time. Tereban was experienced, though. There was nothing to worry about for him. The same could possibly not be said for Nightmare. Though he had lived in the forest for a while, there was a chance that even he could not face one of the Dwellers alone. There was his life at stake here, but more importantly, there was the money involved. That too would be trivial compared to the opportunity to travel back to Cuja. Yes, there were a good amount of things to be had, and there shouldn’t be any sort of slip-up. Tereban quickly made his way through the trees. Although it was pitch black and the moon barely manifested itself through the dense trees, Tereban could see just fine. Being one of Cuja’s 64 had its perks. Tereban then stopped short. He could smell blood. Sure enough, there was a massive cliff that led to the western edge of Unkardia’s Crystal Forest. Upon looking over the edge, Tereban noticed a small figure laying down on small beach, surrounded by a ghastly amount of dried blood. That must be the boy that was accompanying Nightmare. Nightmare himself had gone missing.
The Dwellers. They were coming out of their trees and caves and beginning to wreak havoc on those who were not wise enough to leave the forest in time. Tereban was experienced, though. There was nothing to worry about.
vii. Resolve
Roanin was brought to Castle Norfell by Tereban later that night. He was in a terrible state, being battered and bruised, his clothes torn to shreds, and he was covered in blood. There were few people in the castle that rainy night, as most of Castle Norfell was in disrepair, and it was used more as a hideout than an official government building. In truth, a lot of Unkardia was virtually lawless, with the Royal Family often sitting back in the shadows and allowing the Dwellers to rip apart the travelers caught in between towns, with just the walled cities of Rasoe and Ocsania to fend for themselves. Inside Castle Norfell lived a family of nine, much like the Windy Summit, but all being related by blood. The father, Norfell, had been destroyed by a type of assailant known as an Arc-Demai. The Arc-Demai were three different individual creatures that were created by an entity known as the Unknown Beast. The Unknown Beast itself lived up to its name, with no one knowing its purpose or its location. The only thing known about it is that it existed in the past. Tales of the battles of Eresymcaion and Muagarah, the two living components of the Unknown Beast plagued ancient manuscripts, to an extent that no one could not be fascinated by its prominence. In any case, the Arc-Demai known as Jackanapes decided to destroy Norfell due to his so-called “alliance” with the Greater Power, a god that watched over The Beginning, the place that Conan came from. Tereban was one of the infamous members of Cuja, and thus was allowed to enter Castle Norfell. Dragging the boy Roanin around had become tedious and rather difficult, so Tereban made his way to see his soldiers in the room close to what would be the throne room. Tereban, as a suitable commander of the Terror, ordered his men to gather. Putting the unconscious boy Roanin on the ground, Tereban’s men began to intently sniff and probe the body, as to get an idea of their target. With a wave of his hand, his men quickly ran outside of the castle and into the night with the speed of the wind.
"Ugh... My head..."
Roanin woke up to the sound and feeling of rain coming down through a misty dawn. He got up slowly and looked around. Nightmare was nowhere to be seen.
"That crazy horse! He's going to get a piece of my mind when I find him..."
Looking for tracks, Roanin only found those of a man. That man must have taken Nightmare! Wait... That would mean there would have to by horse tracks next to his own footprints. Strangely, there was nothing to be found. Even so, Roanin would have to get back to Sanders, the small village. His mother would be worried about him. Roanin looked briefly at the rising sun, and then headed west from it. Though there was probably nothing to worry about, Roanin had a bad feeling about what awaited him in the village.
viii. Zeffon
Turning around, Tereban saw Emeroch. The young man was the spawn of Norfell and Mathilda, which disturbed Tereban greatly. He wasn’t sure of any of the members of Cuja other than him and survived or not, but after Norfell and Mathilda had had seven children, the likelihood of a gathering was highly improbable. Yes, Tereban would have to continue on alone. Yet, it seemed as though he was not completely without members of Cuja, since the Ivory Music Box had not broken. Tereban quickly ran up the tower where the Ivory Music Box was kept. It was still on the pedestal. This device was the only thing that the goddess Sarah had left behind to keep the members of Cuja alive. If the music box still played its melody, then there were members of the clan still in existence. The issue that Tereban faced was that the members of Cuja were being constantly annihilated by the Arc-Demai, leading him to believe that was one of the few that was left. After the goddess Sarah died, she left the music box to her daughter Gretchen. Gretchen however, disappeared without a trace, leaving no heirs to the throne of Cuja. Thus, the remaining 62 members collectively became the next Queen. Among them were Norfell and Mathilda, as well as Tereban.
“Remembering your past…?”
Tereban whirled around. Emeroch was there, looking slightly timid as usual. Tereban simply pushed past the young man, and exited the chamber, silently walking down the stone stairs. Emeroch never meant to anger Tereban, but he hardly knew how to take his Cujaise blood “seriously”, or however Tereban tried to refer to has lack of interest in his ancestry. Despite his various attempts, Emeroch could never understand the goals that his father and mother had tried to leave his mentor to teach him. Was he just a failure, or was someone else destined to follow in his father’s footsteps? He just didn’t know.
The run was a long one. Without Nightmare, the sheer distance to Sanders was incredible. Luckily, with an hour, Roanin had made it back to the top of the cliff. Now to head home. Hopefully everyone will be fine despite my short absence.

Roanin woke up to the sound and feeling of rain coming down through a misty dawn. He got up slowly and looked around. Nightmare was nowhere to be seen. "That crazy horse! He's going to get a piece of my mind when I find him..." Looking for tracks, Roanin only found those of a man. That man must have taken Nightmare! Wait... That would mean there would have to by horse tracks next to his own footprints. Strangely, there was nothing to be found. Even so, Roanin would have to get back to Sanders, the small village. His mother would be worried about him. Roanin looked briefly at the rising sun, and then headed west from it. Though there was probably nothing to worry about, Roanin had a bad feeling about what awaited him in the village.
trackinfo.about: Through the iris of a placid eye, I understand that the goal has been on my mind this entire time.
trackinfo.credits: from Resolve, released July 30, 2010

trackinfo.title: Zeffon
trackinfo.lyrics: viii. Zeffon Turning around, Tereban saw Emeroch. The young man was the spawn of Norfell and Mathilda, which disturbed Tereban greatly. He wasn’t sure of any of the members of Cuja other than him and survived or not, but after Norfell and Mathilda had had seven children, the likelihood of a gathering was highly improbable. Yes, Tereban would have to continue on alone. Yet, it seemed as though he was not completely without members of Cuja, since the Ivory Music Box had not broken. Tereban quickly ran up the tower where the Ivory Music Box was kept. It was still on the pedestal. This device was the only thing that the goddess Sarah had left behind to keep the members of Cuja alive. If the music box still played its melody, then there were members of the clan still in existence. The issue that Tereban faced was that the members of Cuja were being constantly annihilated by the Arc-Demai, leading him to believe that was one of the few that was left. After the goddess Sarah died, she left the music box to her daughter Gretchen. Gretchen however, disappeared without a trace, leaving no heirs to the throne of Cuja. Thus, the remaining 62 members collectively became the next Queen. Among them were Norfell and Mathilda, as well as Tereban. “Remembering your past…?” Tereban whirled around. Emeroch was there, looking slightly timid as usual. Tereban simply pushed past the young man, and exited the chamber, silently walking down the stone stairs. Emeroch never meant to anger Tereban, but he hardly knew how to take his Cujaise blood “seriously”, or however Tereban tried to refer to has lack of interest in his ancestry. Despite his various attempts, Emeroch could never understand the goals that his father and mother had tried to leave his mentor to teach him. Was he just a failure, or was someone else destined to follow in his father’s footsteps? He just didn’t know. The run was a long one. Without Nightmare, the sheer distance to Sanders was incredible. Luckily, with an hour, Roanin had made it back to the top of the cliff. Now to head home. Hopefully everyone will be fine despite my short absence.
trackinfo.about: I had an incident when I was 5 years old - it followed the way of the old ones, and I have been traumatized ever since. I saw the old way and the light.
trackinfo.credits: from Resolve, released July 30, 2010

Zeffon.title: Rose Field
Zeffon.about:
In certain places I go to, I find circles of stones. Sometimes, I wonder curiously about their origins. I find out later when suddenly, I fall to the Earth. A misty haze builds up and I'm unable to do anything about it. Slowly I lose consciousness. When I wake up, I wonder whether anything has happened at all.
Of course, nothing like that is ever true.
As I rummaged through some of the foliage, I found what I was looking for. Somehow, I dreamt of a field of wild roses, and soon after I went to find them. As I looked closely and smelled the beautiful aromas, I looked up and saw a figure on the plains far away. It looked to be in pain and was distorting in various grotesque ways, but I couldn't be certain at this distance. In a sudden lack of attention on my part, the figure mysteriously vanished.
Zeffon.credits:
released October 17, 2014
Everything - Creighton Jenkins, TR, Knoll

trackinfo.title: Glaciate
trackinfo.lyrics: One Reve Isga decided one day to visit the Castle Uaa. She found it was devoid of humans, but filled with reptiles and birds. A small bird landed on her shoulder, and told her that the major spiritual Cashew Tree in Paradise (the first one ever grown) was wilting as of late. Reve did not know what to make of this.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Death Wall
trackinfo.lyrics: The bird told her that the Big Stick was an old branch from that tree. Reve had heard of the Big Stick before, and how whacking problems with it instantly solved them. She refused to believe that the solution to Zeffon's problems was that simple.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: The Lava Key Ritual
trackinfo.lyrics: Soon, the portal that was being manufactured in the frontier town of Barra became reality. Now, people could travel to a new dimension called Revenence.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Summer Solstice
trackinfo.lyrics: They took their children and their belongings and traveled to the new dimension. Soon, Zeffon was empty, save for a few people. When it was apparent that most of the people of Zeffon had made it through the new portal, the portal was closed off, and anyone that may have been allowed through was now left behind.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Bled the Idol of Ice
trackinfo.lyrics: There was one individual who somehow got left behind (she was in the ruins of Dotajmari at the time). She wielded the Forest Element of the Sharhodeon Forest, and was hiding from the trees that sought to take the element back.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Sacred Tundra
trackinfo.lyrics: Luckily, the Sulka found the young woman, and took her to Paradise. She initially didn't believe in the Big Stick either, but she began to believe when she was taken to Paradise.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Crowd of Nine
trackinfo.lyrics: Paradise is the only world beyond Zeffon to be perfect. Other worlds that were created by humankind were imperfect and were destined to meet the same fate as Zeffon, as Zeffon was created by humans who rose above and saw themselves as Gods and Lords.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Destroyer in Three Parts
trackinfo.lyrics: Paradise soon became the closest thing that Teran, the rescued woman, had to a home. The Big Stick was enshrined on a pedestal in the largest palace in the land of Paradise.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Vegetable Moon Sage (Rose Field)
trackinfo.lyrics: Teran didn't know what to think, but she quickly became enthused and it became clear that the only way to save her fellow humans was to have them believe in the Big Stick.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Triumph
trackinfo.lyrics: On that day, Teran was crowned High Queen of the Sulka, as she was one of few humans who believed in the Big Stick's tremendous power. She had the ability to convince her fellow humans that the solution to all their problems was less complicated and convoluted than many were initially led to believe.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Visitation of Strangers
trackinfo.lyrics: In the space of 50 years or so, Teran began to become very old, and she died on her 87th birthday. At this point, she had had three daughters: Ophelia, Natalie, and Yvette. Ophelia, the eldest, became High Queen after her mother's death. Natalie disappeared when Ophelia was young, and Ophelia led a search party to discover the fate of her long-lost sister. Yvette was left in charge of the kingdom.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Origin of the Falls
trackinfo.lyrics: Ophelia leads the party outside of Paradise, and into the nearby Gothoh Forest. The Sulka guarded the forest reverently, as this was their original home. Near the Gothoh Forest was the Jala Woods, a strange dark, dense forest with ruins of old houses in it.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Permafrost
trackinfo.lyrics: Ophelia knew the dangers of the Jala Woods, but led the party past the Gothoh Forest into the Jala Woods regardless, as she was certain this was the point of disappearance for her long-lost sister Natalie.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

trackinfo.title: Rose Field, Pt. 2
trackinfo.lyrics: As they crossed the Homroge Plain, a small clearing and field east of Gothoh Forest, with the Jala Woods further east of that, a soldier with a broken broadsword and a very pronounced limp approached from a small hill. His skin on his hands was a very dark blue, and he seemed to be in a lot of pain.
trackinfo.credits: from Rose Field, released October 17, 2014

Lydia told us that her psychic powers have diminished over the time that she's been in Revenence. She says that although she is very powerful in Zeffon, she's essentially another human being in this new dimension. This, according to her, is because of the Brown Star that is in the sky above Revenence. The Purple Star gave the psychic power to Lydia and her family, as well as a few others. No one has dared reopen the portal, but the mist seems to be attracting monsters from the other islands. A wall is supposedly going to be built close to the shore to ensure that demons don't arrive in Ter-El.

Zeffon.title: Sacrifice
Zeffon.about:
i. Man No. 19
An album composed of demos that were created over the years, each representing a political scandal or atrocity.
The file that contains information on Man No. 19 appears to have been burned at some point, but then rescued from the flames.
ii. Man No. 5
This file is missing.
iii. Man No. 44
Man No. 44 was considered an enemy of the state. He was swiftly destroyed by the powers granted to the state by the people.
iv. Man No. 3
An unknown amount of gratitude came from this man for having his life spared.
v. Man No. 25
This man started a rebellion in the depths of a cathedral that is located in Verimore. He was found out, but he managed to escape the cathedral on foot and avoid being spotted by the secret police. Unfortunately, this breath of free air did not last long.
vi. Man No. 24
This man did not managed to last long out in the frozen plains. He was running from political oppression, but died. His corpse was found with the skin missing from his feet and face.
vii. Man No. 23
Man No. 23 had two broken arms when he was located by the Rukla, the people a rank above the secret police. He had been severely beaten by an enemy of the state, and was killed to preserve state secrets.
viii. Man No. 22
He died in a horrific manner.
ix. Man No. 13
I understand nothing regarding the state secrets.
x. Man No. 17
In the cathedral where Man No. 25 was found, there was an antique organ that was damaged by Man No. 17. This being a cherished relic of the state, Man No. 17 was executed.
xi. Man No. 16
Not much is known about Man No. 16. He died in a horrific manner for being an enemy of the state.
xii. Man No. 14
Possible relation to the lich. He died for being an enemy of the state.
xiii. Man No. 59
This man is unrelated to the other men. He had knowledge of the Earth Element, and thus was treated fairly by the state. He had a unique character about him, and the state reports that he had been committed to an insane asylum in years past.
xiv. Man No. 12
Killed.
xv. Man No. 11
HDNWTTAI.
xvi. H.
This is about a man who died trying to protect his family. He is known only as "H". What this stands for has been lost.
xvii. C.O.
C.O. is the initials of someone who was hidden and killed by the state. He has no known living relatives, except for a 30-year-old man by the name of Leslie. Keep this a secret.
xviii. Man No. 62
Man No. 62, also known as LESLIE, is kept under close observation. He is not entitled to anything otherwise and is likely aware of the operation. He is related to the now-deceased "C.O.".
xix. Man No. 6
H: I don't understand what you're trying to tell me. Are you saying that Man No. 6 is trying to kill me?
ST: That's not what we're trying to tell <unintelligible>. You're being accused of killing someone. You know that, right?
H: I've never killed anyone in my life. Are you sure you have <unintelligible>?
ST: We are quite positive.
xx. The Spectral Dungeon
ST: Have a seat. We are under the impression that there is something that you can do for us.
F: That is correct. I can grant you immortality.
ST: Immortality? That's bogus.
F: Only to someone who does not believe. Dynamics-Sixteen is always looking for new people to serve.
ST: <unintelligible>
xxi. The Presence of Corruption
ST: Who <unintelligible>?
F: I cannot say because I am a free being.
ST: Free?
F: Yes. The being of the unknown state.
ST: You'll <unintelligble>!!
F: Oh trust me, you won't.
xxii. Moors and Assassins
Someone killed the state leader the other day. His remains were clumped into a pile that had practically decayed to nothing, even though his screams were only heard a minute earlier.
xxiii. Ominous Fog
It's rare to see an assassination in that regard. However, there are tales of this... thing. The thing that is part of the unknown and the forgotten, something that cannot be replaced.
xxiv. The Dusty Chapel Organ
I've been accused of being insane, but this organ is supposedly a relic of days past. There was something about it that could not be replaced, according to the caretaker of the chapel. Something to do with the unknown.
xxv. Stone Ruins and Gilded Stone Faces
Below the chapel are some of the oddest catacombs that one can find. It was very odd because the entrance was very well hidden, as if it was something that was not supposed to be found. In any case, down in the passages below, one can hear some sort of fire crackling noise, as if someone is burning a campfire down there. These ruins date to the Ognians, some say.
xxvi. Burning Castle Dränsilane Under Royal Decree
Last year, because of its notoriety to the people of Cathrop, Castle Dränsilane was torched and destroyed. No matter the trauma however, it will continue to destroy and eat away at the person it is carried by until it consumes the individual completely.
xxvii. Suffering Hour
I personally went down to explore the tunnels once. I had a flashlight, which was hard to import to Unkardia from Lavu, as the treat that very suspiciously - that is, the transport of any sort of goods from Lavu to Unkardia. It was the Memor Aag De-Suffering Hour in Unkardia, a distorted name given to this time of year to immortalize the year that the king Joha of the Ognians went mad and destroyed a fountain in the middle of a main city. Although this may not seem significant, it was a fountain that allowed anyone and everyone to look into the past.
xxviii. The Sound of Wings
Following the destruction of the fountain, a strange flapping noise was heard, which turned out to be one of the Arc-Demai that still continues to torment the island of Unkardia to this day. It was the Decaying Angel.
xxix. Musty Sewer Escape
The Ognian Empire managed to destroy the Decaying Angel, but it kept coming back. Like a zombie from the dead, it became stronger in death, allowing it to mutate and become unstoppable. Eventually, power of the kingdom was handed to a psychic named Luya in exchange for the sealing of the monster in the Temple of Faces. Luya disappeared inexplicably thereafter, supposedly having escaped through the sewers that ran to the Temple of Faces.
xxx. Null and Void
Luya was never heard from again, even when the Decaying Angel began to break through the seal in the Temple of Faces. The Decaying Angel managed to destroy the seal shortly thereafter, and flew high above Unkardia, tormenting the people all across the country. Later, a man claiming to be Luya's son appeared, and demanded the power of the kingdom, but the Ognians felt the deal was broken, as the Decaying Angel had broken free. The son then cursed the kingdom, condemning the people to walk as zombies for the rest of their existence, and to not know death.
xxxi. Age of Silence
Thus began a series of Dark Ages in Unkardia. The Ognian Empire collapsed, and the people began to be distorted by the curse, known as the Breath of the Undead.
xxxii. C.E. (Comes Next)
The son became known as Ryan, who ruled the kingdom from that day forth. There are several accounts of Ryan Isga, but although there are accounts of him existing peacefully with his brethren, he is commonly known among the people of Unkardia as an enemy. Ryan died a while later, having no one to inherit the kingdom. Norfell Isga appeared a while later in the Chaoslands. Bearing the same name as Ryan Isga, he gathered some of his followers and they began to rule over Unkardia as psychic lords.
xxxiii. Resistance
The people couldn't resist the takeover, as they were practically zombies at this point. Eventually, the undead bodies of the people of Unkardia were buried in the deepest chamber of Castle Emeroch. Castle Emeroch was a castle dedicated to Norfell's son, as Emeroch was called by his father to be the caretaker of the undead.
xxxiv. Unknown Falls
However, Norfell's son Uaa was caretaker of the tridead, a select group of people who had begun to develop psychic powers of their own after being dormant for the space of three years. These tridead became the source of Uaa's research, and from their bodies, he created a parasite that he named Gondii Maledicta.

trackinfo.lyrics: xvii. C.O. C.O. is the initials of someone who was hidden and killed by the state. He has no known living relatives, except for a 30-year-old man by the name of Leslie. Keep this a secret.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Man No. 62
trackinfo.lyrics: xviii. Man No. 62 Man No. 62, also known as LESLIE, is kept under close observation. He is not entitled to anything otherwise and is likely aware of the operation. He is related to the now-deceased "C.O.".
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Man No. 6
trackinfo.lyrics: xix. Man No. 6 H: I don't understand what you're trying to tell me. Are you saying that Man No. 6 is trying to kill me? ST: That's not what we're trying to tell <unintelligible>. You're being accused of killing someone. You know that, right? H: I've never killed anyone in my life. Are you sure you have <unintelligible>? ST: We are quite positive.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: The Spectral Dungeon
trackinfo.lyrics: xx. The Spectral Dungeon ST: Have a seat. We are under the impression that there is something that you can do for us. F: That is correct. I can grant you immortality. ST: Immortality? That's bogus. F: Only to someone who does not believe. Dynamics-Sixteen is always looking for new people to serve. ST: <unintelligible>
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: The Presence of Corruption
trackinfo.lyrics: xxi. The Presence of Corruption ST: Who <unintelligible>? F: I cannot say because I am a free being. ST: Free? F: Yes. The being of the unknown state. ST: You'll <unintelligble>!! F: Oh trust me, you won't.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Moors and Assassins
trackinfo.lyrics: xxii. Moors and Assassins Someone killed the state leader the other day. His remains were clumped into a pile that had practically decayed to nothing, even though his screams were only heard a minute earlier.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Ominous Fog
trackinfo.lyrics: xxiii. Ominous Fog It's rare to see an assassination in that regard. However, there are tales of this... thing. The thing that is part of the unknown and the forgotten, something that cannot be replaced.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: The Dusty Old Chapel Organ
trackinfo.lyrics: xxiv. The Dusty Chapel Organ I've been accused of being insane, but this organ is supposedly a relic of days past. There was something about it that could not be replaced,  according to the caretaker of the chapel. Something to do with the unknown.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Stone Ruins and Gilded Stone Faces
trackinfo.lyrics: xxv. Stone Ruins and Gilded Stone Faces Below the chapel are some of the oddest catacombs that one can find. It was very odd because the entrance was very well hidden, as if it  was something that was not supposed to be found. In any case, down in the passages below, one can hear some sort of fire crackling noise, as if someone is burning a campfire down there. These ruins date to the Ognians, some say.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Burning Castle Dränsilane Under Royal Decree
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Suffering Hour
trackinfo.lyrics: xxvii. Suffering Hour I personally went down to explore the tunnels once. I had a flashlight, which was hard to import to Unkardia from Lavu, as the treat that very suspiciously - that is, the transport of any sort of goods from Lavu to Unkardia. It was the Memor Aag De-Suffering Hour in Unkardia, a distorted name given to this time of year to immortalize the year that the king Joha of the Ognians went mad and destroyed a fountain in the middle of a main city. Although this may not seem significant, it was a fountain that allowed anyone and everyone to look into the past.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Sound of Wings
trackinfo.lyrics: xxviii. The Sound of Wings Following the destruction of the fountain, a strange flapping noise was heard, which turned out to be one of the Arc-Demai that still continues to torment the island of Unkardia to this day. It was the Decaying Angel.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Musty Sewer Escape
trackinfo.lyrics: xxix. Musty Sewer Escape The Ognian Empire managed to destroy the Decaying Angel, but it kept coming back. Like a zombie from the dead, it became stronger in death, allowing it to mutate and become unstoppable. Eventually, power of the kingdom was handed to a psychic named Luya in exchange for the sealing of the monster in the Temple of Faces. Luya disappeared inexplicably thereafter, supposedly having escaped through the sewers that ran to the Temple of Faces.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Null and Void
trackinfo.lyrics: xxx. Null and Void Luya was never heard from again, even when the Decaying Angel began to break through the seal in the Temple of Faces. The Decaying Angel managed to destroy the seal shortly thereafter, and flew high above Unkardia, tormenting the people all across the country. Later, a man claiming to be Luya's son appeared, and demanded the power of the kingdom, but the Ognians felt the deal was broken, as the Decaying Angel had broken free. The son then cursed the kingdom, condemning the people to walk as zombies for the rest of their existence, and to not know death.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Age of Silence
trackinfo.lyrics: xxxi. Age of Silence Thus began a series of Dark Ages in Unkardia. The Ognian Empire collapsed, and the people began to be distorted by the curse, known as the Breath of the Undead.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: C.E. (Comes Next)
trackinfo.lyrics: xxxii. C.E. (Comes Next) The son became known as Ryan, who ruled the kingdom from that day forth. There are several accounts of Ryan Isga, but although there are accounts of him existing peacefully with his brethren, he is commonly known among the people of Unkardia as an enemy. Ryan died a while later, having no one to inherit the kingdom. Norfell Isga appeared a while later in the Chaoslands. Bearing the same name as Ryan Isga, he gathered some of his followers and they began to rule over Unkardia as psychic lords.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Resistance
trackinfo.lyrics: xxxiii. Resistance The people couldn't resist the takeover, as they were practically zombies at this point. Eventually, the undead bodies of the people of Unkardia were buried in the deepest chamber of Castle Emeroch. Castle Emeroch was a castle dedicated to Norfell's son, as Emeroch was called by his father to be the caretaker of the undead.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

trackinfo.title: Unknown Falls
trackinfo.lyrics: xxxiv. Unknown Falls However, Norfell's son Uaa was caretaker of the tridead, a select group of people who had begun to develop psychic powers of their own after being dormant for the space of three years. These tridead became the source of Uaa's research, and from their bodies, he created a parasite that he named Gondii Maledicta.
trackinfo.credits: from Sacrifice, released June 26, 2013

Zeffon.title: Sage Alone on a New Island!
Zeffon.about:
i. New Lands
The five people who came up with the plan to make it into the Frogplain came from a very different world. The two that remained following 2510's passing were the ones that decided to take a different approach regarding the control of Zeffon. Although 2510 regarding everything that had been created as trash, the two remaining individuals, whom had given themselves different names, decided there were a couple of people worth saving.
New Lands refers to the creation of the lands of the five. Before, they were a group of friends who managed to venture into the forbidden Frogplain. The Golden Statue, the guardian of the large expansive wetland, did nothing to defeat the intruders, and hence they were able to do as they pleased. The friends were given a mission by a non-existent group called Dynamix16: Destroy the world of Zeffon, and you will be rewarded.
ii. The Sage's Wilderness
No one knows the origins of Dynamix16, but they have been described by different names in the past. The main idea behind their existence is that "they have never existed in the perspectives of those who have heard or comprehended them".
2510. _garimorg. 256. ars-y-var. Behindhand. Keliu.

Zeffon.title: Sand
Zeffon.about:
i. Sand
It's a relief I found this book after all these years. Things have been a little tricky over at the factory lately, and I was currently wondering if we'll have enough gasoline to complete our large task that we have at hand. Perhaps it's a matter that I'll have to consult with the minister about. Come to think of it, I'll probably be contacting him a lot.
ii. The Truth
Things are a bit hazy ever since I left for the tropical island Anne overseas. The fresh air here in Dragös is quite nice compared to that spit of land in the ocean. I'd stay here, but duty calls me elsewhere.
iii. Untitled
Update: The little angels that oversee the Marshcrown have been torn to shreds - blood covered everything from the chapel to the hallways. I swear I heard their distraught voices echoing throughout the chamber. I left immediately and called the police through a payphone. Luckily, I was not detained. Since the Marshcrown was such a valuable treasure for the royal family of Icrifeani, they've sent squads and squads of soldiers looking for it! It's not like it's any of my concern. What is it, other than some precious heirloom! It's not like the angels mattered either, apparently. The kingdom's priorities are outside of reason!
iv. In Mourning of Eresymcaion
I recently heard of a horrible tragedy that befell the local sanctuary. Hopefully nothing horrible has happened. There were a lot of sirens in the town, and the bells on the towers were ringing madly. I have no idea what has unleashed such chaos and pandemonium, but I intend to stay off the streets for today. The "gift" that I ordered that is undoubtedly waiting at the post office by now has likely arrived. I'm praying that they'll hold on to it for a couple of days before I send the boy out to obtain it.
v. Lapis Lapis
I was recently reading a copy of the Disynxiym, when a man came knocking at my door. He said he wanted me to obtain a package for him, but I told him that he had missed his chance. The rent was due for over a month, and I had no intention of returning the lack of favors this old scab of a man had done for me. I politely told him to run along, and then gave the door a satisfying slam to tell him that when rent is due, there is no "I'll have it in a week". I think he got the message. From this point on, there'll be no more disturbances until I can finish my studies.
vi. Kingdom of the Undead
A most unusual thing has popped up in the book. It seems to be a cryptic message of sorts. but I'm having trouble decoding it. My butler seemed especially fearful today, as I have come to notice - he could barely stand still. I swear he's probably hiding something. If he's found out a lick of what I've been trying to decipher for the latter part of my life, I'll throw him on the street. I have no tolerance for that kind of snooping.
vii. Mortal Art
I seem to think the painting on the wall is trying to speak to me. It's an old one. We've had it since the dawn of time as far as I can remember (basically a long time). It's an old Unkardian painting of a lady with long wavy grey locks and a suit of chain mail. In her hand is a sword. It seems rather obtuse, but the thing is, it whispers my name when I turn my back to it. If I try to ignore it, I feel something poking me in the back, as if a long sword was there. Of course, when I turn around, the painting is the same as its always been. I think I'd better get another job. This one pays well, but the master of the house is rather critical of my "suspicious behavior", or so he calls it. If he keeps that up, I'll have no reason to stay.
???. ???
The funny thing is, is that it turns into some sort of vortex when the light is right and the no one's actually consciously observing that painting. Strange isn't it? I think I'll call it "The Strange Old Lady", just for the sake of being consistent with the subject portrayed. Hahaha...

Zeffon.title: Search
Zeffon.about:
i. Introduction
Another day arises.
ii. Mysterious Disappearance
The remaining leaders of the previous Lavulese government are searched for. They are as follows:
No. 9: Victor Keller (assassinated)
No. 8: Félix Oarr (deceased)
No. 7: Ryce Ilhid (alive - granted immunity for his actions against the government he was in)
No. 6: Kerragan Cathrop (missing)
No. 5: Nathaniel Short (assassinated - killed by Kerragan Cathrop for unknown reasons - apparently was one of the Four Brothers)
No. 4: Keshka Metmarshe (alive - granted immunity for similar actions like Ryce Ilhid)
No. 3: Lamont Ferastille (assassinated)
No. 2: Conrad Small (assassinated - killed by two unknown men who are still at large)
No. 1: Rowland Meylith (Domnik) (missing - was captured, but disappeared into thin air...)
The disappearance of Rowland befuddles search teams who are bent on apprehending the vicious leader.
iii. Putrid Crater Depths
Excavations at Unknown Falls are resumed, ever since being suspended by the government of the Seraph Territories. According to documents, a new dimension was found here. While digging, men find a cavern filled with mist. Its floor continues to descend into the depths of the Earth.
iv. Dream Path
The ruler of the Marat Empire, in a sudden move, declares war on the rest of the world. Soldiers are sent from all countries in a rare collaboration, responding to the threat. The takeover is quick, since the Marati soldiers are not even willing to go to war. In the presidential palace, a caretaker suddenly witnesses the shadow of their leader, the High Prince Vant Ruan. It looks much different than his actual body. It's almost shaped like a giant bird.

Zeffon.title: Serenade for the Dead (Autumn V)
Zeffon.about:
So, here's a compilation of tracks that date back to 2012. In fact, today is the 13th anniversary of their complete publication, and thus November 20th became THE DAY to publish it as a compilation.
I don't really like posting compilations because they feel a little like a cop-out for posting actual new material. Given that the Serenade for the Dead in its entirety is one of 52 works in the 4300 SERIES (called PCO, usually goes by the name Chaosfoundry in a lot of cases), it made sense to at least post it all as a single album. The goal here mostly aesthetic, since the artwork is meant to reveal a little about the small world that I have spent many years crafting. These tracks all have an association with a specific element.
More music is coming soon.

Zeffon.title: Shocker Infiltration Strategy
Zeffon.about:
I noticed then when I woke up with the moon's light in my eyes that a man was sitting cross-legged on the same ledge as me. Startled, I got up, but the man held up his hand and for some reason, I felt calmer. As he turned to me, I noticed both his eyes were missing, and he asked me in somewhat of a gentle voice if I could help him. I felt that he was some sort of sorcerer based on how out-of-place my sense of ease was. How else would someone react to a blind man who somehow showed up next to you without your knowing?
"Don't worry, I won't hurt you."
"What gave you the idea that I'm scared? I haven't moved a muscle."
"If I had the ability to find you on an obscure cliff face in the middle of nowhere and climb such a monstrosity, I'd probably have the ability to at least perceive your countenance."
"Fair enough."
His empty eyes peered in my direction. I knew he couldn't see, but I dared not move, nor try to reach for the short bow I had packed with a few of my belongings.
The man had an item for me, or so he said. It looked like an ages-old grimoire with a fair amount of pages missing. Given his lack of sight, he asked me to read a page he had flipped open to. I recognized the script as Ghelian - one of two languages I spoke and read, the other being Neo-oceanic, the language of the folk living in the ravine. The page he had requested I read regarded a horse and his woman, the Lady Ijianne (Ee-Gee-Ann) of the Forest, who ruled a Castle Ophelia at one point. The Lord of Her Lands, she brought a failing city state back from the brink of destruction with Crystal-Shroud-Bearing, a throwing axe with origins unknown. Her horse was a mare with a rich chocolate and white mane with a body resembling the darkness of midnight. As I relayed this information to the man, he frowned, and then he stated that he wasn't sure if he had given me the right material to read.
"I might've gotten the wrong tome..." he said with a slight smile peaking on his left cheek. "Well, that's a shame." As he said these things, I began to feel drowsy, and I nodded off. When I woke, he was nowhere to be seen. As I looked about, I did feel a voice in my head say something strange:
"With the power you wield, you may cause wells of deluge to dry into nothingness".
I couldn't perceive who the voice was from.

Zeffon.title: Shorelines III
Zeffon.about:
i. Shorelines III
Just like the Rider of Inejeheim was a legend, the legend of the Limping Man of Ruptured Heart continues to haunt those who fled Unkardia to come the Wysteriascape. The Limping Man originates from tales of a mirage of man, bleeding profusely from his arms and chest, that appears in the forests of Unkardia. The legend is that it is the ghost of Emeroch, one of the two Isga brothers and once monarch of Anne. The fable tells of how he tried to tap into the power of the Bell of Noor. The bloodthirsty bell demands a hefty sacrifice of both blood and meat in order to be used sparingly by an individual. The bell can hone instinct, but at the price of your own well-being. This drove Emeroch mad, as he tried and tried to become a flawless human. Legend has it that before accomplished his goal, the bell took his entire body.

Zeffon.title: Shorelines VI, or Orshaiee Festival Tables with Feasts Grow Wings
Zeffon.about: As the night fell, something seemed... off. Morgan had begun to tread nervously through the foliage before becoming sufficiently unnerved and making the decision to return to the side of the ravine. Setting up a campfire in a depression in the brief threshold of bare land that separated the dense woods and the cliffside, Morgan sat down as the sun completely disappeared from the horizon and the residual glow was extinguished. As the fire began to die down to mere embers, a large glowing moon emerged from the eastern treetops, and the light it cast began to ebb towards Morgan's position. The shadows posed by the trees had begun to slink away when Morgan heard her name screamed from the south. Glancing to her left, there was a figure standing in the moonlight with a shiny reflection emanating from the blood streaming down its head. The figure shouted for her to run, which she did, briefly running for the north before making a sharp right into the eastern trees.

Zeffon.title: Silver Demo
Zeffon.about:
i. Scrrech
The sound of chains echoed through the hallway outside, followed by tortured screams.
ii. Silver
In the depths of a once pristine forest rests the ruins of an old Unkardian Temple. The year is 1802. The world has ended above the surface, but a prison below the dust-covered stone continues to operate, being patrolled by undead beastmen who were told by the warden that he would one day return. Only once that day arrives will they be able to rest in peace. The world was so-called “destroyed” following the destruction of the Magot Tower by the True Calignosity in 1567. The Magot Tower was constructed solely out the limbs of fallen enemy soldiers, with flesh still attached to the bone. Once Exeräise was conquered by the True Calignosity, the leader of the country made a decree to destroy the tower. Once the men were positioned with their ropes, a beast of massive proportions emerged from the Earth where the foundations of the tower were laid. With one swipe of his arm, he obliterated Meredith, the island of the Marat Empire, causing massive tsunamis and earthquakes, as well as filling the atmosphere with dust. And so the world withered under his influence. If only everyone had been paying attention to the warnings surrounding the two bells…
~
By the time the sound of chains had stopped, the man looked back at the mirror. The glass was shattered.

Zeffon.title: Solar Flare
Zeffon.about:
I heard about this once.
A man who worked for another man named Charlie was trying to assassinate a certain man who was connected to the forest south of Ramalest. The certain man was sensitive to sunlight.
I was concerned that the certain man was going to be killed, so I found his would-be assassin and killed him first. He never knew what hit him.
I watched with some apathy as the workers tore down the moldy apartment where the certain man had once lived. It was clearly a mess.
In any case, I've felt the need to write down some of the strange happenings that I've been experiencing. There is indeed some amount of curious horror that has infected the populace of Ramalest as of late, and I am no exception. Following the discovery of the would-be assassin, we (as in our household of three) began to hear howling to the north. My husband had died two years ago for defying the order that is Ramalest, and I don't blame the government at all. He was a coward and bloodthirsty fool who wished to decimate the greatest empire of all time. I was left with my daughter and son, the latter of whom had spent quiet evenings outside of town in the woods. I told him not to do that, but he wouldn't listen.
Later, he brought in a strange book. This book was filled with symbols that I instantly recognized as Oasis script. Oasis is a small island nation that exists (or did exist) north of Ghel. It was invaded by Kin's Forces later during the year of my visit there, so I was lucky to escape with my life; those soldiers wouldn't have recognized me at all. In any case, the North has always been a little strange in the sense that it seems to be a gateway to a different world. Kin, one of my friends since my youth and Supreme Leader of Ghel had established the theory of "True North". In the old days, Ghel was cursed to be the keeper of the Sun and the Moon; both celestial bodies were "summoned" routinely through the construction of Suntowers and Moontowers. They were also doomed to become Arc-Demai at the age of 100 years (or so I've heard, I may be wrong).
Anyway, my son said that a stranger had given him the tome he was holding and he had been instructed to give it to me. As I read it, I began to realize who the author was, despite his name not appearing anywhere in the substantial volume. It was Kin.
Kin had never spoken any language besides the language spoken by the Arc-Demai, so naturally, when I saw his hand in the Oasis script, I was intrigued. After flipping through the pages, a letter tumbled to the ground. As I read it, I began to understand what was going on. Apparently, he had been captured by some people loyal to Oasis. Despite the initial success of the invasion and following occupation, the army was suddenly overwhelmed by cultists practicing some of the darkest magic, magic that even the spell-wielding descendants of the Arc-Demai had not seen for ages or had never seen at all. He was contracted to help them with a comprehensive tome that the cultists had been throwing together, and his knowledge of spells specific to the Arc-Demai was critical to its completion. In return, the cultists swore not to harm and destroy his people. Oasis was apparently their connection between their world and ours.
Stop the sun.

trackinfo.lyrics: Suddenly, the symmetry was broken. How on earth was that done? In any case, a sign was made and seen when a raven was seen with a large branch in its beak, a cashew glued to the tip that glistened in the breaking daylight.

Zeffon.title: Something Wicked
Zeffon.about:
i. Chemical Rain
The following journals are that of a woman named Madeline. She was apparently daughter of royalty, but she became obsessed with the unknown. Apparently, she recovered, but these journals still reflect her mental state.
ii. Something Wicked
As Reve pushed through the branches and leaves, she became unsettled by the groaning and creaking either brought on by the wind in the old trees, or something else that had yet to be explained. There wasn't a lot of time to dilly-dally, though. Reve had come to accept that Gaine was dead, not by any conventional means, but by an ancient foe, one that desired a human body that it was not born with.
iii. Burning Fire of Fires
A pistol that was used to shoot DU was found the other day. It was dirty and cloven to the point of disappointing consequences. I hate to say it, but I am SICK and tired of these fires that keep turning down the iron sheets that they use in the factory. The fires are very keen about this.
iv. Glass Bottle
The trees were getting thicker. Surely there was some point to this. You only ventured this far east of Lavu in order to talk to a ghost. This was a very important ghost, one that you had met as a child. It was only recently that you had a dream about the ghost again, and it felt so real, you felt it was necessary to run all the way out here. But that isn't the only reason you would come out here. There's someone else somewhere in the trees. They're following you. And you know it.
v. Treasure Trove
The unknown is an entity of various beings. The I is a single being, but cannot be destroyed. Apparently, there is a treasure hold in the Gum Bay. The Gum Bay is part of an island made through the processes of Muagarah and Eresymcaion. It exists, but it struggles to keep its head above water. In the end, it insulates the wooden heads and rotting corpses beneath it.
vi. The Long Road Home (Execution)
There's a trail beneath the trove island. It is called Sumine, and it is for all the souls who are cloven. I am lost as well, but I did not entirely understand the bearing that my existence had on the end of the long road home.
vii. Orchid Pact
As much as I don't understand, I wish to obtain help and assistance for my predicament. It pains me, but I must see my mother.

Zeffon.title: SRF020
Zeffon.about:
The 10th Box came tumbling down from the sky. We avoided opening it for years. We even built a temple around it and called it the Wysteriascape. We had no idea whether the (thing) Box would ever be opened, in fact. It still remains a mystery.
For the most part, we remained sane. We were never visited by Dynamix16 again, and soon, it had been around 50 years since we landed on the surface of this new world.
Another 25 years later, we ran into a tribe who had lived in the world before us. They were very kind, but warned us that our way of living was bad for the Earth god. The Earth god was the one who would cause havoc if we managed to anger him, they said. We heeded this warning for as long as we could. Being from a different dimension had caused us to want to believe just about anything we heard. Information was all we really wanted.
By this time, we realized that we were not aging. We were just existing perfectly, without the ability to die. We felt awful.
The tribe let us know about a way we could end the suffering. "If you find a box," they said, "Open it."
-2TSS.

Zeffon.title: State of Mind
Zeffon.about:
i. State of Mind
Part one of Kerragan's prophetic dream sequence. In these particular visions, Kerragan sees the creation of a human bradyzoite.
Kerragan moved towards the shores of Anne and thought for a bit. He needed to get off the isle of Anne. There was great punishment that awaited him here.
”Kill the intruders.”
”What?”
Kerragan heard a voice in his head, but then realized it was his own. Fusing souls was getting to be a pain, since two souls were trying to operate as one. Gaine was a wimp who never deserved to be heir to the throne, though. Luckily has soul should fade away within a few days. Yet, it seemed that he was still hanging on, which troubled Emeroch greatly. After course of the next few days, Kerragan would have these internal wars with himself, trying to establish some sort of peace of mind. Unfortunately, it just wasn’t happening.
”…”
Another presence entered Kerragan’s head. This one made his blood run cold. And with that, Kerragan suddenly grew drowsy and was soon asleep.
ii. Anxiety
Kerragan woke up. He wasn’t on the shores of Anne anymore, that was for sure. He was in the middle of some sort of jungle. He pulled out his longsword and began to slice through the various cobwebs and vines that were all around him. This might be his doing. It might be.
iii. Movement
”Kill the intruders…”
The voice kept repeating the statement in Kerragan’s head, until it began to grow monotonous.
iv. Audio
Unbeknownst to Kerragan, there was a certain force at work, manipulating Kerragan’s vision so that he would find his way.
v. Microscope
Aside from the many secret locations in the entire world, one of which is the Wysteriascape. The Wysteriascape is a city established deep in the jungle, known only to a handful of humans, namely, the Uaa, Vagard Tekraona, and some of the other people on or from the Fourth Continent. The Wysteriascape is a city with access that you’re only born with. Any others who have attempted to even get close to this city have failed miserably. In the Isga’s quest for immortality, they discovered this odd quality in some of the humans they would imprison and possess. The Wysteriascape, according to legend, is on the Fifth Continent, one that has never been discovered, since it is said to be in the fifth corner of the map of the world.
vi. 69!
In the Wysteriascape, there are certain devices that can give you immortality and control over the universe. Like the Cave of Origin, the Wysteriascape both highly desirable to access, and hard to find. Not everything about the Wysteriascape is highly sought after, though. The Wysteriascape is filled with traps and various torture devices. Despite the fact the civilization that inhabited the legendary city has been dead for quite some time, the dangers still exist. It is only when you reach the end of the city that you will get your reward.
The fast paced society
Moves through the streets
With blistering, dubious speed
They run and they walk
But they do not talk
The speed is all that they need
Never colliding
Never conflicting
They are just part of a massive system
vii. Red and Blue
One of the ancient tales tells of a Death Machine that exists in the End Temple of the Wysteriascape. According to legend, a man who was said to be able to see the future was put on trial and killed by the Death Machine when found guilty. The Death Machine bled him so quickly, his body turned blue before he died.
viii. Sinemu
Eventually, the people of the Wysteriascape became so agitated towards the prophets that grew up in their town, that they destroyed them all. Only one escaped. Despite being forbidden by law, the boy escaped on a boat into the ocean, never to return.

Zeffon.title: Stone Man
Zeffon.about:
This album begins a new story within the world of Zeffon.
~~~
i. Before Them (Wisdom Lost)
On an isle far out in the ocean, a man crawled from a piece of driftwood that he had been hanging onto for the longest time. He couldn't remember anything, other than he was supposed to find "them". Although he knew nothing about "them", he was continuously skeptical regarding all this "them" and "they" business. That was one of the things he remembered anyway: delirious minds were the euphoria of others.
ii. Parallels in Azure or Cyan
He found a forest that led him away from the beach and began to think of things to construct that would spare him the dangers that may descend upon him come the nightfall. He looked about him and found a few items in the brush. There was a strange cloth that glowed ominously as well as what appeared to be a rusty sword. There appeared to be a name engraved on the blade, but it was difficult to make out. All that was known was that it started with an "J". The sun beat down on the shipwrecked survivor, who was becoming hot and beginning to hallucinate. It wasn't necessarily that he had been exploring forever, but something within him desired that he take a quick rest.
iii. Ghost White
The next day, the man made a fort. It wasn't much to look at, but he knew that it was good enough for him to survive in, and thus it was all that he needed. The sun continued to beat down on the dreary lone man and he began to get the distinct impression that he was being watched. His suspicions were sort of confirmed when a much smaller man washed up on the same shore that he had been lying on the day before. The tricky bit was that the smaller man looked exactly the same as the larger one. In fact, the larger man could have sworn that he was staring at a reflection, if it hadn't been that he was lying on the beach. Suddenly, the clouds began to gather and rain began to pour. The larger man decided that he would give the body a proper burial. Within minutes, the rain had soaked the island and ruin the fort that the man had built so carefully to withstand the sun. Shivering, he began to make his way to the cover of the forest that lay on the rather small island. Soon, all would be well.
iv. The Administrative Portal
After dragging the corpse to his shelter, the larger man couldn't brush away the feeling that he was still being observed in some way. He decided that it didn't matter and began to dig into the soft mushy soil below him. The sound of the rain beginning to subside gave him some sense of relief, and he began to mutter to himself. How did he get here? Who were "they"? Why was he trying so hard to search for them? He imagined that he was no longer this victim, but a distant observer, making note of his prey from a hill in a coniferous forest full of dried-up riverbeds and red cedar trees. The vision excited him a little bit, since the victim didn't see him coming until he drew his bow and shot him in the back. The victim cried out, but was quickly and hastily subdued by the power of the arrow, and soon, the victim was dead. As the large man approached his kill, he noted the victim was like the man he was trying so desperately to bury. This man looked less like him given that his neck was horribly scarred, like he had survived an assassination attempt like this before, but was then distraught when he realized he wouldn't be getting out of it this time. The large man then noticed that he was carrying a small slip of paper. It looked like it was ripped out of a tome of some sort, perhaps something that was once incredibly obscure and valuable. The note read something to the effect of "parallels", which didn't strike the large man in any particular way, other than that it was indeed just a random slip of paper. Then he remembered something. His name was Cyane.
v. Blind
He had been dreaming. The corpse was gone. In its place was a hand, one made of stone.
vi. Doctor, Doctor, Minister
Then Cyane woke up. He realized that he had had the sixth dream. He went to report that to his superiors. What the dream he just witnessed meant was something that was a mystery to him, but he realized its divine nature.
vii. 87F
The temperature of the administrative portal was fairly hot, as the dream farm was located in a strange desert, surrounded by flowing rivers of quicksand.
viii. Map of the Entire World
The administrators told Cyane to go back to sleep. With any luck, he might summon the Dream VII or the seventh dream. The wars outside of the town had ceased to exist, so many of the people of the land took the opportunity to go outside of the town walls.
ix. Bomber Robbery / In La Mention
It is said that Yeueooohh is the name of a dragoon that wished to conquer the lands beyond the town. As his name suggests, he was a follower of the Third Eye. He made his way to the only mountain peak on the horizon and jumped to the top with ease. It was there he saw that there was very little beyond flat sandy desert to explore. Or perhaps there wasn't. Maybe it was all a mirage. In the distance, the giant sand worms leapt and moved throughout the dunes.
x. A Mysterious Distorted Guest
The chaos invoked by the mysterious guest had changed Zeffon completely. We knew we were stage two of the dimension. The Chaoslands had been expanded to a vast, vast desert, with the capital of the world placed in the middle. Oooograh was the name of the town originally, but it finally became known as Ratayu, as a sort of ward against what lie beyond the sands.
xi. Valentine
The strange things that began to take place were the fault of the three gods, but then a fourth one began to make itself known in the middle of the desert. This one was the former Trahma of the Groooalaahh clan (the leader). The Trahma began to experiment, coming up with a way to tap into the Lunar Plane from Ratayu and thus become a god.
xii. #0_800003051757813
The Battle of Yteia began to take place as this Trahma began to rise from the ground and take on the two warring gods, as well as the Third Eye. Not all was right with the world, and soon it became obvious that something needed to be done.
xiii. Greed
A young girl by the name of Caria, the only daughter of a woman named Madeline Crowa appeared in the town one day, after a portal opened and just as quickly closed, depositing Caria in the town square. She was nursed back to health and when she realized that there were still problems occurring between Eresymcaion and Muagarah (albeit with new gods in the mix), she became contemplative, trying to figure out how to stop the four powers from warring.
xiv. Reverse
The essence of Dream VIII, or the eighth dream began to wander around the town of Ratayu, looking for a vessel to spread its message. It found Caria.
xv. Terraformed Fortress of Winds
The first dream (Dream I) occurred when the people of Ocsania began to have nightmares and moved to Viandor across the sea. Ever since, the people of Zeffon in various stages and dimensions have made it their duty to seek out additional dreams. Dream VIII, or the eighth dream began to become a very apparent vision for Caria, and she saw a strange swampy land filled with ancient statues and the like, as well as a fortress that could house the likes of the gods.
xvi. A Cursed Avenger of Sorts
It became clear of the Battle of Gagrhe that there was a fifth god coming into play. Eresymcaion knew that its battle had been lost, and thus retreated into the ancient ruins beyond the desert, perhaps to never be seen again.
xvii. Scales
Vald was the name of the fifth god, who came into existence from across the sea. He brought his followers with him and decimated the old Temple of Muagarah, causing Muagarah to become wrathful. It became clear that there was no hope for the Vald as Muagarah descended upon him.
xviii. A Path to the Vacant Dream
The strange battle of Yuuuggureaooooh occurs during this time. At this point, the administration has gone crazy searching for the eighth dream, as they haven't realized that it has been Caria who has had it.
xix. The Stranger With A Lamp
The stranger who originally moved Zeffon to its second phase appears in the middle of the town square in Ratayu, causing a very loud ruckus that causes many civilians to dash to the square to see what's going on.
xx. 11: Unwelcome Dwellers, Water Book
The stranger leaves behind a very specific clue addressed to Caria: do not drink the water in the pyramid, regardless of what you do. It is poison.
