Zeffon.title: The Unanswered Question
Zeffon.about:
- Love Ballad (Hatross Tribute)
Greetings from the Sharhodeon Territories (or what's left of it). My name is Rufus Maye, and I am the scribe for my friend Lauren, who resides in the Seraph Territories. As you may have read in the cryptic beginnings of this piece, we in Zeffon have thoroughly refined our understand of how we believe dimensions work. All of the credit (or most of, to avoid giving her all the credit; she did work with others) goes to an Unkardian scientist of Anne Library fame. She is none other than the mighty Adelais Isga, with a little help from her colleagues, as I have implied.
On the 5th of March, around the year 300, Zeffon made a close encounter with what Lydia Isga refers to as "The Lunar Plane". No one knows what it is exactly, and Miss Lydia has been relatively silent, despite her commitment to science. Founding the Library of Anne is no small feat. Apparently, only women know where it is.
Anne is an island off the west coast of Unkardia with a battered history. Lauren has been there, but as a resident of the Seraph Territories, she is sensitive to sunlight. Most towns are underground in the Seraph Territories, as sunlight sensitivity is something all of the residents share.
- All I Wanna Do Is Love You An' There Ain't No More
In any case, Lauren was led to the Library by Adelais and Lydia Isga, since she apparently qualified to see the cursed Diary of Fair Onrac. Lauren has made me privy to the information held within. I'll explain some of it now.
A little backstory: according to my proxy (I'll give an example of proxy after a bit here), a dimension is fluid, meaning its location and borders fluctuate wildly. This said, a dimension's criteria can be found in other places. For example, Zeffon's handroteim was located on Earth at one point. A dimension originates from the Nofolkomé, a Tree of All Things. A dimension's "borders" are not immediately obvious, and do not necessarily cause physical change of the surroundings. A walk from one end of a hall to the other may be a dimensional change, despite never having left the hallway.
Thus, there needs to be some sort of criteria for each dimension's actual existence, as I referred to earlier using those odd words. If you're wondering why I'm not using pronouns for those, I'll explain later. However, it was by this concept of dimensions that a woman, a key component of another dimension, came by the Diary of Fair Onrac and gave it to the Anne Library.
- Nothin' T'lose
According to Lydia Isga, a lof od Adelais' work was derieved from this volume. She and Adelais, along with the late Queen Mathilda their mother, were the only individuals who could read past Fair's cryptic scribblings (yes, Fair is the name of a young man, not a descriptive word). According to another sacred tome called The Tales of Inejeheim and Igen, a tome that has been (luckily) printed in small quantities (around 75 copies exist at the moment), Igen was the mother of Fair Onrac, and the tome tells more about Fair than his own diary.

Zeffon.title: To Gather...
Zeffon.about:
i. Ramh
The pond dried up
And so did the falls
And soon there was no water
But there was something else instead
Let the sun shine through the pillar that does lean
And bestowed will be a device to see the unseen
Be cautious and beware
In the cave that is Dim
For when it is lit
The Ramh shall tear you to shreds
And so it is writ.
In the older towns that dot the land of Zeffon, very few have as much of a history as Gree. Gree is very isolated, and was formed because of the energy of the Earth that resonated from the area. It is also near Unknown Falls, where a very rare type of squid live. But the main reason for Gree's formation was to taunt the Pathiers by building a town on one of their ancient gravesites. Pathiers contest that Zeffon was formed out of the mind of a man - a man whose disappointment in death was so great that it spawned a world. The victims of this man's campaigns were remembered with a grave marker, which served as a cornerstone for the town's large wall.
ii. Phase Seven
In the older days of Zeffon, there was a split in timelines when a woman named Terra Lyeon (from whom Reve Terra Lyeon takes her name) made a fundamental decision to travel back in time to stop the creation of a curse in Zeffon's formation period. No one knows how old Zeffon really is, or how many different people have lived in it, but they do know that there was a time when the Chaoslands were cursed, and this led to people migrating across the ocean.
iii. Unclear Paths
Terra Lyeon was successful, creating an alternative timeline where she saved the Chaoslands from being doomed to being uninhabitable. It was in this timeline that the trees began to grow in such a manner that they blocked out the light of the sun. Soon, the only town left that was not devastated by foliage was Gree, where Terra Lyeon built a wall marked with wards to keep the plants from enveloping the town.
iv. Rehearsal Piece
Gree in the first unmodified timeline though, has had a reputation - when murderers are cast out of Lavu for their crimes, they often migrate to Gree, where they go to die after being exhausted over the journey there. Yet, even though the wall was built for the protection of Gree in the alternative timeline, it exists in its entirety in both. Why would that be? There are no trees for miles in the regular version of Gree.
v. A Return to the Throne
Some say it's because it existed before the town did, and the town was built inside of it. But then what was the wall used for? In the older days of Zeffon, the curse of the Chaoslands manifested itself in a large heron-like bird that was over 100 feet tall. The presence of this bird sent chills down the spines of strong individuals, and its calls turned many to stone. The wall in the old days had the ability to repel and destroy anything that got near it, with people of the old days hiding within the wall's corridors to avoid the curse of the Chaoslands.
vi. To Consume...
The wall was also built to guard what appeared to be simple grasslands in the area. Again, this is because the Pathiers deemed this site sacred territory that should never be traversed. Naturally, it would make sense that the wall was considered a very holy place for the Pathiers, and that place began to feel the "corruption of the human mind". After years of being a holy shrine, many Pathiers began to feel ill when within the wall, creating a sense of unease that became common. This was called "corruption of the human mind" by religious leaders, who later declared the wall unfit for people. The real reason people were becoming sick is still unclear.

Zeffon.title: Triangle
Zeffon.about:
Demo 13.
i. The Death Wall
Throughout my life, I have had a certain amount of ecstasy, things that make me enjoy my otherwise monotonous existence, things that make me happy to be alive. However, there is a certain threshold to be had in these things, as I am no longer as ecstatic as I was, nor am I as energetic, often collapsing on the old chair at my house that I inherited from other ancestors. My lineage goes much farther than that - people often say I have Unkardian features, such as sunken cheeks and tiny eyes. They would be right for all I knew. I remember the day I encountered Cyane, the man that would eventually tell me these things. He was a man of short stature, saying he owed it to his ancestor Nathaniel Deylane, whom he described as being no higher than an average child at age sixty. I believed it; Cyane seemed just as short.
Of course, I was not happy about the so-called discovery of my ancient Unkardian bloodline. The Unkardians had barely survived the Reve's Genocide all those years ago. Somehow, like roaches, they had lived and were spreading throughout the populace of Ramalest (May she live forever). Although I still hold some of these allegations to be true, I (with no intention of EVER betraying the monarchy) hold in question the things that I've been taught over the years about the filthy Unkardian magic users. Thus, my euphoria has vanished.
On a trip with Cyane to Castle Northane, I came across an excavation. Various dolls (ones made of porcelain and clay) had been pulled out of the wreckage of a burnt estate. The owner was apparently a drunkard who had perished in the flame and embers, unable to get up or get help. We saw no significance in the remains and continued onward, while workers demolished what was left of something once-glorious and lavishly expensive. We continued following the road until we came across a deep wood. The woods themselves seemed to bear no ill will, but I couldn't help but figure something was wrong. Cyane was undeterred and continued forward quicker than I had anticipated. For someone who was quite short, he could run many times faster than I could. I dashed after him, but lost sight of his figure within an instant. It was here that I realized that I was lost. Very lost.
The day rapidly became night, and soon it was pitch black. I pulled out a match and lit it on a nearby rock. The feeble orange light flickered dimly across the closely knit trees and quickly burned out. Feeling around in my raincoat made me realize that I was down to approximately two more matches. I dared not light them, for when I did, it would be truly and permanently dark. After traveling for days with the two sources of light in my pocket, I became parched, hungry, and increasingly tired. Soon, it became difficult to move. When I reached what I felt was the center of this enormous wood, I ran into something sticky. Finally, I felt obligated to shed some light on to the area, and lit my second match.
What I saw was beyond description.
Human bodies, stuck to the enormous tree trucks with melted flesh, were scattered amongst the area. Some of them seemed to be undergoing some sort of metamorphosis, their skin gleaming in the yellow glow of my light. Just as quickly as I could see, my vision went dark again when my match was blown out by a strange gust of wind. A clattering sound, augmented by the sound of small voices filled the air as trees began to snap and crack under the weight of what was swiftly sweeping through the dark.
Eventually, I woke up in a room in Castle Northane. My throat was very sore, and it felt as though I had been screaming for an incredibly long time. The terror I felt had vanished, but I have felt the same type of fear when I have visited Cyane's empty house following his mysterious disappearance. From here, I can only hypothesize how I managed to escape that wood. No one really knew.

Zeffon.title: Tribal Sector
Zeffon.about:
Tribal Sector (Written March 12, 2016)
I hated him. Why didn’t he tell me that he was in danger? Johnny was dead. My uncle was dead. Life was dead. I hated everything.
I itched the pock marks on my arm. Without my knowledge, or anyone’s for the matter, the factory was experimenting on its own workers. I wished I could’ve been my knowledgeable of that at the time, but recovering from an involuntary drug high was preventing me from seeing the writing on the wall. I escaped the town I was in and walked to the outskirts, home to a large desert. Perhaps I would find some solace here.
After a long walk, I began to feel parched and hungry. I didn’t really care though. I had nothing else to live for. Naturally, I was surprised when I swore I saw a castle on the horizon. We didn’t have castles in this land. No one did. Yet there it was, staring me down. I decided to entertain the illusion by walking towards it.
During that journey, I thought about my uncle and his research, as well as poor John. John didn’t have the chance he should have had to live. He was definitely a nice guy. I looked back up. The castle was actually getting larger, something I wouldn’t expect from a mirage. Then I saw something else. A human perhaps? It was in a black cloak, and it silently began to limp in my direction. It scared me, but at the same time, I felt a gentle assurance that this figure was not malevolent. It introduced itself as it got close, and it had the voice of a woman. I realized that I recognized its voice. It was my mother’s.
A very emotion reunion took place. I had not seen my mother in years.
My mother led me to the castle I had been approaching. In it were a number of people looked scared, but for the most part, healthy. This was the tribal sector.

Zeffon.title: Unatikmock in the Evil Forest
Zeffon.about:
i. Headline
Something I uncovered the other day was a body - not just a small animal, or just a normal-sized human body, but a small body about the length of my forearm. It made headlines when it was seen and was mentioned throughout much of the propagated news cycle. I didn't understand why it was there, but it was inherently unsettling to have corpses that were so disfigured and strange-looking buried underneath one's house.
ii. Malwoubetowabi (Part II)
On a list of other things that occurred to me lately, I found that after the police had taken the corpse, I began to feel a sense of unease, like something foreboding was coming to the country. I live in a closed city, so my job is to work at the factories, and the government heavily guards us. So naturally, I shouldn't feel unsafe, but the feeling has still persisted.
iii. Zeffon Appreciates Scripture
I heard later that a plane had been shot down by a good friend of mine, who is somewhere in the government hierarchy prestigious enough that he hears these kinds of things. The pilot was never found, but the inside of what remained of the plane was highly radioactive. My friend asked me to accompany him to some sort of government-sponsored training session shortly after the news made headlines, Apparently, we in the closed city needed to know something.
iv. A Thousand Suns
The world continued to change after that. Our government created its own atomic bomb - something that we knew that we could use against our enemies. We didn't have the means to drop something of its size however, and miniaturization of a such a monumental piece of technology would take several years. We didn't have that time, since the world declared soon after that we were a danger to everyone's sovereignty.
v. Pineapple Frictia Sub-sexist
A covert project started after our technological atom bomb discovery. We, part of the closed city, were to become officers for Program 82, something that required us to speak in code words. We found the meaning of this precaution when three of us were arrested for subversion and espionage. The government was not messing around.
vi. Skittering Tantrum Foanu Nonchalant
Program 82 involved taking an aging plane and testing our new, if not over-sized atomic bomb in a valley between two famous mountains.The news of our discovery would take the world by storm. We knew that. We had to make a statement, according to the government, that we would not be pushed by our oppressors any longer. We were a sovereign nation.
vii. The Seven Sensitive Patches
I was aboard the plane. I was one of the first to know that we had no intention of a "traditional" test, but something more sinister. I passed out for reasons I cannot discern, but in a dream, I remember seeing the body that was buried underneath my house. It started talking to me about a poison, a poison of the mind.
viii. A Monk in His Home of Isolation
I woke up to one of the engines on the aging warplane bursting into flame. The plane began to drop as I began to think about everything that led up to this moment. My life flashed before my eyes as the plane continued to descend. I had been poisoned from the moment I discovered that corpse.
ix. Hymn
It was too late.

Zeffon.title: Unknown...
Zeffon.about:
i. (Yha Evjhnt jc Vefrenwlcbo) Etho
To decide the fate of a world
Through the toss of a coin
The Earth may shatter
The lands may flood
The sky may black out the sun
Heads means death
And tails means life
Or is it the other way around?
Though one way humanity may fall
The coin may never land...
There was a point where Kerragan Cathrop began to feel like there was something special about something he called "the voice". Although he would occasionally tell people about it, not even his partner, Reve Isga believed him. Ever since Uaa Isga made a deal with the Creator and made everyone immortal (that is, people keep coming back to life), Zeffon had known nothing but misery. But there was something that Kerragan began to hear after he came back to life consistently after around 500 years. He began to hear a voice in his head, someone who wanted him and his family to make it outside of Zeffon and onto the Earth of Reverence.
ii. Caria (Frogcatcher, Pt. 2)
Suddenly, there was a stroke of luck. Lydia, Adelais, and their mother Mathilda were the only humans that had remained fertile after the Creator's fall, after Uaa made the deal. The reason for this is unknown, but not a single human had been born or had arrived in Zeffon since Uaa's apostasy. Then, the first daughter of Reve Isga, Madeline Crowa, had a child with a man named Ross Dylai. This child was named Caria, and was considered to be the Crimson Child, or as the people of Zeffon called her, the Young Queen.
iii. Unveiling the Machine
When the Caria Dylai was 15, she began to see the dire state of affairs that Zeffon was in. She decided that there was something that had to be done, unless everyone, including her, would die and live again repeatedly until something was changed. She hated watching her mother and father live in misery, as she was apparently well-acquainted with this voice that her grandfather Kerragan Cathrop had come to know, something Kerragan seemed to be impressed by.
iv. Endigös
Thus, on her sixteenth birthday, Caria told her mother that she was off to find a solution to Zeffon's endless woe. Her mother Madeline wished her luck, but seemed struck with grief that she would lose the only child that an entire dimension had known for millennia. Nevertheless, she bid Caria farewell and allowed her to depart.

Zeffon.title: Unknown Falls
Zeffon.about:
i. An Offer (A Pan.Thy.Monium Tribute)
Truly we cannot determine
The course of events over time
But for some people
It appears to be undeniable
That they will be ensnared in a personal course of destiny
Through the brambles
And various obstacles
Came the man who would loot the mansion
He knew not his goal
Nor his incentive
But knew this is what he had to do.
A chain is as weak as its weakest link
And so the man was told
For if one alters his fate
The chain can break and therefore become nothing
And so the man joined the forces
The ones that would invade the likes of Sharhodeon
Heavily influenced by Pan.Thy.Monium. Ragoonshinaah lives!!
In the end, the man with weights in his hands (7 and 3) has been referred to as a symbol of overcoming adversity. The symbol itself is modeled after a man that the God Muagarah saw in an ancient mansion that exists around Unknown Falls while he was still a human. Muagarah and Eresymcaion, who lived in the alternative timeline with Gree being the only existing town in the Chaoslands, were human. Eventually, they contacted the Forest God, the one that controlled the trees all over the large continent of the Chaoslands. This God was known as Marrus.
ii. Mother is Calling
Marrus was compassionate towards the two children, who had not had anything to eat for a day, as they had traveled deep into the forest, trying to find something that they lost a long time ago. He gave them a home in a deep mansion that had existed before the forest sprang up and enveloped the entirety of the continent. The mansion had something in it, something that Marrus referred to as the Longbow.
iii. Aarmysiseth and Empire
The Longbow was found by Eresymcaion, who took it and shot arrows into the forest. Marrus showed Eresymcaion the different types of trees and then showed him something that appeared when the forest took over the continent: the Nameless Temple.
iv. F.2 (Four Guards and Five Runners)
The Nameless Temple was a large marble strcuture covered in moss, as if it had risen from the earth and taken some of the undergrowth with it. The Nameless Temple was the sleeping place of someone who was betrayed a long time ago, someone who had fallen in love, but then denied the privilege of being with that one person that they admired. That person was Emeroch Isga.
v. Fabled Existence of the Great Master of Patience
The Great Master of Patience, also known as Nathan Va Gero, led Emeroch Isga on a trail of sorts into the depths of the Sharhodeon Forest. Nathan Va Gero was a man who was born in Whip, a town in Verimore. Eventually, he would become acquainted with Marrus, who, after spending time with Nathan in the Sharhodeon Forest, gave Nathan the title "The Great Master of Patience", and along with it, the Forest Element, the fifth element of the Earth. Although the wellbeing of the Earth itself is determined by the Earth Element, the Forest Element gives wellbeing to the things that grow on the Earth.
vi. Outside Unknown Falls
Anyhow, Nathan Va Gero died by the hand of a fell beast that lives in the very depths of the Sharhodeon Forest. Thus, he became a spirit that guided ancient fools into dark places to be destroyed.
vii. Robbing the Mansion of Bones, Longbow, Vines
Why did N. Va Gero feel the need to destroy anyone? Well, some say it was because of the feelings of contempt Nathan had for humanity, something that dictated his actions and his attitudes towards everyone around him. Others say Nathan himself was betrayed, and thus found solace in betraying others. In any case, when Eresymcaion found the Nameless Temple, he went in, finding that the tomb of Emeroch had been opened. Someone or something cracked the stone lid of the coffin down the middle, or had something managed to crawl out? Eresymcaion had no idea, but the air around him began to feel cold, as the stone faces carved in the walls around him began to seep black oil. Eresymcaion dashed out of the room and out of the Nameless Temple, finding that he was in a different world. The sky had become the earth, and the earth had become the sky, and Eresymcaion was struck with fear. Suddenly, what used to be a ceiling (and was now the floor beneath his feet) gave away, and Eresymcaion fell into the endless sky.
viii. Unknown Refeaëlese Call (c.1415)
When Eresymcaion woke up, he was in an arctic setting, surrounded by statues covered in carvings. Not knowing where to go, Eresymcaion headed towards the rising sun, hoping that that would allow him to safely make it back to Gree, though he considered those chances slim, as Gree was now miles above him. According to what I've heard about this alternative dimension, he found a guide in the form of a spirit that showed him the way to the only town in this freezing land. This land, according to rumors, is called True Refeaël.
ix. Gods of Wrath
In any case, the dimension where the two gods are human is a very interesting place. Many people have tried to get to True Refeaël, but have failed, as they have had no idea where to find the Nameless Temple, or Emeroch's grave for that matter. It is said however, because of the third eye in the palm of Emeroch's left hand, that Emeroch had the power to travel to True Refeaël through inverting the world. Eresymcaion apparently never made it back to Gree. He died of the freezing temperatures in a small community known as Adnarim locally, but is technically nameless.
x. SeraphOperations (U.F.SW)
The Seraph Territories' operations in the dimension of Zeffon have prevented the forest from growing beyond Sharhodeon. They say that's the entire reason that the Seraph Territories pursues chemical weapons, but many people doubt this.
xi. S.O. (Re.)
There has been some debate of the true meaning of Adnarim's and True Refeaël's existence. Some say if there really is a tundra above the Earth of Zeffon, how come the stars are visible at night? No one really knows the answer to this, and for now, no one will.

Zeffon.title: (untitled)
Zeffon.about:
An album released independently on December 28, 2010. After that, the album disappeared. I only re-discovered it recently.
i. Static
(Parte I of Hgara)
In the past, the Earth had been coveted by a certain medical company, a group of men who were otherwise kind people looking to share their expertise with the world. This company had no other purpose, other than its goal. Eventually, this company of men would go on to engineer the lunar plane, as well as creating a virus that would control the people they intended to experiment upon. These people were put in a generated world, one that they created with the use of five hackers that would have otherwise been arrested.
Tereban was a nice man, but Reve constantly sensed there was something strange to be had with his presence.
ii. Dodge
The possibility remained that he was an enemy that was just being kind in the time being. The company decided that although he could be a threat, the chances of that were incredibly low. Of course they couldn’t comprehend what was going on in that sense. The company was a strange entity that existed beyond the planes of existence, beyond the lunar plane, which was something that they themselves had invented.
The possibility remained that he was an enemy that was just being kind in the time being.
iii. Ouverture
The medical company lived in an area known as Oblivion, an infinitely large space that the world is destined to fall into once it repeats 515 times. This is the company known as ____. A great war was fought in order to secure this area, one that nearly wiped out humanity. However, ___ came to the rescue and healed the few people that remained, securing that spot in the eyes of mankind. Oblivion was also known as “The End of Time”, being the next and final phase of the universe, one that goes on forever.
It was after Reve's nagging that Tereban finally felt safe with telling Reve who he really was.
iv. Ages
Originally, the company was indeed a medical company that existed far in the future, but got caught up in the desire to control the natural resources that remained on Earth. That plus the desire for the effects of living in Oblivion were the key factors that started the war. Eventually, people began fighting because their relatives were dead, until there were no soldiers left to fight. Everyone else took up arms and there was war until what was then known as The Intervention.
There was a great modern society at one point. It was always felt that it was safe from any sort corruption. Its creators were thus given the title of "Pathier", derived from the term "pathfinder". Therefore, these people created a Kingdom meant to inspire the masses.
v. Peddler's Theme
(Parte II of Hgara)
In the Kingdom of Lavu, things took a turn when a strange man covered in scars visited the kingdom. He claimed to be the son of leader No. 6, Kerragan Cathrop. No one believed him because Kerragan had not had children as far as anyone was aware. Later on, Kerragan and his wife Reve Isga would have a child named Vari. The scene that the strange man caused that day never left Kerragan’s thoughts, however. Kerragan knew who that person was, and he didn’t wish to be reminded. Kerragan was one of 11 survivors from the dimension of Graghgorra, a parallel dimension to Cuja. Another 9 were the members of the Windy Summit, though they themselves didn’t remember. The remaining member was the leader that remained in Refeaël to the south. Kerragan had not heard from him for a while, and thus worried about his wellbeing.
Things changed when a strange man covered in scars visited the kingdom. He claimed to be the son of leader No. 6, Kerragan Cathrop.
vi. Microfarad
When Governor No. 0’s disappearance was reported, strange things began to occur. The Kingdom of Lavu, which was once a desert, became a swamp in a matter of hours, with rainfall covering the town quickly. Eventually, the Kingdom of Lavu became an ocean, with the badlands to the east including Unknown Falls turning into an island. The Great Marsh also disappeared under the sudden rush of water. The rest of the countries sat easy however, as the fall of their permanent enemy would be a great one. Eventually, the only two parts of the Kingdom of Lavu that were above water quickly became what were as the Sharhodeon and Seraph Territories. On that day, the Sharhodeon Territories discovered the ruins of the Uaa off the west coast of the Chaoslands. However, the problems were not restricted to just the Kingdom of Lavu.
No one took this man seriously. Kerragan had never had children. The man vowed revenge for this "callous" rejection.
vii. Bröadcast
As the rainfall disappeared, a vortex appeared in the sky, destroying what was left of the awful world. People seemed to solemnly accept the fact that their world was to be destroyed. They were prepared for this. This ended the first part of the current state of the universe as they knew. Before long, the universe was the puppet of a new creator, one that was beyond any other being that had ever been recognized by man. He was the mysterious unknown, and that was all that could be said regarding him, as he could not be comprehended or described accurately with human words. The obedient stage of humanity was over. The sinful stage had begun.
It was only later that Kerragan and his wife had a child. It was a baby boy named Vari.
viii. Undead Radio
(Parte III of Hgara)
Vari later became deathly ill. During this time, Kerragan and his wife had a baby girl. As the days passed, Vari got better, but no one paid attention to his state of wellbeing. Vari became the estranged first born son of the Cathrops, neither being cared for or about. This state of affairs, brought upon the new world by the brand new universe that housed it, continued to taunt individuals such as Vari. One day, Vari would meet up with a man driven to insanity by the constantly changing atmosphere that affected the world.
Vari later became deathly ill. During this time, Kerragan and his wife had a baby girl.
ix. Outro (Bröadcast)
According to Vari, “he” was a ruler of that Kingdom when all of this was occurring. The Kingdom was not the Kingdom of Lavu, but the Kingdom of the Undead that lay just farther beyond the lake. A tree in the distance shook with much intensity. There was a dragon prowling the woods. That distant dragon would not be able to reach the town. Zeffon.title: 'Urbain Ghra'
Zeffon.about:
i. Grandeur (Part II of II)
In the older days of Ytrac, there was a man who came to the town named Goam Ulyse Acrogge. He was wounded when he approached the town, as there were many things out to get him. He used to be the king of a northern kingdom, but due to his condition, he lost everything. He then visited the sage of the town, who told him about the Fair Tower, and how he could be healed there.
ii. Town of Unknown Worth (Red Hot Candy, Part II of II)
The sage became famous for betraying the people of Ytrac. Although he had good intentions, the curse that the old king had transferred into the land, causing a scourge to fill the nearby soil. The sage, seeing what he had done, locked himself in the very top of Fair Tower, never to be heard from again.
iii. ‘Taraja Wold’s Permafrost Machine’ (Part II of II)
The land began to decay to the point where the earth began to cry out in pain. Strange noises could be heard in the Valley of Fair Tower. The strange sounds may still continue to this day (no one can access the valley nowadays, due to the mountains shifting and closing the only passageway there). It’s only a rumor, but supposedly, there are several ancient relics that exist there.
iv. Heightened Ocean and Sea
One of these ancient relics that exists in the Valley of Fair Tower is an old nameless book that talks about when the mountains of the valley still moved and breathed with the rest of the earth. However, those days are long gone.
v. Beast Eradication
One night, there was a large storm that came into the Valley of Fair Tower. This was the storm that caused the mountains to cease being alive. This storm was caused by an energy of the universe that was moving to fill a void in the valley. The void was that of the yet unknown energy of Dränsilane. When the flow of the energy continued to create a large storm, a new person appeared in a flash of lightning that struck the top of Fair Tower, destroying it and causing it to collapse.
vi. Imprint (Ella's Day)
The person in question was a woman who had been turned invisible by the Shadow People of Dotajmari. All people who have been cursed in such a way find their way to the Valley of Fair Tower. That's one of the reasons Fair Onrac built the tower, so that those cursed by the Shadow People would be able to come into the visible realm once more. This woman managed to find the last village that existed in the valley. The villages of the Valley of Fair Tower had been created to avoid the evil, malicious spirits that haunted the world's oceans. The townsfolk of the village (named Elladay) found that the woman's name was Igen.
vii. Escape From Castle Helga
In the Valley of Fair Tower, there's also a old ruined castle left by the previous inhabitants of the valley: Castle Helga. The castle fell into ruin when Fair Onrac built his tower, most notably because of a disagreement that Fair and the old king of Castle Helga had with the location of the tower on sacred ground. Eventually, Fair challenged the king to a duel and killed him, causing the rest of the inhabitants to disappear and flee the castle entirely.

Zeffon.about:
i. Meteor Shower to the East, Human, Skeleton Amongst the Cedar Trees
The numbers tell all
That through the abyss
My assembly slowly .descended
I didn't know where I was going
I could only walk straight forward
And then I knew
That was as infected
As all the others
It started as a curiosity
Visiting the place where the meteor showers fell
And then I became a slave
To the one who was a slave before
As I walked without turning
Walking towards my doom
I knew that Conan was watching from above
On the first day of her journey, Caria began to travel north of Rasoe on the continent of Unkardia. She had heard that there were snakes in the castle of her great-grandfather, a man named Norfell who stood (at most) two to three feet tall. In the old days, Unkardia was inhabited by people who were short, but the Royal Family's entry to the land caused the people to begin to grow in stature. Supposedly, this lack of height was caused by the snakes that used to live in the land. They began to disappear, but they still existed in Castle Norfell. The reason Caria wanted to find these snakes is that they could speak psychically to one's mind about the mysteries of the universe. She had to be careful though, as the sound of their hiss could turn someone to stone.
ii. Host (Baylisascaris procyonis)
As she approached the castle, she came across some Ognian ruins. These ruins were scattered about the land and had sacred qualities that people would seek out. Ogna was a peaceful empire, a stark contrast with the Royal Family, who terrorized the land of Unkardia, though this is said to have been because they were controlled and forced to do so by their own minds, under the control of a parasite. Caria decided that she would camp out in the ruins for the night, as it was getting dark. She unpacked the sack she had strapped on he shoulder and rummaged through the contents. She was very hungry, as she had not eaten all day.

trackinfo.title: Meteor Shower to the East, Human, Skeleton Amongst the Cedar Trees
trackinfo.lyrics: i. Meteor Shower to the East, Human, Skeleton Amongst the Cedar Trees The numbers tell all That through the abyss My assembly slowly .descended I didn't know where I was going I could only walk straight forward And then I knew That was as infected As all the others It started as a curiosity Visiting the place where the meteor showers fell And then I became a slave To the one who was a slave before As I walked without turning Walking towards my doom I knew that Conan was watching from above On the first day of her journey, Caria began to travel north of Rasoe on the continent of Unkardia. She had heard that there were snakes in the castle of her great-grandfather, a man named Norfell who stood (at most) two to three feet tall. In the old days, Unkardia was inhabited by people who were short, but the Royal Family's entry to the land caused the people to begin to grow in stature. Supposedly, this lack of height was caused by the snakes that used to live in the land. They began to disappear, but they still existed in Castle Norfell. The reason Caria wanted to find these snakes is that they could speak psychically to one's mind about the mysteries of the universe. She had to be careful though, as the sound of their hiss could turn someone to stone.
trackinfo.credits: from Vicious Human Cycle, released August 29, 2013

trackinfo.title: Host (Baylisascaris procyonis)
trackinfo.lyrics: ii. Host (Baylisascaris procyonis) As she approached the castle, she came across some Ognian ruins. These ruins were scattered about the land and had sacred qualities that people would seek out. Ogna was a peaceful empire, a stark contrast with the Royal Family, who terrorized the land of Unkardia, though this is said to have been because they were controlled and forced to do so by their own minds, under the control of a parasite. Caria decided that she would camp out in the ruins for the night, as it was getting dark. She unpacked the sack she had strapped on he shoulder and rummaged through the contents. She was very hungry, as she had not eaten all day.
trackinfo.credits: from Vicious Human Cycle, released August 29, 2013

Zeffon.title: Violence Asylum and Its Martial Anthems
Zeffon.about:
Some info regarding the tracks in this album:
Track 1 recorded in early 2012.
Track 4 recorded in late 2014 for the CD release of Apathy, originally released in 2012.
Track 8 recorded in 2015 as a live improvisation (monophonic) of the EP "Songs of the Dark Earth", released in mid-late 2014.
Track 13 recorded as a follow-up to Chaosfoundry, written in 2011. The track was eventually broken up and the pieces were used on the Apathy and Fate albums, published in 2012 on Jamendo.
Track 15 was originally released as the end to a Revenence track called "Goodbye". This is the full version.
Track 17 was originally Side A to a brief demo series, sold on cassette in 2014. "Cryptic Rays" was originally published on the album "Shorelines I", released in 2013.
Everything else was recorded January, 2015. Enjoy (more or less) over 7 hours of industrial/martial/ambient!
The words sung on "Clay People in the Earth (A Martial Anthem)" are the opening words to Earth Book I, a book other than the Disynxiym. Those words have been published with the untitled track on "7429FD", and are meant to be read while listening.

Zeffon.title: Visual Decay
Zeffon.about:
i. Visual Decay
The second single for the month of September.
The earth began to reek of rotten meat after the Dark Comet and the blue moon had passed. A new species was beginning to leech away at the life energy of the Earth, causing many repercussions for the people on the surface. Crops died, and harvests were small. Supposedly, on Meredith, the island of the Marat Empire, the locals were burning their children alive. According to an ancient superstition, the power of life would fill the air after it was extracted from nearby people. At the Temple of Jeramaj, a decree was made by Vant Ruan, making murder legal until the hardships plaguing the island had passed. We could hardly believe our ears once we heard that this was occurring. Oddly enough, Rowland suddenly decided to send a peacekeeping force over to Meredith, and we were to be included.

Zeffon.title: Void
Zeffon.about:
i. Music Box V
Void is an experimental album, best heard when the listener is either running a fever or mentally insane. Or both for that matter. The Last Murder is where Samuel Cathrop makes his final kill before being captured later.
The two part song "Hermit of the Pol Mountains" is meant to represent a hermit that keeps playing the same song over and over. As the hermit ages, natural mistakes occur, and the song changes.
Still, despite being faced with death, we managed to escape our stone prisons. We were close to dying, so we used our energy conservatively. Despite this, our bodies soon gave up and we died. Due to Ryan’s desires for our future however, we continued to walk the Earth as spirits.
~
Builds off of the previous release, Yet Another Dimension. The final part of the five music boxes.
ii. Altitude Sickness
That’s when Ryan informed us of something that will continue to haunt me forever. In the past, me, Emeroch, and my father Norfell had abandoned our family in their time of need, taking a secret passage out of the throne room just as three Arc-Demai stormed into the chamber. My mother Mathilda survived, but was distraught for the rest of her life. Our sisters Reve, Adelais, and Lydia were taken by beasts and disappeared.
~
Meant to kind of simulate the things I think I hear when I'm down with the flu and fading in and out of sleep.
iii. Dead Frequencies
It came to Ryan’s attention that at the very least, Reve was still alive. According to Ryan, she was still a young woman, having aged very little. Of course, we were dumbfounded. Reve was born over 500 years ago! How could she still be a young woman? The answer is still unknown to me, but I suspect it had to do with her husband Creator, or as he was known at the time, Kerragan Cathrop.
~
Represents a man who had previously cut down multiple forests. He entered the woods one rainy day and was never seen again.
iv. Hermit of the Pol Mountains
Emeroch moved to the Pol Mountains after he found this out. His spirit wandered the snow-capped peaks for years, watching Reve from afar. Then came the horrible part. Emeroch was forced by Ryan’s psychic powers to kidnap our sister’s son. We both resisted. Vari was the son of our blood sister! How could we even think of doing such a thing? Even though it was not our own conscious thought process that was considering this ordeal, I still feel responsible for what happened to Vari Cathrop.
~
A hermit in the mountains who plays the same song over and over. As time passes, the song changes. Continued on the song "Winter".
v. Interlude (Void)
We led Reve’s son back to Anne, our island. Under Ryan’s power, I destroyed Vari’s soul and took his body.
~
Represents the trauma of a child whose father has disappeared.
vi. Winter (Hermit of the Pol Mountains, Pt. 2)
To this day, I still look like Reve’s son. Emeroch also was forced to kidnap Reve’s daughter Madeline, and to take the body of a poor boy from the town of Cathrop on Anne named Gaine and take on Creator’s old name. I never knew the true reasons for Ryan’s actions, other than he wanted me and Emeroch to become dark lords whom he would control like pawns. My sister became emotionless after the whole ordeal, and after Creator left her, she has spent most of her time trying to find her lost children.
vii. The Last Murder
Back in Lavu, Dr. Uy had murdered a third person, but the police were still after Samuel Cathrop. Rowland Meylith didn’t inform the police, nor did he care. Samuel Cathrop had still managed to elude the police, though.
~
A man is killed for the third time within a kingdom known as the Kingdom of Lavu. Unlike the first murder, the public hardly takes notice.
viii. Amber Shades
With Emeroch’s help, who was now the second person named Kerragan Cathrop in seat No. 6 of Lavu, I was placed as seat No. 7 under the name Ryce Ilhid. Together with member No. 4, Keshka Metmarshe, we made the decision to do something good with our lives: Establish a free, non-oppressive empire and raise the Earth from the ashes of apocalypse.
~
Treats the season of Autumn as an entity, one that has the power to change an entire forest.
ix. Catoblepas
Keshka informed us that he was one of the few who knew Rowland’s true identity as Creator. He also knew that Creator had lost a lot of his power from his purging of Ryan’s rule of the universe.
~
The four part album series (Catoblepas, Mist, Yet Another Dimension, Void) reaches its closing stages.
x. Prokaryote
?

Zeffon.title: Voyager
Zeffon.about:
i. 901 - I Don't Care About Distortion
There is a town in the sky (or so it is said) called "Adnarim", and it is home to a bunch of people who fell out of favor with Emeroch Isga. It is said that Emeroch was pursuing a woman, but I know the truth: he was pursuing a rare animal that could only be found in another dimension, because this is the animal whose blood could cure his disease. He met a young man by the name of Nathan Va Gero in his travels, but Nathan disappeared. They were good friends in life, and so Emeroch went into the Sharhodeon Forest to find him.
ii. Voyager
In the Sharhodeon Forest, Emeroch became lost, and night rolled in. It didn't matter that much because the trees obscured all light anyway. Emeroch knew that he didn't have a lot of time left in Zeffon because of his disease. With Emeroch Isga's condition, one is born with a third eye in the palm of their hand. If it is in the right hand, good fortune will come your way until the eye closes. If it is in the left hand, like Emeroch, then the person stays bound in their body forever, even when it begins to die and decay.
iii. Why Are We Here and Not There?
Emeroch has repeatedly written poetry about the subject, and scattered the pages throughout time. One of his most famous works is associated with the Earth Book of Unkardia, and was copied down into the tome when it was discovered.
iv. Pulklos, Part 3
Emeroch at the time of his departure into the Sharhodeon Forest, wrote a piece of poetry that has not been found anywhere. There is a line that has been made known through Reve Terra Lyeon's psychic power. It reads as follows:
"I take off the leather gauntlet that covers my left hand, and the eye stares back at me, wide open, as if it sees something over my shoulder."
v. Thé Läp, Part 2
The journey into the Sharhodeon Forest was a tough one for Emeroch. He passed many different statues that remained from when the forest was a country. According to Reve Terra Lyeon, there was something, as described in the poem extract, that kept bothering Emeroch as he was traveling deeper and deeper. There was some sort of personage that kept appearing and disappearing, watching Emeroch from behind. At the end, Emeroch began to hear some odd sounds. Then, there was a whistle, and a deep moan from around the trees. That's when Emeroch's lantern suddenly ran out of fuel.
vi. Superviolent
When Emeroch awoke, he was in complete darkness. Feeling around, he could feel grass, albeit grass covered in slime. He looked at his left hand. Although the light level was terrible, he could make out the white of the eye, as if the pupil had been clouded over. He sat up and then looked down and realized that he was missing his right leg. Feeling around, he found his axe. His equipment had been strewn about as if something sadistic had been playing with his unconscious corpse, and then tossed him aside when it got bored.
vii. During the Mission To Convert
There was a small glow, and Emeroch heard a voice in his head. What it said was a mystery to Reve Terra Lyeon when I asked her, but she summed it up the best she could:
"There is a lake covered by the trees, Emeroch. In it, is a temple that contains that which can help you with your disease. Don't be afraid: it's me, Nathan. I am now a spirit of this forest. In this lake temple, there is a fell beast that has caused the waters of this dimension to become corrupted, to sting like lava. If the beast is defeated, then the entire dimension will be free of the curse of the Chaoslands. There will be a ghost that will need your guidance, Emeroch. That is your purpose".
The psychic transmission became too hard for Miss Lyeon to decode at this point.
viii. Guinea 1
In any case, not much is known about what has become of Emeroch, as he has not emerged from the forest. Some say he's dead, but I want to believe that he's alive in there somewhere. This ghost that Nathan spoke of, also intrigues me deeply, as well as the monster at the bottom of the Lake Temple. To be the manifestation of the curse of the Chaoslands must make it very powerful, powerful enough to cling to life for a very long time.

Zeffon.title: White Tape
Zeffon.about:
i. Space Patrol, Part 3
In the end, Castle Ghra was part of a large revolution against the reigning party that lived on the hill above. This reigning party lived near the only active volcano in Zeffon. Castle Ghra had been oppressed for the longest time, being part of an inferior class of people (or so the ancient kings claimed). There was a strange thing that happened later on though. Once, Castle Ghra got access to some of the secrets of Dynamix16, a group of individuals who straddle the two realities of Zeffon and The Alternative Dimension.
ii. No Harm
Castle Ghra eventually overcame the evil kings through information warfare. The "superior" people who lived with the evil kings could no longer abide with the idea of being ill-willed towards the "inferiors". Thus, the evil kings were killed from within.
iii. Why Do You Start Fires?
The kings never forgave Castle Ghra for the loss of their power, and so cursed the land, that it would never see light again. The castle lies abandoned, and the land all around it uninhabited.
iv. Dr. X and His Radioactive Computer
Things changed after Dynamix16 gave their influence to Castle Ghra. To them, it was a gift. To the others, it was a curse. Eventually, a giant stone statue was built by the last people who lived in Castle Ghra. The statue, called the Tuhigpläfen, exhibited a strange expression that one could only describe as a mix of curiousity and terror, representing the gift that Dynamix16 had to bring. Eventually, when the last people left Castle Ghra, Dr. X, one of the Dynamix16 leaders, tried to have the statue destroyed. Despite their technology, Dynamix16 was able to only take a small chip out of the knee of the Tuhigpläfen, and they eventually gave up.
v. Sinclaire
Dr. X then began to feel the most inexplicable terror coming from the stone fragment, something that he had not felt in the longest time. Dr. X had been a king of the nameless volcano, but had been hired by Dynamix16 out of his thirst for increased control and power.
vi. Gerstaadhion
The next night, Dr. X vanished.
vii. Ice Spear (ヴィルード火山)
The volcano then erupted for the last time. When members of Dynamix16 went to the nameless volcano to inspect it, they found that all the lava had disappeared, and the crater was full of rainwater. Suddenly, one of the members pointed towards something they could see moving under the surface of the pool, causing some of the members to run in terror. One member however (2510), stayed behind and briefly observed the underwater movement before he too was filled with horror and departed.

Zeffon.title: Wounded Land
Zeffon.about:
This album starts a new phase in Zeffon. Everything has returned to normal, but there are only about 10 people left on earth, Reve Terra Lyeon being one of them. The people start their first community in a town they call Vorsanchu. Eventually, the town reaches around 60 people. Reve is rejected as an outcast, since the other nine original inhabitants remember the issues that arose with her uncle that sought to rule the universe. She is cast out of Vorsanchu and becomes a hermit, watching the town from afar. Reve spends the remaining 77 years of her life in the Ill Mountains (named that because of her presence) and then passes away.
The untitled track represents the initial desolate state of the earth.
Requiem, Pt. 2 represents the First Assembly. The First Assembly is the group of nine plus Reve that established Vorsanchu.
Hiding in Leaves represents a strong wind that came around the 30th year after Vorsanchu was established.
Trapped in a Box represents the search for more ethnic groups that may or may not have been preserved by means of mysterious coffins, referred to as "Boxes". This formal search occurred in years 2 and 3 before it was abandoned.

Zeffon.title: Wysteriascape
Zeffon.about:
i. Dawn
This album is the sixth and last of Kerragan's prophetic dream sequence. In this album, Kerragan dreams he's running endlessly from something malevolent, but doesn't know what.
In the depths of the Wysteriascape, in the End Temple, a certain sage awaited the arrival of her guests. Soon enough, the man who was called Tereban arrived, although he did not look his best. There was also another man named Lloyd, a young boy called Stephane, and the corpse of a young woman. They seemed relieved to have arrived in the place, especially Tereban. A request was made, one that the sage had not fulfilled in a long time.
ii. Asymmetry
Yet, it was still possible. With her powers, the young woman’s corpse was revived. The young woman thanked the sage, and the young boy hugged the woman. The sage smiled briefly, but then looked rather sad. Upon their inquiry as to why she seemed this way, she revealed that a strange wind was coming, one that could wipe the Earth from the plane of existence.
iii. They Say The Winds Steal Your Spirit
The sage got up and then closed the doors to the temple. The wind outside was getting stronger.
”It’s time. The creator of our universe is dying, so he aims to destroy everything we’ve worked for,” she said. “The Wysteriascape is the only place that remains safe from his power, since it straddles two dimensional planes.”
I simply remained hidden behind one of the columns. I didn’t feel like being seen.
iv. Wysteriascape
It was from that day on that the world changed. I moved to the roof of the End Temple and I could see the ocean that surrounded the Wysteriascape’s island drying up. It was true. Creator had somehow destroyed O23 and his own creator. Out of curiosity, I moved through the dissolving space and found the isle of Exeräise where he had resided about this time. The Magot Tower was shooting purple beams into the sky! I didn’t quite understand, but I could only assume that the Magot Tower was not really a tower, but a giant cannon. I moved back the Wysteriascape to make sure I wasn’t dissolved just like the rest of the world. The sea around the Wysteriascape was completely gone by this time, and was in fact covered in huge trees all of a sudden. I went back in the End Temple only to encounter Yvonne. Yvonne said that Reve had left and was going out to collect survivors via horseback. It seems that Nightmare had recovered from that fall after all.
~
Nightmare galloped through the trees which continued to grow taller and taller. The dimensional effects on the land were incredible! The night began to come, and crickets were already beginning to chirp. Reve had already began to round up survivors and was sending them to the End Temple. It was seeming that this was not quite the apocalypse that was expected. Yet, there was a strange presence that made me feel like it was not all over.
Zeffon.credits:
released May 27, 2012
Sound Credits - timbre, dobroide, 3bagbrew
Everything Else - Creighton Jenkins

Zeffon.title: Xezbr
Zeffon.about:
i. Xezbr
The thirteenth part of Serenade for the Dead.
My friend's name was Xezbr. He was an interesting fellow that, as I mentioned before, became obsessed with the Crown of the Nacajda. Whatever the reason was for this I could not tell.
We arrived in Runame, a small village in the country of Refeaël. The subject of Refeaël is something that we rarely talk about here in Lavu, and I shall do the same. Let's just say the very name of the country evokes a certain idea that we as Lavulese individuals are a bit uncomfortable with. That's putting it lightly. Anyway, we arrived in Runame, and the local government instantly sent their secret police after us. Like I said, we Lavulese hate Refeaël with a passion, so it's not often that people who live in the country meet travelers. We were quickly arrested and thrown into the local jail on no charges we could discern.

Zeffon.title: Yet Another Dimension
Zeffon.about:
i. Music Box I
Yet Another Dimension is about the possibility of a secret group meeting in the impoverished provinces of Blueheart. Even the Secret Police within Lavu seem to know little to nothing about them, other than they exist.
The Dark within Ryan stayed in my blood after all those years. After I ran like a coward when my sisters were in danger, me and Emeroch encountered the Nightmare.
ii. Central Square
The Nightmare was the talking horse of Aed, who had died cursing my ancestor Ryan. A certain secretive group in Blueheart that was devoted to the re-discovery of the past often talked about Nightmare in the streets of Blueheart during stormy nights. Though they were committed, there was little they could discover on their own.
iii. Music Box II
Nightmare was cursed to lead all ancestors of Ryan astray. Even a small boy whom Reve found had been victim to Nightmare’s various ways. It was only after I brought him to the now-sage Yvonne who was married to Ryan all those years ago that she cured Nightmare of his curse. Nightmare can no longer talk, but is still a strong and very capable horse.
iv. The Bending Walls Above Me
Nightmare was attracted like Aed was to Dark in Blood. Dark is a magical chemical that can exist in one’s bloodstream, making the able to use a type of magic called Darko. The magic is the same that the Bell of Noor is composed of.
v. Woodlands
In order to use Darko, the evil dark god Muagara demands a sacrifice of flesh and blood. The closer you are to death upon your self-mutilation, the stronger you become.
vi. Music Box III
The whole reason Aed challenged Ryan in the first place was to obtain Darko for his own use. When Aed was killed, he cursed his horse to hunt down Ryan’s descendants, obtain Darko, and use it to revive Aed himself.
vii. Yet Another Dimension
Though this was nearly obtained through me, I was saved. When Nightmare had me cornered and began to extract my energy, I fell into yet another dimension. I don’t fully know the secrets behind dimensions, but I know that they can hold more power and knowledge than anything else. Dimensions are the universe, and should be regarded as such. When I left the dimension, I had survived, but I also had grown quite malevolent under Nightmare’s influence. Me and Emeroch decided to show humanity that Unkardia and Anne were not trivial places to loot and occupy, but legitimate lands of their own. Of course now, I don’t think this way.
viii. Music Box IV
Due to Ryan’s obsession of Darko, he used his powers to create the Device. The Device is what me and Emeroch used to hone our Instinct, a discovery that we could not have found with Ryan’s psychic aid. However, the Kingdom of Lavu had discovered this tech as “accident-proofing” technology years before we did. Our methods of honing our bodies were crude at best.

trackinfo.title: Music Box I
trackinfo.lyrics: i. Music Box I Yet Another Dimension is about the possibility of a secret group meeting in the impoverished provinces of Blueheart. Even the Secret Police within Lavu seem to know little to nothing about them, other than they exist. The Dark within Ryan stayed in my blood after all those years. After I ran like a coward when my sisters were in danger, me and Emeroch encountered the Nightmare.
trackinfo.credits: from Yet Another Dimension, released June 16, 2012

trackinfo.title: Central Square
trackinfo.lyrics: ii. Central Square The Nightmare was the talking horse of Aed, who had died cursing my ancestor Ryan. A certain secretive group in Blueheart that was devoted to the re-discovery of the past often talked about Nightmare in the streets of Blueheart during stormy nights. Though they were committed, there was little they could discover on their own.
trackinfo.credits: from Yet Another Dimension, released June 16, 2012

trackinfo.title: Music Box II
trackinfo.lyrics: iii. Music Box II Nightmare was cursed to lead all ancestors of Ryan astray. Even a small boy whom Reve found had been victim to Nightmare’s various ways. It was only after I brought him to the now-sage Yvonne who was married to Ryan all those years ago that she cured Nightmare of his curse. Nightmare can no longer talk, but is still a strong and very capable horse.
trackinfo.credits: from Yet Another Dimension, released June 16, 2012

trackinfo.title: The Bending Walls Above Me
trackinfo.lyrics: iv. The Bending Walls Above Me Nightmare was attracted like Aed was to Dark in Blood. Dark is a magical chemical that can exist in one’s bloodstream, making the able to use a type of magic called Darko. The magic is the same that the Bell of Noor is composed of.
trackinfo.credits: from Yet Another Dimension, released June 16, 2012

trackinfo.title: Woodlands
trackinfo.lyrics: v. Woodlands In order to use Darko, the evil dark god Muagara demands a sacrifice of flesh and blood. The closer you are to death upon your self-mutilation, the stronger you become.
trackinfo.credits: from Yet Another Dimension, released June 16, 2012

trackinfo.title: Music Box III
trackinfo.lyrics: vi. Music Box III The whole reason Aed challenged Ryan in the first place was to obtain Darko for his own use. When Aed was killed, he cursed his horse to hunt down Ryan’s descendants, obtain Darko, and use it to revive Aed himself.
trackinfo.credits: from Yet Another Dimension, released June 16, 2012

trackinfo.title: Yet Another Dimension
trackinfo.lyrics: vii. Yet Another Dimension Though this was nearly obtained through me, I was saved. When Nightmare had me cornered and began to extract my energy, I fell into yet another dimension. I don’t fully know the secrets behind dimensions, but I know that they can hold more power and knowledge than anything else. Dimensions are the universe, and should be regarded as such. When I left the dimension, I had survived, but I also had grown quite malevolent under Nightmare’s influence. Zeffon.title: Zeffen Imââôprha der to der Sulka - Mentstroââi Maarr Lowlands
Zeffon.about:
My second release on Murmure Intemporel. This album's divided into two parts: Urban-Habitual and Tribal-Temporary.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Uploaded to Bandcamp on 8/27/22.
======================================================
This album (and its crazy title) are dedicated to the dead and the odd rumors surrounding death.
In a few words, the songs themselves are meant to invoke a sense of malaise and uneasiness.
In a place called Inejeheim, a man became lost after the discovery of a book, thought long lost.
The book contained a song to Awaken the Living, which the man percieved as odd, since the Living often wake by themselves (this song is on my previous Cian Orbe release: Delete the Mouth and Inhale). The book itself briefly mentions waking the dead, but does not elaborate.
After playing the song to Awaken the Living, the man set off on his travels, coming to the humid land of Inejeheim. Despite being surrounded by ponds, springs, and rivers of all kinds, the man began to find that water began to quench his thirst less and less.
After many days, he found himself in a field covered in a thick fog. Then, he found a traveler sitting in a muddy pit, and it quickly began to rain. The traveler looked as though he had not slept for days, and so the man sat down to keep the traveler company, and so he might comfort him.
The next morning, as the fog cleared, a farmer found the traveler and man in the pit, dead and shriveled to near skeletons. The ground around them was no longer mud, but appeared parched, like it hadn't rained in that spot for years.
